\"Champion's Song\" Painting.text: Loot: Altus Plateau. Acquired from interacting with the painting found in a wooden structure north of the Shaded Castle Ramparts Site of Grace.

\"Domain of Dragons\" Painting.text: Loot: Shadow Keep. Acquired from interacting with a painting found in a hidden room, northeast of the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace. This room is found down a ladder, which is hidden within an opening by the water moat leading to the Specimen Storehouse.

\"Flightless Bird\" Painting.text: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Acquired from interacting with the painting found in the same room as the Fortified Manor, First Floor Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

\"Homing Instinct\" Painting.text: Loot: Limgrave. Acquired from interacting with the painting found inside the Artist's Shack located on a hill, past the road north of Waypoint Ruins.

\"Incursion\" Painting.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain. Acquired from interacting with the painting found in the Artist's Shack found on the cliffs southeast of Prospect Town.

\"Prophecy\" Painting.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle. Acquired from interacting with the painting found inside a room found west of the heavily barricaded courtyard of Stormveil Castle.

\"Redmane\" Painting.text: Loot: Caelid. Acquired from interacting with the painting found almost buried by sand underneath a balcony in Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

\"Resurrection\" Painting.text: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. Acquired from interacting with the painting found inside the Artist's Shack located near a cliff in east Liurnia.

\"Sorcerer\" Painting.text: Loot: Mountaintops of the Giants. Acquired from interacting with the painting found inside a building located in the middle of Castle Sol, the room can only be accessed from above. The player needs to traverse the northern and western ramparts, guarded by Exile Soldier Phantoms on mounted ballistas to be able to reach it.

\"The Sacred Tower\" Painting.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain. Acquired from interacting with a painting found in a cave, northeast of the Scorched Ruins.

About Adding Skills.text: Acquired automatically after obtaining the Whetstone Knife from the cellar of Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave.

About Birdseye Telescopes.text: Acquired automatically when approaching a Birdseye Telescope for the first time.

About Combat with Spirit Ashes.text: Acquired automatically after interacting with Marika's Effigy inside the Caelid Colusseum for the first time.

About Competitive Multiplayer.text: Acquired automatically after picking up the Duelist's Furled Finger by the gate of Limgrave Colosseum.

About Containers.text: Acquired automatically after obtaining their first Container. Meaning either a Cracked Pot, Ritual Pot or Perfume Bottle.

About Cooperative Multiplayer.text: Acquired automatically after obtaining the Tarnished's Furled Finger near the Stranded Graveyard Sites of Grace.

About Crouching.text: Acquired automatically when arriving to the section with many bushes in the latter half of the Cave of Knowledge.

About Death.text: Acquired automatically after the player dies for the first time, after arriving in the Stranded Graveyard. (The guaranteed death at Chapel of Anticipation does not count.).

About Dodging.text: Acquired automatically early on in the Cave of Knowledge.

About Duels.text: Acquired automatically after interacting with Marika's Effigy inside the Royal Colusseum in Leyndell for the first time.

About Fast Travel to Sites of Grace.page: About Fast Travel to Sites of Grace

About Flask of Wondrous Physick.text: Acquired automatically after picking up the Flask of Wondrous Physick at the Third Church of Marika in Limgrave.

About Great Runes.text: Acquired automatically after obtaining the player's first Devoid Great Rune.

About Guard Counters.text: Acquired automatically when approaching the Soldier of Godrick boss in the Cave of Knowledge.

About Guarding.text: Acquired automatically early on in the Cave of Knowledge.

About Guidance of Grace.text: Acquired automatically after touching a Site of Grace that emits the Guidance of Grace for the first time.

About Horseback Riding.text: Acquired automatically after obtaining the Spectral Steed Whistle from Melina.

About Hunter Multiplayer.text: Acquired automatically after purchasing the Blue Cipher Ring from the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold.

About Invasion Multiplayer.text: Acquired automatically after receiving the Festering Bloody Fingers from White Mask Varré at Rose Church in Liurnia, as long as this is the first time the player has obtained them. (If the player has obtained Festering Bloody Fingers from any other source before this, then this Info Item is left unobtainable.).

About Item Crafting.text: Acquired automatically after purchasing the Crafting Kit from Merchant Kalé.

About Marika's Effigy at the Roundtable.page: About Marika's Effigy at the Roundtable

About Materials.text: Acquired automatically after picking up a Crafting Material for the first time.

About Monument Icon.text: Acquired automatically after walking within the radius of a Rebirth Monument after obtaining the Spirit Calling Bell. (This Info Item became unobtainable after the release of App Ver.1.06.).

About New Inventory Features.text: Acquired automatically upon loading a save after updating the game to Version 1.11.

About Requesting Help from Hunters.text: Acquired automatically after purchasing the White Cipher Ring from the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold.

About Roundtable Hold.text: Acquired automatically after the player permits Melina to transport them to the Roundtable Hold for the first time.

About Sites of Grace.text: Acquired automatically after touching a Site of Grace for the first time.

About Spiritspring Jumping.text: Acquired automatically when approaching a Spiritspring while riding Torrent.

About Stakes of Marika.text: Acquired automatically when approaching the Stake of Marika towards the end of the Cave of Knowledge.

About Stance-Breaking.text: Acquired automatically towards the end of the Cave of Knowledge.

About Strengthening Armaments.text: Acquired automatically after picking up the Smithing Stone 1 on the Anvil at the Church of Elleh in Limgrave.

About Summoning Pools.text: Acquired automatically after picking up the Small Golden Effigy and Small Red Effigy from any of the Summoning Pools scattered throughout the Lands Between.

About Teardrop Scarabs.text: Acquired automatically when approaching a Teardrop Scarab for the first time.

About United Combat and Combat Ordeals.page: About United Combat and Combat Ordeals
About United Combat and Combat Ordeals.text: Acquired automatically after interacting with Marika's Effigy inside the Limgrave Colusseum for the first time.

About Vanquishing Enemy Groups.text: Acquired automatically after the player clears an enemy group for the first time.

About Wielding Armaments.text: Acquired automatically early on in the Cave of Knowledge.

About the Cave of Knowledge.text: Limgrave, (Stranded Graveyard). Recieved automatically when approaching the hole that leads to the Cave of Knowledge.

About the Map.text: Acquired automatically after opening the Map for the first time.

About the Revered Spirit Ash Blessing.page: About the Revered Spirit Ash Blessing
About the Revered Spirit Ash Blessing.text: Acquired automatically upon obtaining one's first Revered Spirit Ash.

About the Scadutree Blessing.text: Acquired automatically upon obtaining one's first Scadutree Fragment.

Academy Glintstone Key.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Temple Quarter). Found to the north of the Site of Grace, on the corpse of a Glintstone Sorcerer guarded by Glintstone Dragon Smarag. Liurnia of the Lakes (Debate Parlor). Traversing the rooftops to the north-east of the Site of Grace, found on top of a chandelier in the Church of the Cuckoo.

Academy Glintstone Staff.text: Guaranteed drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Dropped by Thops, either by killing him in the Church of Irith or upon finishing his questline, inside the Academy of Raya Lucaria just before the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace. Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes/Caelid/Mt. Gelmir. 2% drop chance from Glintstone Sorcerers (excluding the Lazuli variant).

Academy Magic Pot.text: Recipe is included with Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [8], found in the Consecrated Snowfield, south-west of Albinauric Rise.

Academy Scroll.text: Guaranteed Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. Found in the graveyard west of the Land-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace, in southernmost Liurnia of the Lakes. Can easily be reached from either the exit from Stormveil Castle or with the path at the broken bridge in Stormhill.

Adula's Moonblade.text: Guaranteed Drop: Moonlight Altar. Acquired from defeating Glintstone Dragon Adula at the front entrance of the Cathedral of Manus Celes.

Aeonian Butterfly.text: Aeonian Butterflies can be found in the world, however they do not respawn after dying or resting at a Site of Grace. Loot: Caelid. x1 in one of the buildings in the Street of Sages Ruins, in the Swamp of Aeonia. x1 south of the Heart of Aeonia.

Aged One's Exultation.text: Guaranteed Drop: Abyssal Woods. Aged One's Exultation is dropped by the Aging Untouchable found nearest to the Abandoned Church in the Abyssal Woods. The Aging Untouchable is only vulnerable after it has been parried.

Agheel's Flame.text: Dragon Communion: Caelid. Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 2 Dragon Hearts after defeating Flying Dragon Agheel.

Ailment Talisman.text: Ailment Talisman is found in the Gravesite Plain at the Abandoned Ailing Village. It is located on a corpse at the edge of an unfinished wooden bridge.

Alabaster Lord's Sword.text: Guaranteed drop: Lake of Rot / Yelough Anix Tunnel (Consecrated Snowfield). One each is dropped by respective the Alabaster Lord in the Lake of Rot and in Yelough Anix Tunnel. Note that the sword will not drop if the Lord is killed at the same time as the player.

Alberich's Bracers.text: Found alongside the rest of the armor set in the Fortified Manor's entry hall, Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Alberich's Pointed Hat.text: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Alberich's Pointed Hat is found in the entry hall of the Fortified Manor in Leyndell, located on the Altus Plateau.

Alberich's Pointed Hat (Altered).text: The non-altered version can be found alongside the rest of the armor set in the Fortified Manor's entry hall, Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Alberich's Robe.text: Found alongside the rest of the armor set in the Fortified Manor's entry hall, Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Alberich's Robe (Altered).text: The non-altered version can be found alongside the rest of the armor set in the Fortified Manor's entry hall, Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Alberich's Trousers.text: Found alongside the rest of the armor set in the Fortified Manor's entry hall, Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Albinauric Ashes.text: Found on a corpse in a cemetery east of Caria Manor. Only accessible after defeating Royal Knight Loretta as the spot is on the high cliffs behind the Manor.

Albinauric Bow.text: Drop: Consecrated Snowfield / Ordina, Liturgical Town. 4% drop from Albinauric Archer enemies, whether riding a wolf or not, of which many can be found between the Sites of Grace Inner Consecrated Snowfield and Ordina, Liturgical Town. 3 sitting Archers can be found just south and southeast of Ordina, Liturgical Town's Site of Grace, sitting at the top of some small cliffs.

Albinauric Mask.text: Found alongside the Albinauric Staff on a corpse near an Omenkiller in the same building as the Guest Hall grace in Volcano Manor. It is accessed by jumping on a balcony with a visible opened door.

Albinauric Pot.text: Recipe is included with Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [3], found in Highway Lookout Tower (Liurnia).

Albinauric Shield.text: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Consecrated Snowfield. 2% drop chance from curved sword- or axe-wielding Second-Generation Albinauric enemies. Three shield-wielders can be found on a sunken church/trio of buildings northwest of the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace and southwest of the icon for Academy Gate Town itself. Note that the blood red Albinarics in Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum don't drop this shield.

Albinauric Staff.text: Loot: Mt. Gelmir. Found together with the Albinauric Mask in the same room as an Omenkiller, located on the third floor of the same building as the Guest Hall Site of Grace, located in Volcano Manor. This room is accessed by jumping onto a balcony from the roof of the building. The balcony is located to the right of the building when looking towards the main entrance on the second floor.

Alexander's Innards.text: Crumbling Farum Azula (Dragon Temple Lift). Drop: Alexander, Warrior Jar, alongside Shard of Alexander. He's found on the path south-east of the Site of Grace.

All-Knowing Armor.text: Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

All-Knowing Armor (Altered).text: Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

All-Knowing Gauntlets.text: Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

All-Knowing Greaves.text: Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

All-Knowing Helm.text: Dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing upon defeat.

Alluring Pot.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [21], found behind an illusory wall in Volcano Manor.

Altus Bloom.text: Grows in the Altus Plateau. 8% chance for 5 Altus Blooms to drop from Perfumers. 15% chance for 5 Altus Blooms to drop from Depraved Perfumers.

Amber Draught.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Royal Moongazing Ground). Quest: received by Preceptor Seluvis after he's given the Amber Starlight from Altus Plateau.

Amber Starlight.text: Altus Plateau (Altus Highway Junction). Area: at the foot of the statue of Malenia and Miquella, found north-east of the Site of Grace.

Ambush Shard.text: Loot: Weeping Peninsula. Acquired from a corpse next to the imprisoned Sellen in the cellar of Witchbane Ruins.

Ancestral Infant's Head.text: Ancestral Infant's Head is looted from a chest in a ruin north of Hallowhorn Grounds (North).

Ancestral Spirit's Horn.text: Trade the Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor, gained by defeating Regal Ancestor Spirit, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Ancient Death Rancor.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Acquired from defeating the Death Rite Bird that roams the sunken ruins south of the Gate Town North Site of Grace at night.

Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff.text: Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor in Sainted Hero's Grave.

Ancient Dragon Prayerbook.text: Found on the floor in the giant hall between the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths and Tempest-Facing Balcony Site of Grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.

Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.text: There is a limited number of Ancient Dragon Smithing Stones that can be acquired each playthrough. There's 13 in the base game and 9 in the Realm of Shadow, for a total of 22 per playthrough. However keep in mind, some are obtained through quests, and can be locked out from obtaining them. 13x found in the base game:. 1x given by Nepheli Loux at the end of her questline.

Ancient Dragon's Blessing.text: Quest Reward: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion (Foot of the Jagged Peak). Given by the Dragon Communion Priestess by selecting "Ask for power" as long as Bayle the Dread hasn't been defeated and no Ancient Dragon's Blessing is in the Tarnished's inventory.

Ancient Dragons' Lightning Spear.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for 8,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Ancient Dragon Prayerbook.

Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for 10,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Ancient Dragon Prayerbook.

Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword.text: Loot: Ruined Forge Starfall Past (Scadu Altus). Obtained upon examining the altar of the dungeon. The altar is found on the second level of the dungeon. To reach it, you must pull the lever to make the iron door rise, and use it as a platform to jump across to the second level where the altar is.

Ansbach's Attire.text: Quest reward: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Available after successfully assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Specimen Storehouse. Then defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The item can be recovered from Ansbach's body, which can be found seated against one of the walls close to the entrance of the boss arena.<!

Ansbach's Attire (Altered).text: Quest reward: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Acquired from altering Ansbach's Attire. Which can be obtained after successfully assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Specimen Storehouse. Then defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The item can be recovered from Ansbach's body, which can be found seated against one of the walls close to the entrance of the boss arena.<!

Ansbach's Boots.text: Quest reward: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Available after successfully assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Specimen Storehouse. Then defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The item can be recovered from Ansbach's body, which can be found seated against one of the walls close to the entrance of the boss arena.<!

Ansbach's Longbow.text: Quest Reward / Guaranteed Drop: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep). Obtained from assisting either Ansbach or Leda in their confrontation at the first floor of Specimen Storehouse, after giving Ansbach the Secret Rite Scroll and either helping Leda invade Hornsent or ignoring that invasion entirely by challenging Messmer the Impaler. Must also be done before burning the Sealing Tree.

Ansbach's Manchettes.text: Quest reward: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Available after successfully assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Specimen Storehouse. Then defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The item can be recovered from Ansbach's body, which can be found seated against one of the walls close to the entrance of the boss arena.<!

Ant's Skull Plate.text: Loot: Nokstella, Eternal City. Can be found in a chest in a small room at the beginning of Nokstella, Eternal City. From the Nokstella, Eternal City Site of Grace, heading up the stairs just to the west of the Grace there is a room with a treasure chest to the south on the first landing that contains this Greatshield.

Antspur Rapier.text: Guaranteed drop: The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau). Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan, found just to the west of The Shaded Castle, together with a Guardian Golem.

Anvil Hammer.text: This weapon can be found and obtained at Ruined Forge Lava Intake.

Arbalest.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Found inside Stormveil Castle, near the explosive ballista shooting enemies. The quickest path to the Arbalest is through the Rampart Tower Site of Grace. Jump down and enter the room that has a fog wall that can only be broken with a Stonesword Key. After exiting that room, take a right and climb up the ladder on the wall, continue upon the path and climb up another ladder.

Archer Ashes.text: Found in Nokstella, Eternal City, behind a building.

Aristocrat Boots.text: Chance to drop from Wandering Noble enemies that wear it. The Sorcerer variant and the variant that carries the torch or the Noble's Slender Sword all wear them.

Aristocrat Coat.text: Chance to drop from Wandering Noble enemies that wear it. There are two immediately north of the Mistwood Ouksirts Sites of Grace, following a torch bearer.

Aristocrat Garb.text: Chance to drop from Wandering Nobles that wear it, such as the Sorcerer type. Two Sorcerer Wandering Nobles can be found to the east and north of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace.

Aristocrat Garb (Altered).text: Chance to drop from the Wandering Noble enemies that wear it.

Aristocrat Hat.text: Chance to drop from Wandering Noble enemies that wear it. There are two following a torch bearer immediately north of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace.

Aristocrat Headband.text: Chance to drop from the Sorcerer Wandering Noble enemies that wear it. Two can be found in the vicinity of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One to the east up the hill and one along the road to the north. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass while heading to both groups will allow the Tarnished to kill them uncontested.

Armor of Night.text: Loot: Bonny Gaol (Scadu Altus). Recovered from a body lying on a guillotine-table. Located on a somewhat hidden floor of the gaol. To reach this floor, the player must progress through the dungeon until they reach a jar-elevator that has already begun to move on its own.

Armor of Solitude.text: Guaranteed Drop: Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from defeating the Blackgaol Knight located in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

Armor of Solitude (Altered).text: Guaranteed Drop: Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from altering the Armor of Solitude. Which can be obtained from defeating the Blackgaol Knight located in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

Arrow.text: Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure. Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region. Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge. Abandoned Merchant in the Siofra River region.

Arrow's Reach Talisman.text: Loot: Stormgate (Limgrave). Found in a chest along the bridge over Stormgate's entrance. To access it, go to the southwest tower, kill the guards here, and then you can enter the area.

Arrow's Soaring Sting Talisman.text: Loot: Fog Rift Fort (Scadu Altus). Found in a chest at the top of the southernmost rampart tower of the Fog Rift Fort.

Arrow's Sting Talisman.text: Loot: Impassable Greatbridge (Caelid). Obtained from a chest, atop the wooden siege tower, next to the Impassable Greatbridge Site of Grace.

Arsenal Charm.text: Quest Item: Roundtable Hold. Received from Nepheli Loux in Roundtable Hold, after talking to her at Stormveil Castle and defeating Godrick the Grafted.

Arteria Leaf.text: Arteria Leaves do not respawn after being harvested. Can be farmed in late game, 30% drop chance from Mountaintop Trolls. The trolls in Consecrated Snowfield do not drop the item. It grows rarely in various locations across the Lands Between. In Liurnia, 3 can be found north-east of Gate Town North grace, between cliffs, surrounded by many normal and red Jellyfishes.

As You Wish.text: Quest Item: Liurnia of the Lakes. Received from Lightseeker Hyetta after giving her the first Shabriri Grape near the Lake-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace.

Ascetic's Ankle Guards.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 3% chance of dropping from a Curseblade.

Ascetic's Loincloth.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 3% chance of dropping from a Curseblade.

Ascetic's Wrist Guards.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 3% chance of dropping from a Curseblade.

Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Win.page: Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings
Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Win.text: Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings is acquired upon defeating the Black Knight Edredd boss at the Fort of Reprimand, located in the southernmost point of Scadu Altus.

Ash of War: Assassin's Gambit.text: Purchase: Volcano Manor. 1x Sold for 6,500 Runes by Recusant Bernahl in the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor. If Bernahl's questline has already been completed before purchasing this item from him, then it (along with the rest of his unsold stock) can still be acquired from his sword for the same price. The sword can be found in the same chair he used to sit in at Volcano Manor.

Ash of War: Barbaric Roar.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops from a Scarab found in the Ravine-Veiled Village in northern Liurnia, situated north of the eponymous Site of Grace.

Ash of War: Barrage.text: Guaranteed Drop: Mt. Gelmir. Drops from a Scarab north of the Seethewater River Site of Grace in Mt. Gelmir. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Barricade Shield.text: Guaranteed Drop: Weeping Peninsula. Drops from the Night's Cavalry found next to the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace (only appears at night). Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Beast's Roar.text: Quest Item: Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. Reward for giving 4 Deathroot to the Beast Clergyman, Gurranq. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado.page: Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado
Ash of War: Black Flame Tornado.text: Guaranteed Drop: Crumbling Farum Azula. Drops from the Godskin Duo bossfight. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Blind Spot.text: Guaranteed Loot: Gravesite Plain. Found pre-equipped on the Backhand Blade, which is found in a small stone building north-northeast of Scorched Ruins or east-southeast of Three-Path Cross Site of Grace. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Blinkbolt.text: Guaranteed Loot: Fog Rift Catacombs. From the Fog Rift Catacombs Site of Grace proceed to the third room with a dropping, spiked ceiling. Reach the end of the room, being mindful of the hole in the second safe cubbyhole, and use the altar to jump into a hole in the spiked ceiling after it has fallen down. Jumping out of the hole once the ceiling is at the top leads to a platform with a chest holding the Ash of War.

Ash of War: Blood Blade.text: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau. Drops from a Scarab found in a pond south of the entrance for Old Altus Tunnel and east of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill Site of Grace (the pond is not marked on the map). Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Blood Tax.text: Guaranteed Drop: Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum. Drops from a Scarab found in a small cave in the eastern stone walls by the lake of blood north of the Palace Approach Ledge-Road Site of Grace. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Bloodhound's Step.text: Guaranteed Drop: Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. Drops from a the Night's Cavalry patrolling the easternmost bridge of Dragobarrow, north of Lenne's Rise during the night. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Bloody Slash.text: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave. Drops from the Bloodcrazed Godrick Knight found at Fort Haight in east Limgrave. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Braggart's Roar.text: Guaranteed Drop/Quest Item: Liurnia of the Lakes / Capital Outskirts. Found pre-equipped on the Iron Ball Fist weapon, which can be looted off the body of Blackguard Big Boggart. Who can be found dead either at the hands of the player in either of his locations or Dung Eater after he is released from his cell while Boggart is present at Capital Outskirts.

Ash of War: Carian Grandeur.text: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. Found on a body in the Caria Manor. Requires dropping down multiple levels on the cliff to the south-east from the Royal Moongazing Grounds Site of Grace, where you'll come across a bunch of jar enemies and a Cracked Pot. The precise spot is on top of the standalone gate on the path towards the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace.

Ash of War: Carian Greatsword.text: Purchase: Stormveil Castle / Roundtable Hold. Sold by Sorcerer Rogier for 2,500 Runes. Should Rogier die before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Rogier's Bell Bearing. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Carian Retaliation.text: Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes. x1 Can be purchased for 3,000 Runes from Pidia in Caria Manor. Royal Knight Loretta must be defeated to reach Pidia's location within the Manor. Should Pidia be killed before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Pidia's Bell Bearing.

Ash of War: Carian Sovereignty.text: Guaranteed Loot: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus). Dropped by a Scarab hanging from the roof of a cave southwest of Cathedral of Manus Metyr. The cave is found by heading further west when starting to take the road to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, and then heading as far south as possible along the plateau, keeping an eye on the left/to the east towards the end.

Ash of War: Charge Forth.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops from a Teardrop Scarab in Academy Gate Town, Liurnia of the Lakes. Northeast of the Fallen Ruins of the Lake Site of Grace and west-northwest of the Academy Gate Town Site of Grace, hanging from the ceiling in an archway above a bunch of poison-spewing Land Squirt. A bow is advised to hit the scarab and make it fall.

Ash of War: Chilling Mist.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops from a Scarab found in the Ruins southeast of Renna's Rise behind Caria Manor. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Cragblade.text: Guaranteed Drop: Caelid. Drops from a Scarab found on a hill near the Sword Monument west of the Impassable Greatbridge Site of Grace which itself is just west of the bridge leading to Redmane Castle. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Determination.text: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave. Drops from a Scarab found on the stone bridge north of Agheel Lake. (A Night's Cavalry will patrol this bridge during night time). Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Divine Beast Frost Stomp.page: Ash of War: Divine Beast Frost Stomp
Ash of War: Divine Beast Frost Stomp.text: Trade the Remembrance of the Dancing Lion, dropped by the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method). Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Double Slash.text: Guaranteed Drop: Caelid. Drops from a Scarab found on top of a large root near the rooftops in the southwestern quarter of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Dryleaf Whirlwind.text: Guaranteed Loot: Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Found just northeast of the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East Site of Grace, at the top of a waterfall (the top of the waterfall is on the same level as the Site of Grace). Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Earthshaker.text: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau. Drops from an invisible Scarab found south the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace. The scarab moves slowly in a straight line and generates dirt particles around it, which are easier to detect at night.

Ash of War: Enchanted Shot.text: Guaranteed Drop: Nokron, Eternal City. Dropped by a Scarab next to a rock near the northern shore cliff of the Ancestral Woods, south-east of a nearby Hallowhorn Brazier. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Endure.text: Purchase: Stormhill / Volcano Manor. 1x Sold for 600 Runes from Bernahl at either the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill or the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor. Should Bernahl be killed before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Bernahl's Bell Bearing.

Ash of War: Eruption.text: Purchase: Volcano Manor. 1x Sold for 8,000 Runes by Recusant Bernahl in the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor. If Bernahl's questline has already been completed before purchasing this item from him, then it (along with the rest of his unsold stock) can still be acquired from his sword for the same price. The sword can be found in the same chair he used to sit in at Volcano Manor.

Ash of War: Flame Skewer.text: Guaranteed Drop: Church of the Crusade or Belurat, Tower Settlement. Dropped by Fire Knight Queelign during his second invasion. If the first invasion was in Belurat, he will invade again when entering the Church of the Crusade.

Ash of War: Flame Spear.text: Guaranteed Drop: Shadow Keep. Dropped by Fire Knight Kood, along with the Winged Serpent Helm. He's found by climbing the statue in the middle of the sixth floor, most easily reached by heading north from the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace and dropping down a floor, then turning around and walking up the central pillar before crossing a statue to a doorway in the eastern wall.

Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes.page: Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes
Ash of War: Flame of the Redmanes.text: Guaranteed Drop: Caelid. Drops from an invisible Scarab rolling around northeast of the Fort Gael North Site of Grace. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Flaming Strike.text: Guaranteed Drop: Caelid. Drops from a Scarab found in the graveyard outside of Redmane Castle's southern wall. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Ghostflame Call.text: Guaranteed drop: Charo's Hidden Grave. Dropped by a Death Rite Bird found in the body of water northwest of Charo's Hidden Grave Site of Grace. It only appears after approaching the big central grave. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Giant Hunt.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops from a Night's Cavalry patrolling the Bellum Highway at night. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Glintblade Phalanx.text: Quest Item: Roundtable Hold. Found pre-equipped on Rogier's Rapier +7, which can be given by Rogier himself if the player informs him on the defeat of Godrick or looted off his body at the end of his questline. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Glintstone Pebble.text: Purchase: Stormveil Castle / Roundtable Hold. Sold by Sorcerer Rogier for 1,500 Runes. Should Rogier die before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Rogier's Bell Bearing. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Golden Land.text: Guaranteed Drop: Deeproot Depths. Drops from a Scarab guarded by a group of Giant Ants south of the Erdtree Avatar near the Great Waterfall Crest Site of Grace. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Golden Parry.text: Guaranteed Drop: Capital Outskirts. Drops from a teleporting Scarab found on one of the northern balconies of the grand staircase up to western gate of Leyndell, Royal Capital. Follow the ramp northeast from the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace, until it turns southeast to see it. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Golden Slam.text: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau. Drops from a Scarab in Woodfolk Ruins. It can be found in the remains of a small building northeast of the Minor Erdtree. It is one of the buildings that are closer to the tree compared to the rest. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Golden Vow.text: Guaranteed Drop: Stormhill. Dropped by a specific horse-riding Godrick Knight found on a hill north-east of the Warmaster's Shack/just above and to the west of Deathtouched Catacombs. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Gravitas.text: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave. Drops from an Alabaster Lord on the beach southeast of the Stranded Graveyard. To reach it, go southeast from Seaside Ruins Site of Grace (just south of Dragon-Burnt Ruins) and look for a Spiritspring to the right of it. The Alabaster Lord will be patrolling from under an archway on the sands.

Ash of War: Ground Slam.text: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave. Drops from a Scarab found southwest of the Minor Erdtree in Mistwood. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker.text: Remembrance Item:. Trade the Remembrance of Hoarah Loux with Finger Reader Enia, which can be obtained by defeating Hoarah Loux, Warrior. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Hoarfrost Stomp.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Dropped by an invisible Scarab southeast of Caria Manor, in the pond above the ravine. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Holy Ground.text: |-|Retail=. Retail: Guaranteed Drop: Auriza Hero's Grave. Drops from the three teleporting Chariots found within the Hero's Grave of Capital Outskirts in Altus Plateau. The player has to navigate the side section that begins in the pit towards the end of the dungeon and trigger a Flame Pillar found at the end of said side section.

Ash of War: Ice Spear.text: Guaranteed Drops: Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops from a Night's Cavalry just north of the Liurnia Highway North Site of Grace, past the army of Puppets, and south of the Gate Town Bridge Site of Grace. Can also be reached by standing on the ground level far beneath the liurnian Highway Lookout Tower and heading north.

Ash of War: Igon's Drake Hunt.text: Guaranteed Loot: Jagged Peak. Found on Igon's body if he was summoned to help kill Bayle the Dread (Igon needs to have been summoned for the successful attempt, but need not have survived). WARNING: This Ash of War will not be gained if Bayle is killed without Igon having been summoned, or if Igon is killed by the player.

Ash of War: Lifesteal Fist.text: Guaranteed Drop: Caelid. Dropped by a Scarab northwest of the Astray from Caelid Highway North Site of Grace.

Ash of War: Lightning Slash.text: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau. Drops from a Scarab found in the middle of an enemy campsite, past the gate north of the Outer Wall Battleground Site of Grace, yet southeast of the Highway Lookout Tower.

Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Equipped to the Dryleaf Arts given by Dryleaf Dane after defeating him in combat at the northwest section Moorth Ruins (requires the May the Best Win gesture). WARNING: Dane will disappear from this spot after the Sealing Tree in Ancient Ruins of Rauh is burnt. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Parry.text: Purchase: Stormhill / Volcano Manor. x1 Can be purchased for 600 from Bernahl at either the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill or the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor. Should Bernahl be killed before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Bernahl's Bell Bearing.

Ash of War: Phantom Slash.text: Guaranteed Drop: Forbidden Lands. Drops from a Night's Cavalry patrolling the Forbidden Lands at night.

Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Piercing Throw.text: Guaranteed Drop: Scadu Altus. Dropped by an explosive Teardrop Scarab found by one of the pillars just east of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight.page: Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight
Ash of War: Poison Moth Flight.text: Guaranteed Drop: Caelid. Drops from the Night's Cavalry patrolling the southern highway in Caelid at night, northeast of the Cathedral of Dragon Communion. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Poisonous Mist.text: Guaranteed Drop: Swamp of Aeonia. Dropped by a teleporting Scarab In Caelid, found on a small island southeast of the Aeonia Swamp Shore Site of Grace. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Prayerful Strike.text: Guaranteed Drop: Capital Outskirts. Drops from an invisible Scarab found in the moat, east of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Prelate's Charge.text: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants. Drops from a Scarab hanging on a large, thorned stake found near a cliff south of the Guardians' Garrison. Ash of War: Quickstep.text: Purchase: Stormhill / Volcano Manor. 1x Sold for 800 Runes from Bernahl at either the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill or the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor. Should Bernahl be killed before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Bernahl's Bell Bearing.

Ash of War: Raging Beast.text: Guaranteed Drop: Scadu Altus. Dropped by a teleporting Teardrop Scarab found on a small hill east of the road leading north-northeast from the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and Bridge Leading to the Village Site of Grace. The Scarab is slightly visible from the road. The location is also southeast of the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and northeast of Bonny Village.

Ash of War: Rain of Arrows.page: Ash of War: Rain of Arrows
Ash of War: Rain of Arrows.text: Painting Treasure: Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. Acquire the "Redmane" Painting in the rubble near the main road in Sellia, Town of Sorcery and then go to the painting's depicted location on the edge of the Ancient Ruins below the cliffs south of Dragonbarrow's Minor Erdtree. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists.page: Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists
Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists.text: Quest Item: Liurnia of the Lakes. Automatically acquired after successfully assisting Yura in defeating Bloody Finger Ravenmount Assassin near the Main Academy Gate Site of Grace. Can be accessed by touching a red Summoning Sign near the edge of the broken bridge north of the grace. The sign will only appear after the player has talked to Yura after defeating Bloody Finger Nerijus.

Ash of War: Repeating Thrust.text: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave. Drops from a the Night's Cavalry patrolling the bridge north of Agheel Lake during the night. Southeast of Gatefront Ruins and east of Limgrave Tunnels. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Rolling Sparks.text: Guaranteed Drop: Scadu Altus. Dropped by a flying Scarab on top of a hill east of the northern parts of the Messmer Soldier encampment a bit south of Shadow Keep. Also directly south of the Shadow Keep Main Gate Site of Grace. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve.page: Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve
Ash of War: Royal Knight's Resolve.text: Loot: Volcano Manor. Located on a corpse in an isolated room of Volcano Manor, near the shortcut door back to the entrance of the manor (Stonesword Key is required). To reach it, the player must start from the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace and take the elevator up to the upper level of the manor (where the Man-Serpents with Magma Blades patrol).

Ash of War: Sacred Blade.text: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave. Drops from a Scarab found on a hill, past the pond northwest of the Third Church of Marika. The Scarab is fairly close to the bottom of the hill. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Sacred Order.text: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau. Drops from a Scarab found on the western shore of the lake north of the Abandoned Coffin Site of Grace. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Sacred Ring of Light.page: Ash of War: Sacred Ring of Light
Ash of War: Sacred Ring of Light.text: Guaranteed Drop: Swamp of Aeonia. Drops from a Scarab found on land, east of the Heart of Aeonia (where Commander O'Neil is fought). Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Savage Claws.text: Guaranteed Drop: Gravesite Plain. Equipped to the Beast Claw, dropped by Logur, Beast Claw in southern Gravesite Plain. Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain. Found in a small camp northwest of the Three-Path Cross Site of Grace and directly west of Run-Down Traveler's Rest. Head north along the cliff just west of the Site of Grace to find it more easily. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Scattershot Throw.text: Guaranteed Drop: Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Dropped by a hanging Teardrop Scarab found on a small pillar next to the foot of the large bridge south of Taylew's Ruined Forge. The pillar is one of the ones in the lower area of Rauh, on the eastern side of the road heading south from the Forge, and is just south of the bridge itself.

Ash of War: Seppuku.text: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants. Drops from an invisible Scarab found on the northern side of the Frozen Lake at the Mountaintops of the Giants. The First Church of Marika is at the opposite end of the lake.

Ash of War: Shared Order.text: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau. Drops from a flail-wielding Night's Cavalry patrolling the road south-west of the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace at night. Ash of War: Shield Bash.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops from a Scarab found on patch of land underneath the tall, stone bridge north of Raya Lucaria. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Shield Crash.text: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau. Drops from a disappearing Scarab found within Lux Ruins. On the northern side of the ruined church on top of the hill. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Shield Strike.text: Guaranteed Loot: Shadow Keep. Found pre-equipped to the Dueling Shield, which in turn is found by taking the stairs up on the other side of the statue at the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace then taking a left and going up the first stairs to the right. Continue on that path to another set of stairs to another floor up to find a balcony to the right.

Ash of War: Shriek of Sorrow.page: Ash of War: Shriek of Sorrow
Ash of War: Shriek of Sorrow.text: Guaranteed Loot: Belurat, Tower Settlement. Found behind a statue in the middle of a plaza in Belurat. Head out the north door from the Small Private Altar Site of Grace, then head down the stairs east past a Horned Warrior, and finally go north to reach the plaza with the statue. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Sky Shot.text: Guaranteed Drop: Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. Drops from a Scarab on the cliffs northwest of the Isolated Merchant's Shack in Dragonbarrow. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Spectral Lance.text: Guaranteed Drop: Academy of Raya Lucaria. Drops from a Scarab found on a descending, curved slope past the roped bridge in the graveyard after the Church of Cuckoo Site of Grace.

Ash of War: Spinning Gravity Thrust.text: Loot:. Comes equipped to the Sword Lance, one of the possible rewards when trading Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider with Enia at the Roundtable Hold.

Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Square Off.text: Guaranteed Drop: Siofra River. Drops from a Scarab north-northwest of the Worshippers' Woods Site of Grace near the edge of a cliff. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Stamp (Sweep).text: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave. Drops from an invisible Scarab rolling around on Limgrave's western shores, northwest of the First Step Site of Grace. Alternatively, Glintblade Phalanx and its skill counterpart will fire off when the scarab is close and in front of the character,.

Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: War Cry.text: Purchase: Stormhill / Volcano Manor. 1x Sold for 800 Runes from Bernahl at either the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill or the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor. Should Bernahl be killed before purchasing it from him, this item can still be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Bernahl's Bell Bearing.

Ash of War: Waves of Darkness.page: Ash of War: Waves of Darkness
Ash of War: Waves of Darkness.text: Remembrance Item:. Trade the Remembrance of the Naturalborn with Finger Reader Enia, which can be obtained by defeating Astel, Naturalborn of the the Void. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: White Shadow's Lure.page: Ash of War: White Shadow's Lure
Ash of War: White Shadow's Lure.text: Guaranteed Drop: Consecrated Snowfield. Dropped by an invisible Scarab at the Consecrated Snowfield. North-west of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace and south of Ordina, Liturgical Town, just north of the river. There will be a pack of wolves chasing it. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Wild Strikes.text: Guaranteed Drop: Stormhill. Drops from a Scarab found on the road approaching the Castleward Tunnel Site of Grace northwest of Stormhill Shack and on the approach towards Stormveil Castle. Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

Ash of War: Wing Stance.text: Loot: Castle Ensis. Found in a chest in a small tower found by taking the east exit from the Castle-Lord's Chamber Site of Grace and then jumping over the north railing and falling down to the cliffside below. Continuing south and falling down three times more leads to the tower, and climbing to the top of it leads to the chest.

Ash-of-War Scarab.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Found on a corpse on the edge of the broken bridge right behind a portal.

Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom.text: Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom is found in the upper sections of the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East site of grace, head across the bridge just to the west, then drop down to a slightly lower bridge section at the end.

Aspects of the Crucible: Breath.text: Aspects of the Crucible: Breath is acquired upon defeating Tanith's Knight, which can be fought after killing Tanith in Rykard's arena in the Volcano Manor, at the end of her questline.

Aspects of the Crucible: Horns.text: Aspects of the Crucible: Horns is acquired by defeating the Crucible Knight in Stormveil Castle, down the outer western rampart. From the Rampart Tower Site of Grace, head north to the walkway with the Warhawks, and drop down to the left at the guard tower. Continue dropping down until you reach a breakable cliff and fall through it to arrive on a cliffside with the Crucible Knight.

Aspects of the Crucible: Tail.text: Aspects of the Crucible: Tail is acquired by defeating the Crucible Knight trapped in the Stormhill Evergaol, located in Stormhill.

Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns.text: Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns is acquired by defeating the Golden Hippopotamus boss found just inside the main gate of Shadow Keep on Scadu Altus.

Assassin's Approach.text: Equipped:. Assassin's Approach is a starting spell for the Confessor origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for runes 2,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Assassin's Prayerbook.

Assassin's Cerulean Dagger.text: Guaranteed Drop: Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes). Obtained from defeating the secret Black Knife Assassin hidden behind an Illusory Wall in the Black Knife Catacombs.

Assassin's Crimson Dagger.text: Guaranteed Drop: Deathtouched Catacombs (Limgrave). Obtained by defeating the Black Knife Assassin at the end of the catacombs.

Assassin's Prayerbook.text: Found behind a second Imp Statue in Roundtable Hold. First door will require one Stonesword Key and the second will require two, so three keys in total are needed to obtain this item.

Astrologer Gloves.text: Starting gear for the Astrologer class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).

Astrologer Hood.text: Starting gear for the Astrologer class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).

Astrologer Robe.text: Starting gear for the Astrologer class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).

Astrologer Robe (Altered).text: Starting gear for the Astrologer class (unaltered). Purchased unaltered from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore). Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

Astrologer Trousers.text: Starting gear for the Astrologer class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).

Astrologer's Staff.text: Equipped:. Starting equipment for the Astrologer origin. Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes. 1x sold by the Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace for 800 runes Runes.

Avionette Soldier Ashes.text: Found at the bottom of the waterwheel near the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace in the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Axe Talisman.text: Loot: Mistwood Ruins (Limgrave). Obtained from a chest in the cellar of Mistwood Ruins, eastern Limgrave. A Runebear lies very close to the entrance.

Axe of Godfrey.text: Trade the Remembrance of Hoarah Loux, dropped by Hoarah Loux, Warrior, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Axe of Godrick.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Grafted, gained by defeating Godrick the Grafted, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Azula Beastman Ashes.text: Found in a room guarded by a Banished Knight, with another Banished Knight patrolling nearby, in the Dragon Temple before the Godskin Duo.

Azur's Glintstone Crown.text: Loot: Hermit Village Mt. Gelmir. Can be found on Azur's body along with the rest of the set, just north of the village, after Sellen's questline has been completed.

Azur's Glintstone Robe.text: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Azur on Mt. Gelmir to loot the Azur armor set.

Azur's Glintstone Staff.text: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. Found in a secluded room on the highest level of the Church of the Cuckoo, accessed via the rooftops of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. From the Debate Parlor site of grace, go outside to the left until you meet two Glintstone Sorcerers. Jump down on the stairs next to them. Continue forward until you can jump onto the rooftops.

Azur's Manchettes.text: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Azur on Mt. Gelmir to loot the Azur armor set.

Backhand Blade.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain. This weapon can be found beside a coffin in a gazebo in the Inquisitor section of Gravesite Plain, north-northeast of the Scorched Ruins Site of Grace. On acquisition it has Ash of War: Blind Spot pre-equipped, despite already having Blind Spot as its underlying base skill — thus allowing this Ash of War to be obtained.

Baldachin's Blessing.text: Quest Reward: Roundtable Hold. Automatically given by Fia, Deathbed Companion when held by her. Not available in other locations.

Balled Up.text: Received from non-hostile Rennala after initiating Rebirth or changing one's cosmetics through her services for the first time.

Ballista Bolt.text: Loot:. x5 are found at the top of Forest Lookout Tower along with the Hand Ballista. x5 Ballista Bolts can be found in Stormveil Castle, behind the main gate. Purchase:.

Bandit Boots.text: Origin:. Starting gear for the Bandit class. Purchase: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Purchased from Gatekeeper Gostoc for 1,000 Runes.

Bandit Garb.text: Origin:. Starting gear for the Bandit class. Purchase: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Purchased from Gatekeeper Gostoc for 1,500 Runes.

Bandit Manchettes.text: Origin:. Starting gear for the Bandit class. Purchase: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Purchased from Gatekeeper Gostoc for 1,000 Runes.

Bandit Mask.text: Origin:. Starting gear for the Bandit class. Purchase: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in northern Limgrave for 1,500 Runes.

Bandit's Curved Sword.text: Drop: Tombsward Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Church of the Plague (Caelid) / Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau) / Wyndham Ruins (Altus Plateau) / Capital Outskirts / Crumbling Farum Azula / Cerulean Coast / Charo's Hidden Grave.

Banished Knight Armor.text: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it, such as the one accompanied by two wolves in Castle Sol.

Banished Knight Armor (Altered).text: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it. Cannot be obtained by altering it yourself.

Banished Knight Engvall.text: Dropped by Grave Warden Duelist in Murkwater Catacombs. In versions prior to Patch 1.03 this Spirit Ash was unobtainable, as the boss would instead drop a Battle Hammer.

Banished Knight Gauntlets.text: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it.

Banished Knight Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it.

Banished Knight Helm.text: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it, such as the one near the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid.

Banished Knight Helm (Altered).text: Chance to drop from Banished Knight enemies that wear it. Cannot be obtained by altering it yourself.

Banished Knight Oleg.text: Guaranteed drop: Stranded Graveyard. Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit boss found at the end of Fringefolk Hero's Grave.

Banished Knight's Greatsword.text: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Cathedral of Dragon Communion (Caelid) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants). 4% drop chance from sword-and-shield Banished Knights. A lone sword-and-shield Banished Knight can be found outside of the southwestern exit from Cathedral of Dragon Communion, patrolling around the Cathedral.

Banished Knight's Halberd.text: +8 version dropped by Edgar. Dropped by Banished Knight enemies that wield it. One can be found near the Rampart Tower Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle.

Banished Knight's Shield.text: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Cathedral of Dragon Communion (Caelid) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Crumbling Farum Azula. 4% drop chance from shield-wielding Banished Knight. The Knight at the entrance of the Cathedral of Dragon Communion is an easy target when farming for this item. The Banished Knights in Fringefolk Hero's Grave do not drop this item.

Barbed Staff-Spear.text: Guaranteed Drop: Darklight Catacombs (Scadu Altus). Dropped by Jori, Elder Inquisitor.

Barrier of Gold.text: Guaranteed Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Drops from an invisible Scarab rolling back and forth on the path patrolled by a Crucible Tree Knight, north of the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace, past the elevator downwards. WARNING: If Maliketh, the Black Blade is defeated before this incantation is acquired it becomes unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

Bastard Sword.text: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula. One is sold for runes 3,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.

Bastard's Stars.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Naturalborn, dropped by Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate a remembrance (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Battle Axe.text: Starting Equipment:. 1 is part of the starting equipment of the Hero origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold. 1 is sold for runes 800 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold.

Battle Hammer.text: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital. 4% chance to drop from hammer-wielding Grave Warden Duelists when defeated. WARNING: These enemies will stop spawning once Maliketh is defeated.

Battlemage Hugues.text: Academy Crystal Cave. Caelid. Altus Plateau. Miquella's Haligtree.

Battlemage Legwraps.text: A specific Battlemage enemy in Altus Plateau drops the Battlemage Legwraps the first time they are defeated. They are located directly north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace, east of West Windmill Pasture, up on a hill behind the bridge where the player first meets Goldmask.

Battlemage Manchettes.text: A Battlemage enemy drops the entire set the first time you defeat him, directly north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace, Altus Plateau, up on a hill behind the bridge where you first meet Goldmask.

Battlemage Robe.text: A Battlemage enemy drops the entire set the first time you defeat him, directly north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace, Altus Plateau, up on a hill behind the bridge where you first meet Goldmask.

Bayle's Flame Lightning.text: Dragon Communion: Foot of the Jagged Peak. Trade the Heart of Bayle at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. Mutually exclusive with Bayle's Tyranny, as the Heart of Bayle and its reward cannot be duplicated.

Bayle's Tyranny.text: Dragon Communion: Foot of the Jagged Peak. Trade the Heart of Bayle at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. Mutually exclusive with Bayle's Flame Lightning, as the Heart of Bayle and its reward cannot be duplicated.

Beast Champion Armor.text: Altered version is received upon:. Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula. At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard. Needs to be altered at a Site of Grace or by Boc.

Beast Champion Armor (Altered).text: Received upon:. Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula. At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard. Can be altered at a Sites of Grace or given to Boc to Beast Champion Armor.

Beast Champion Gauntlets.text: Received upon:. Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula. At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard.

Beast Champion Greaves.text: Received upon:. Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula. At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard.

Beast Champion Helm.text: Received upon:. Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula. At the Warmaster's Shack if the player never joined Volcano Manor and killed Praetor Rykard.

Beast Crest Heater Shield.text: Loot: Stormhill (Limgrave). In a chest at a Godrick Knight's camp, northeast of Warmaster's Shack and southwest of Deathtouched Catacombs.

Beast Eye.text: Quest: received from Gurranq upon giving him the first Deathroot.

Beast Horn.text: Dropped by horned beasts in the Realm of Shadow.

Beast Liver.text: Dropped by herbivorous animals with an 8% droprate:. Sheep are found in large quantities between the Church of Pilgrimage and Witchbane Ruins, in the Weeping Peninsula. Deer are commonly found in upper and lower Siofra River, where they roam freely. Springhares are found throughout Limgrave.

Beast-Repellent Torch.text: Purchase: Dragonbarrow. 1x sold for runes 1,200 Runes by the Isolated Merchant at the Isolated Merchant's Shack in north-west Dragonbarrow, Caelid.

Beastclaw Greathammer.text: Awarded by the Beast Clergyman for feeding him 7 Deathroot.

Beastlure Pot.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [5], sold by Nomadic Merchant (Eastern Limgrave). Cookbook is sold by Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Nomadic Merchant's Bell Bearing 2.

Beastman's Cleaver.text: Drop: The Four Belfries (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Crumbling Farum Azula. 2% drop chance from Cleaver-wielding Beastmen. It can be found at the earliest by taking the "Crumbling Lands" Waygate at The Four Belfries, alongside a throwing knife-wielding one.

Beastman's Curved Sword.text: Drop: Crumbling Farum Azula. 2% drop chance from the Curved Sword-wielding Azula Beastmen enemies, also including the variants with red lightning and with shields. 7 of them can be found just east of/before the Crumbling Beast Grave Site of Grace, 2 in the first room and 5 in the second.

Beastman's Jar-Shield.text: Drop: Crumbling Farum Azula. 2% drop chance from the sword-and-shield and throwing knife variants of Beastman of Farum Azula. One sword-and-shield Beastman can be found just after the Crumbling Beast Grave Depths Site of Grace, along with a dog.

Beckon.text: Available from the start of the game.

Beloved Stardust.text: Received from: Count Ymir. Ymir will reward the Tarnished with the Beloved Stardust and the Ruins Map (2nd) after using the Hole-Laden Necklace at the first Finger Ruins and returning to him.

Bernahl's Bell Bearing.text: Dropped by Knight Bernahl if killed at Warmaster's Shack in Limgrave.

Bestial Constitution.text: Guaranteed Drop: Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. Bestial Constitution drops from a Scarab near the western cliffs on the southern side of Farum Greatbridge.

Bestial Sling.text: Quest Item: Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. Bestial Sling is rewarded from Gurranq after giving him the second Deathroot.

Bestial Vitality.text: Quest Item: Bestial Sanctum, Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. Bestial Vitality is rewarded from Gurranq after giving him the third Deathroot.

Bewitching Branch.text: Craftable (requires Fevor's Cookbook [3]). One of nine optional keepsakes during Character Creation, that rewards you five branches. 3 sold by the Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure. 5 sold by the Nomadic Merchant at Bellum Church.

Black Blade.text: Trade the Remembrance of the Black Blade, dropped by Maliketh, the Black Blade, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Black Bow.text: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau). Found on a corpse on the rooftops of lower Leyndell, Royal Capital. The rooftops be accessed by going down the stairs from the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace, jumping over a railing to the right and climbing a series of stairs to the northeast. The Black Bow can then be found on a corpse on a southwestern roof.

Black Dumpling.text: Chance to drop from the crawling First-Generation Albinaurics that wear it around the Prison Town of the Volcano Manor or in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Black Flame.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for 7,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Godskin Prayerbook.

Black Flame Blade.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for 6,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Godskin Prayerbook.

Black Flame Ritual.text: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants. Black Flame Ritual is received upon defeating the Spiritcaller Snail boss in Spiritcaller Cave on the Mountaintops of the Giants. This Snail summons the spirits of a Godskin Apostle and a Godskin Noble.

Black Flame's Protection.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Acquired from Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing after selecting the "about the secret medallion" dialogue option. This option will only appear after the player has obtained both the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right) and Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left).

Black Hood.text: Found inside a chest behind an illusory wall in Sage's Cave located in Altus Plateau.

Black Knife.text: Received upon defeating the Black Knife Assassin in front of Sainted Hero's Grave located in Altus Plateau.

Black Knife Armor.text: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield.

Black Knife Armor (Altered).text: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield. The chest piece can then be altered at a site of grace or with the help of Boc.

Black Knife Gauntlets.text: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield.

Black Knife Greaves.text: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield.

Black Knife Hood.text: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield.

Black Knife Tiche.text: Dropped by Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader in the Ringleader's Evergaol.

Black Knifeprint.text: Drop: Black Knife Assassin Mini-Boss in the Black Knife Catacombs, northeast of the Church of Vows in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Black Knight Armor.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 3% chance of dropping from a Black Knight.

Black Knight Gauntlets.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 3% chance of dropping from a Black Knight.

Black Knight Greaves.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 3% chance of dropping from a Black Knight.

Black Knight Helm.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 3% chance of dropping from a Black Knight.

Black Leather Shield.text: Purchase: Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes). One is sold for runes 2,500 Runes by Pidia.

Black Pyrefly.text: Several can be found in Scorched Ruins. Dropped by Shadow Commoners in Gravesite Plain.

Black Steel Greathammer.text: Guaranteed Drop: Church of Consolation (Gravesite Plain). A guaranteed drop from the Black Knight found at the Church of Consolation.

Black Steel Greatshield.text: Guaranteed Drop: Fog Rift Fort (Gravesite Plain). Dropped by Black Knight Garrew, who can be found patrolling the southern ramparts of the Fog Rift Fort.

Black Steel Twinblade.text: Guaranteed Drop: Scadu Altus. Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight at the top of the western hill camp off to the side of the encampment in front of the Shadow Keep, or northeast of Church of the Crusade.

Black Syrup.text: Given by Moore after the player has met Thiollier at the Pillar Path Cross.

Black Whetblade.text: Nokron, Eternal City (Ancestral Woods). Area: within Night's Sacred Ground, on a corpse next to the altar overlooking a Giant Silver Tear.

Black Wolf Mask.text: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. The Black Wolf Mask is found on a corpse upon the broken walls near Seluvis's Rise at Three Sisters, located in west Liurnia.

Black-Key Bolt.text: Random Drop:. Loot:. Roundtable Hold. 20x found behind the first Imp Statue alongside the Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow.

Blackflame Monk Amon.text: Dropped by the Stray Mimic Tear in Hidden Path to the Haligtree.

Blackflame Monk Armor.text: Chance to drop from Blackflame Monk enemies.

Blackflame Monk Gauntlets.text: 3% chance to drop from Blackflame Monk enemies.

Blackflame Monk Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Blackflame Monk enemies.

Blackflame Monk Hood.text: Chance to drop from Blackflame Monk enemies.

Blackguard's Bell Bearing.text: Dropped by Blackguard Big Boggart if and when he dies.

Blade of Calling.text: Loot: Forbidden Lands (Mountaintops of the Giants). Hidden within a room that you can only reach during the elevator ride that leads down to the Forbidden Lands grace, alongside the Official's Attire. Jump from the southwestern part of the elevator to a doorway just above the bottom floor.

Blade of Mercy.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain. Acquired from a chest at the top of Scorched Ruins.

Blades of Stone.text: Trade: Finger Reader Enia. Defeat Commander Gaius and trade his Remembrance with Finger Reader Enia.

Blaidd's Armor.text: Obtained from Blaidd with the rest of his armor set after killing him at Ranni's Rise at the end of Ranni the Witch's questline.

Blaidd's Armor (Altered).text: Received unaltered after killing Blaidd at Ranni's Rise at the end of Ranni the Witch's questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Blaidd's Gauntlets.text: Obtained from Blaidd with the rest of his armor set after killing him at Ranni's Rise at the end of Ranni the Witch's questline.

Blaidd's Greaves.text: Obtained from Blaidd with the rest of his armor set after killing him at Ranni's Rise at the end of Ranni the Witch's questline.

Blasphemous Blade.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Blasphemous, gained by defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Blasphemous Claw.text: Dropped by Bernahl in Crumbling Farum Azula if you completed his Volcano Manor questline and killed Praetor Rykard.

Blessed Blue Dew Talisman.text: Loot: Church of Benediction (Gravesite Plain). Can be obtained at the Church of Benediction in front of the statue of Marika.

Blessed Bone Shard.text: Blessed bone shards can only be harvested once per playthrough. Rarely dropped by Black Knights and Messmer Soldiers.

Blessed Dew Talisman.text: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Obtained from a chest, west of the Divine Bridge Site of Grace. This area can be reached via an elevator, in the courtyard outside the Fortified Manor, or by using the sending gate in the Tower of Return, in the Weeping Peninsula.

Blessing of Marika.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain. One can be found in a cave opening north-west behind the Church of Consolation. Guaranteed Drop/Loot: Scadu Altus. One can be found behind the Fort of Reprimand.

Blessing of the Erdtree.text: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Blessing of the Erdtree is located near the Queen's Bedchamber Site of Grace in Leyndell, on the Altus Plateau. WARNING: This item is no longer obtainable after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Blessing's Boon.text: Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes. Blessing's Boon is sold by Miriel, Pastor of Vows for runes 4,000 Runes. Should Miriel die before purchasing this Incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Miriel's Bell Bearing.

Blood-Tainted Excrement.text: Found in the land of the new dynasty.

Bloodboil Aromatic.text: Can be crafted after acquiring the Perfumer's Cookbook 2 from The Shaded Castle. Head north from the Shaded Castle Inner Gate Site of Grace and climb up a ladder, then enter the dark room and take the ladder inside to a small rooftop with a body on a chair holding the item.

Bloodbone Arrow.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [6], found in a room within Fort Haight.

Bloodbone Arrow (Fletched).text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [6], found in a room within Fort Haight.

Bloodbone Bolt.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [6], found in a room within Fort Haight.

Bloodboon.text: Trade: Finger Reader Enia. Trade the Remembrance of the Blood Lord, dropped by Mohg, Lord of Blood, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes.text: Defeat the Chief Bloodfiend at Rivermouth Cave.

Bloodfiend's Arm.text: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Blood Arm.text: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Blood Fork.text: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.

Bloodfiend's Cold Arm.text: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Cold Fork.text: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.

Bloodfiend's Fire Arm.text: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Fire Fork.text: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.

Bloodfiend's Flame Art Arm.text: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Flame Art Fork.text: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.

Bloodfiend's Fork.text: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.

Bloodfiend's Heavy Arm.text: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Heavy Fork.text: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.

Bloodfiend's Keen Arm.text: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Keen Fork.text: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.
