Bloodfiend's Lightning Arm.text: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Lightning Fork.text: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.

Bloodfiend's Magic Arm.text: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Magic Fork.text: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.

Bloodfiend's Occult Arm.text: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Occult Fork.text: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.

Bloodfiend's Poison Arm.text: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Poison Fork.text: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.

Bloodfiend's Quality Arm.text: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Quality Fork.text: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.

Bloodfiend's Sacred Arm.text: Drops from one of a group of Bloodfiends in Prospect Town, Gravesite Plain.

Bloodfiend's Sacred Fork.text: Random Drop: Prospect Town, Rivermouth Cave, Stone Coffin Fissure (Gravesite Plain), Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from Bloodfiends who carry this item.

Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear.text: Guaranteed Drop: Rauh Base (Land of the Tower). Acquired after defeating a Bloodfiend Hexer in the small pond west of Taylew’s Ruined Forge. Must be physically picked up after killing the enemy.

Bloodflame Blade.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Drops from a Scarab northwest of Rose Church.

Bloodflame Talons.text: Guaranteed Drop: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. Acquired from defeating Mohg, the Omen at the Cathedral of the Forsaken.

Bloodhound Claws.text: Received after defeating a Bloodhound Knight inside Volcano Manor.

Bloodhound Knight Armor.text: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the charriot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight set.

Bloodhound Knight Armor (Altered).text: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the charriot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight set.

Bloodhound Knight Floh.text: Defeat the Red Wolf of the Champion boss in Gelmir Hero's Grave.

Bloodhound Knight Gauntlets.text: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the charriot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight set.

Bloodhound Knight Greaves.text: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the charriot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight set.

Bloodhound Knight Helm.text: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the charriot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight Set.

Bloodhound's Fang.text: Guaranteed drop: Forlorn Hound Evergaol (Limgrave). Dropped by Bloodhound Knight Darriwil in the Forlorn Hound Evergaol in southern Limgrave. Blaidd the Half-Wolf will direct the Tarnished here as part of his questline, and will be available for summoning in the Evergaol before awakening Darriwil after doing so.

Bloodrose.text: Bloodrose can be harvested throughout the Lands Between. Fort Haight. Rose Church. Can be purchased in unlimited quantity from Imprisoned Merchant at the Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum for 800 Runes each.

Bloodsoaked Manchettes.text: Found on a corpse near the Underground Roadsite site of grace located in the sewers of Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Bloodsoaked Mask.text: Found on a corpse near the Underground Roadside site of grace located in the sewers of Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Bloodsoaked Tabard.text: Chance to drop from Mausoleum Foot Soldier enemies.

Bloodstained Dagger.text: 2% drop rate from Fierce Demi-Humans aka Demi-Human Chiefs. One can be found asleep next to the bridge west of the South of the Lookout Tower Site of Grace.

Bloodsucking Cracked Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Ruins of Unte (Scadu Altus). Defeat the Furnace Golem blocking the entrance to Ruins of Unte.

Bloody Finger.text: Obtained after giving Varré the Blood-Soaked Favor and joining Mohg's Bloody Fingers.

Bloody Helice.text: Guaranteed drop: Writheblood Ruins (Altus Plateau). Found in the cellar of the Writheblood Ruins, in a chest behind the Sanguine Noble boss. The Ruins are found just north of the Second Church of Marika.

Blue Cloth Cowl.text: Starting gear for the Warrior class. Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria).

Blue Cloth Vest.text: Starting gear for the Warrior class. Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria).

Blue Crest Heater Shield.text: Equipment:. One is part of the starting gear for the Confessor Origin. Purchase: Bellum Highway (Liurnia of the Lakes). One is sold for runes 1,500 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant (Northern Liurnia) just north of Bellum Church.

Blue Dancer Charm.text: Guranteed Drop: Highroad Cave (Limgrave). The Blue Dancer Charm is obtained by defeating the Guardian Golem in Highroad Cave.

Blue Festive Garb.text: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau.

Blue Festive Hood.text: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau.

Blue Silver Bracelets.text: 2% chance to drop from Albinauric Wolfback Archer enemies.

Blue Silver Mail Armor.text: Chance to drop from Albinauric Wolfback Archer enemies.

Blue Silver Mail Armor (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Albinauric Wolfback Archer enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Blue Silver Mail Hood.text: Chance to drop from Albinauric Archer enemies.

Blue Silver Mail Skirt.text: Chance to drop from Albinauric Wolfback Archer enemies.

Blue-Feathered Branchsword.text: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave. Obtained by defeating a Deathbird which appears east of Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill, near a ruin covered in Ruin Fragments and Sanctuary Stones at nighttime.

Blue-Gold Kite Shield.text: Purchase: Limgrave. One is sold for runes 1,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant in the Mistwoods, east Limgrave, and just northwest of Fort Haight.

Blue-White Wooden Shield.text: Loot: Academy Gate Town (Liurnia of the Lakes). Found behind a building in the far west of the town, just before and to the left of the bridge to the locked gate of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Boiled Crab.text: Purchase: Capital Outskirts (Altus Plateau). Sold by Blackguard Big Boggart for 600 Runes each, after he moves to Capital Outskirts. Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold using Blackguard's Bell Bearing, if he died, for the same price. Only tied to his Bell Bearing if at least one was bought from him before his death.

Boiled Prawn.text: Keepsake:. One of nine optional keepsakes from Character Creation, that rewards five pieces of prawn. Purchase: Blackguard Big Boggart. Sold by Blackguard Big Boggart for 600 Runes each.

Bolt.text: Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure. Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region. Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge. Abandoned Merchant in the Siofra River region.

Bolt of Gransax.text: Located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Exit the Erdtree Sanctuary and descend with the elevator, then jump over the street railing and down onto the building below. The spear is on top of its gigantic version. Warning: This item is not present in Leyndell, Ashen Capital. It must be obtained prior to defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Boltdrake Talisman.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle. Obtained from a corpse just before the bridge leading eastward, to the Divine Tower of Limgrave.

Bondstone.text: Found behind an illusory wall in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, close to the Rauh Ancient Ruins, East Site of Grace.

Bone Arrow.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [1], sold by Merchant Kalé.

Bone Arrow (Fletched).text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [1], sold by Merchant Kalé.

Bone Ballista Bolt.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [13], found north of Bellum Church.

Bone Bolt.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [1], sold by Merchant Kalé.

Bone Bow.text: Loot: Belurat, Tower Settlement (Land of the Tower). Found at the bottom floor of the tower with the spiraling staircase, located at the northwestern edge of the settlement. It is guarded by two giant Spider Scorpions.

Bone Dart.text: Recipe is included with the Crafting Kit.

Bone Great Arrow.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [13], found north of Bellum Church.

Bone Great Arrow (Fletched).text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [13], found north of Bellum Church.

Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing.text: Acquired by defeating the Bell Bearing Hunter at the Warmaster's Shack.

Bonny Butchering Knife.text: Loot: Bonny Village (Scadu Altus). This weapon can be found at Bonny Village below a small shed outside a house east of the Site of Grace, just west of the broken bridge in the central ravine.

Borealis's Mist.text: Dragon Communion: Caelid / Jagged Peak. Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid and the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 2 Dragon Hearts after defeating Borealis the Freezing Fog on the Mountaintops of the Giants.

Bow.text: Available from the start of the game.

Braided Arm Wraps.text: Guaranteed Drop from the vengeful Hornsent at either of the following locations:. Shadow Keep - If the player chooses to assist Leda in vanquishing him. This encounter can become available available after suggesting the Hornsent's potential threat to Miquella's cause to Leda near the Highroad Cross site of grace.

Braided Cord Robe.text: Guaranteed Drop from the vengeful Hornsent at either of the following locations:. Shadow Keep - If the player chooses to assist Leda in vanquishing him. This encounter can become available available after suggesting the Hornsent's potential threat to Miquella's cause to Leda near the Highroad Cross site of grace.

Brass Shield.text: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Deeproot Depths / Altus Plateau / Mt. Gelmir / Miquella's Haligtree. 2% drop chance from any Godrick Soldier, Raya Lucaria Soldier, Radahn Soldier, Mausoleum Soldier, Leyndell Soldier, or Haligtree Soldier that happens to be wielding it. Four of the Godrick Soldiers at Gatefront Ruins carry the shield.

Brave's Bracer.text: This item could not be obtained through normal means.

Brave's Cord Circlet.text: This item could not be obtained through normal means.

Brave's Leather Helm.text: This item could not be obtained through normal means.

Brave's Legwraps.text: This item could not be obtained through normal means.

Bravo!.text: Quest Item: Limgrave. Once the player has defeated their first Demigod and obtained their first Great Rune, a message will appear by The First Step Site of Grace, where White Mask Varré once stood. Interacting with this message automatically gives you the gesture.

Briar Armor.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 6,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar.

Briar Armor (Altered).text: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 6,000 runes once Elemer of the Briar has been defeated. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Briar Gauntlets.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar.

Briar Greatshield.text: Guaranteed drop: The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau). Dropped by Elemer of the Briar at the top of Shaded Castle.

Briar Greaves.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar.

Briar Helm.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for 4,000 runes after defeating Elemer of the Briar at Shaded Castle.

Briars of Punishment.text: Loot: Mountaintops of the Giants. Located by a dead tree on the western cliffs of the southern end of the giant stone bridge surrounded by Guilty enemies.

Briars of Sin.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Obtained by defeating a lone Guilty located southwest of the Fire Monk Campsite, near the Church of Vows in Liurnia. This Sorcerer is near a group of Fire Slugs to the north of the Artist's Shack (Liurnia).

Brick Hammer.text: Found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle, near the area where you get trapped in a room with a Banished Knight. It is accessed by jumping across a gap.

Broadsword.text: Starting equipment for the Confessor class. Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.

Broken Gold Mask.text: Obtained after defeating The Noble Broken Mask invader in Leyndell, Royal Capital. He appears after using Law of Regression on the Radagon statue.

Broken Rune.text: Found throughout the Realm of Shadow.

Buckler.text: Equipped:. One is part of the starting gear for the Bandit class. Purchase: Stormveil Castle. One is sold for runes 1,500 Runes by Gatekeeper Gostoc.

Budding Cave Moss.text: Budding Cave Moss is found in caves throughout the Lands Between. It will respawn after being harvested. Lakeside Crystal Cave. Perfumer's Grotto. Dropped by Perfumers (x5, 8%) and Depraved Perfumers (x5, 15%).

Bull-Goat Armor.text: Obtained after killing Great Horned Tragoth in Magma Wyrm Makar's room at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, for Patches' assassination mission.

Bull-Goat Gauntlets.text: Obtained after killing Great Horned Tragoth in Magma Wyrm Makar's room at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, for Patches' assassination mission.

Bull-Goat Greaves.text: Obtained after killing Great Horned Tragoth in Magma Wyrm Makar's room at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, for Patches' assassination mission.

Bull-Goat Helm.text: Obtained after killing Great Horned Tragoth in Magma Wyrm Makar's room at Ruin-Strewn Precipice, for Patches' assassination mission.

Bull-Goat's Talisman.text: Obtained from a corpse, in Dragonbarrow Cave, in northern Greyoll's Dragonbarrow, below the Minor Erdtree. Head left after entering the Runebear's room to find it.

Burn, O Flame!.text: Trade the Remembrance of the Fire Giant, gained by defeating the Fire Giant, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Burred Bolt.text: Random Drop:. Loot:. Can be purchased from the Imprisoned Merchant of Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum for 200 Runes.

Butchering Knife.text: Guaranteed drop: Corpse-Stench Shack (Mt. Gelmir). Dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater when she invades outside of the Corpse-Stench Shack. This weapon is initially infused with the Sacred Affinity, in spite of having no Ash of War equipped.

By My Sword.text: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Found in the bedroom of Fortified Manor in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Caestus.text: Purchase: Gatekeeper Gostoc. Sold by Gatekeeper Gostoc for 800 Runes.

Calm Down!.text: Quest Item: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Mt. Gelmir. This gesture has multiple opportunities of acquisition:. Confronting Patches at Murkwater Cave after getting ensnared in his teleporter trap chest. Confronting Patches by the Scenic Isle Site of Grace, after following his suggestion and getting killed by the Abductor Virgin at the bottom of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Candletree Wooden Shield.text: Loot: Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau). Found inside one of 4 chests found behind an illusory wall halfway through the cave. The illusory wall is on the left, flanked by two braziers, after dropping down a ledge just after passing the first waterfall.

Cane Sword.text: Found next to the stairs just south of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Can still be found in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

Cannon of Haima.text: Converted Fringe Tower, north-east Liurnia of the Lakes, not to be mistaken with the Converted Tower in the south-west. You will need to use the Erudition gesture given by Thops in front of the statue of Marika. This will reveal a hidden ladder to the top of the tower with a treasure chest that contains the spell, alongside Gavel of Haima.

Carian Filigreed Crest.text: Purchase: Smithing Master Iji (Liurnia of the Lakes). Becomes available for 5000 after meeting either of the following two criterias:. Exhausting Blaidd the Half-Wolf's dialogue at the Weeping Evergaol after defeating Bloodhound Knight Darriwil, then selecting the "Blaidd sent me" dialogue option when talking to Iji. To get Blaidd to appear at the Evergaol, the player must complete the following steps:.

Carian Glintblade Staff.text: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. Located on top of the Highway Lookout Tower in southeastern Liurnia of the Lakes, northeast of Laskyar Ruins and south of an Artist's Shack.

Carian Glintstone Staff.text: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. Located in the regular version of Carian Study Hall, on a small pedestal just before the elevator to the second floor.

Carian Greatsword.text: Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 10,000 Runes by Miriel, Pastor of Vows. Should Miriel die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Miriel's Bell Bearing.

Carian Inverted Statue.text: Quest: Ranni the Witch, after she's given the Fingerslayer Blade.

Carian Knight Armor.text: Can be found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria.

Carian Knight Armor (Altered).text: Can be found unaltered in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Carian Knight Gauntlets.text: Can be found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria.

Carian Knight Greaves.text: Can be found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria.

Carian Knight Helm.text: Can be found in front of a tombstone near the rotating lift inside Raya Lucaria.

Carian Knight's Shield.text: Guaranteed drop: Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes). Dropped by Moongrum, Carian Knight. As the shield is automatically awarded after his death, an easy way to earn the shield is to rush past Moongrum to the elevator and take it up so that he falls down the hole underneath it.

Carian Knight's Sword.text: Held by a Carriage located in the northwest region of Liurnia of the Lakes, between the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore and The Four Belfries Sites of Grace.

Carian Phalanx.text: Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 12,000 Runes by Preceptor Seluvis. Should Seluvis die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Seluvis's Bell Bearing.

Carian Piercer.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Acquired from felling a Scarab in Caria Manor, located in the lowermost courtyard full of fingercreepers northeast of Main Caria Manor Gate, near a crystal formation.

Carian Regal Scepter.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen, gained by defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Carian Retaliation.text: Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 9,000 Runes by Preceptor Seluvis. Should Seluvis die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Seluvis's Bell Bearing.

Carian Slicer.text: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 1,500 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Royal House Scroll.

Carian Sorcery Sword.text: Loot: Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain). This item can be found in a chest in northern Castle Ensis after dropping down from Scadu Altus. Starting from the Highroad Cross Site of Grace, head southwest into the river and jump of the southern edge of the western riverbank to get to a freestanding castle-section with the chest on its top.

Carian Thrusting Shield.text: Loot: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep). Located west of the Storehouse, Back Section Site of Grace, at the end of an open room guarded by a Fire Knight and a couple of Shadow Undead.

Castle Cross Message.text: Loot: Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain). Located near the Castle Cross, by the lowered gate in the middle of Castle Ensis. Near the Castle Ensis Checkpoint site of grace.

Casual Greeting.text: Received from Great Horned Tragoth when summoning him as a Co-operator against Magma Wyrm Makar, Draconic Tree Sentinel or Starscourge Radahn.

Catch Flame.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for runes 600 Runes by Brother Corhyn. Should Corhyn die before purchasing this incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing. Starting equipment for the Prophet Origin.

Caterpillar Mask.text: Guaranteed Drop from the vengeful Hornsent at either of the following locations:. Shadow Keep - If the player chooses to assist Leda in vanquishing him. This encounter can become available available after suggesting the Hornsent's potential threat to Miquella's cause to Leda near the Highroad Cross site of grace.

Cave Moss.text: Harvestable Cave Moss is found in caves throughout the Lands Between:. Groveside Cave. Stillwater Cave. Abandoned Cave.

Celebrant's Cleaver.text: Drop: Dominula, Windmill Village (Altus Plateau). 0.5% drop chance from cleaver-wielding Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the north of Altus Plateau.

Celebrant's Rib-Rake.text: 0.5% drop rate from the Dominula Dancers wielding them in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the north of Altus Plateau.

Celebrant's Sickle.text: Drop: Dominula, Windmill Village (Altus Plateau). 0.5% drop chance from the blue Dominula Dancers in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in the north of Altus Plateau. Two of them are found a bit east of the Windmill Village Site of Grace.

Celebrant's Skull.text: From the Windmill Village site of grace, head northeast along a narrow ledge just below the village. Found on a corpse at the end of the path.

Celestial Dew.text: NOTE: only 10x Celestial Dew can be acquired per playthrough. Liurnia of the Lakes (Main Academy Gate). Behind the southern gate of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, guarded by a Bloodhound Knight. Liurnia of the Lakes (Caria Manor):.

Cerulean Amber Medallion.text: Drop: Lakeside Crystal Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes). Obtained by defeating the Bloodhound Knight in Lakeside Crystal Cave.

Cerulean Crystal Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Minor Erdtree (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Minor Erdtree (Mountaintops of the Giants). Left version: dropped by the Erdtree Avatar at the Minor Erdtree in southwestern Liurnia of the Lakes, along with one of the Ruptured Crystal Tears. Right version: dropped by the Erdtree Avatar at the Minor Erdtree in eastern Mountaintops of the Giants, along with the Crimson Bubbletear.

Cerulean Hidden Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir) (Mt. Gelmir). Dropped by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit at the Minor Erdtree south of the Road of Iniquity Site of Grace, along with the Leaden Hardtear.

Cerulean Seed Talisman.text: Loot: Carian Study Hall (Liurnia of the Lakes). Obtained from a corpse in un-flipped version of the Carian Study Hall, located in the eastern region of Liurnia of the Lakes. The corpse can be found on the upper-most level of rafters in the tower, which you can climb to with ladders.

Cerulean Tear Scarab.text: Loot: Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Found in the northeastern section of the town, on a corpse on the rooftops.

Cerulean-Sapping Cracked Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Scadu Altus. Defeat the Furnace Golem in eastern Scadu Altus, northwest of the Bridge Leading to Village Site of Grace. It's legs are armored, requiring Hefty Fire Pots or Hefty Furnace Pots to be thrown into its head-basket to damage it.

Chain-Draped Tabard.text: Chance to drop from Godrick Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

Chainlink Flail.text: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau. 4% drop chance from the Mad Pumpkin Head enemies that wield it. The earliest spot to farm is just outside of Fort Haight, as a Mad Pumpkin Head (and several Godrick Soldiers) guard the entrance to the fort as long as the Blood-Obsessed Godrick Knight atop it hasn't been killed.

Champion Bracers.text: Starting gear for the Hero class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid).

Champion Gaiters.text: Starting gear for the Hero class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid).

Champion Headband.text: Starting gear for the Hero class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid).

Champion Pauldron.text: Starting gear for the Hero class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid).

Cherishing Fingers.text: Loot: Scadu Altus. Found in the small graveyard attached to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr after completing Count Ymir's questline.

Chilling Perfume Bottle.text: Loot: Lamenter's Gaol (Charo's Hidden Grave). Located in a room guarded by a restless Jar Innards enemy. The room can be reached after opening the first locked door of the gaol using the Upper Gaol Key, descending down the first ladder and arriving into a room with the frozen floor, where a Jar Innards enemy will come running out of a door to the right. This item is in that room.

Chrysalids' Memento.text: Limgrave (Rampart Tower). Area: within the room where the Grafted Scion is found, in the courtyard to the left before the elevator that leads back to the Site of Grace.

Cinquedea.text: Loot: Bestial Sanctum (Caelid). On a body very far down at the cliff west of the Bestial Sanctum, on the same level as the Dragoncrest Shield Talisman. The Tarnished must carefully descend the cliffs by jumping onto roots, the domes of the pillars, and outcrops on the walls and pillars. Rainbow Stones can be used to help navigate safe descent.

Cipher Pata.text: Loot: Roundtable Hold. Jump over the balcony rail in the Roundtable Hold, it will be in the rooms to the left.

Circlet of Light.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Automatically acquired from touching the memory of Miquella after having defeated Promised Consort Radahn. The memory can be found on the floor in the middle of the arena.

Clarifying Boluses.text: Craftable after obtaining the Frenzied's Cookbook[1] from a charred corpse in the Frenzied Flame Village in northeastern Liurnia.

Clarifying Cured Meat.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [23], found in the Consecrated Snowfield, north of the Consecrated Snowfield grace.

Clarifying Horn Charm.text: Obtained from a corpse, lying on the stairs in northern Siofra River, near the Below the Well Sites of Grace (this is the entrance area to the region if using the Deep Siofra Well in Caelid).

Clarifying White Cured Meat.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [23], found in the Consecrated Snowfield, north of the Consecrated Snowfield grace.

Claw Talisman.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle. Obtained from a corpse in Stormveil Castle, on top of a watchtower. From Rampart Tower Site of Grace, head through the southern door, hang a right, and climb the spiral staircase. Enter the outer hallway, and circle around to the exit that leads to a rooftop.

Clawmark Seal.text: Quest Reward: Dragonbarrow (Caelid). Received after feeding 1 Deathroot to Gurranq, Beast Clergyman inside the Bestial Sanctum.

Claws of Night.text: Guaranteed Drop: Finger Ruins of Miyr (Scadu Altus). Obtained from defeating the invading Swordhand of Night Anna on the approach to the hanging bell of the Finger Ruins.

Clayman Ashes.text: Found in the northern Uhl Palace Ruins on a corpse at the top of the waterfall.

Clayman's Harpoon.text: Drop: Siofra River / Ainsel River. The slow-moving Claymen enemies have a 2% chance to drop this item.

Claymore.text: Loot: Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula). Found in a chest in the castle. From the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace and taking the elevator up, it's found in a building on the right, reached by climbing up the pile of bodies in the castle's courtyard.

Cleanrot Armor.text: Chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

Cleanrot Armor (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Cleanrot Knight enemies. It can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Cleanrot Gauntlets.text: Chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

Cleanrot Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

Cleanrot Helm.text: Chance to drop from Cleanrot Knight enemies.

Cleanrot Helm (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Cleanrot Knight enemies. It can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Cleanrot Knight Finlay.text: In a treasure chest at Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, guarded by a Cleanrot Knight. Located north of the Prayer Room grace on a rooftop that you need to jump down to from a rafter.

Cleanrot Knight's Sword.text: Drop: Caelid / The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield) / Miquella's Haligtree. All Cleanrot Knights have a 4% drop chance for this weapon. The Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid is quite notably littered with Cleanrot Knights who will rise up when approached.

Cleanrot Spear.text: Cleanrot Knights have a chance to drop this item.

Clinging Bone.text: Guaranteed Drop: Roundtable Hold. Received upon defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains.

Cloth Garb.text: Found in a chest inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

Cloth Trousers.text: Found in a chest inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

Club.text: Starting:. Starting gear for the Wretch origin. Purchase: Limgrave. Bought for 600 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.

Coded Sword.text: The Coded Sword can be found on the upper floor of the Fortified Manor in Leyndell, Royal Capital, in the room that mirrors the one that the Two Fingers of the Roundtable Hold can be found it. This weapon cannot be acquired once the Tarnished has defeated Maliketh.

Coil Shield.text: Loot: Volcano Cave (Mt. Gelmir). From the cave's Site of Grace, take the right path when the cave splits, then fall down one drop and then turn around rather than falling down further. Following this path leads to a smaller section with the shield and 3 Arteria Leaves.

Coldbone Arrow.text: Recipe is included with Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [7], sold by Pidia, Carian Servant.

Coldbone Arrow (Fletched).text: Recipe is included with Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [7].

Collapsing Stars.text: Loot: War-Dead Catacombs. Acquired from a treasure chest in the middle of the scarlet swamp water in the lower levels of the large hall where all the phantoms are fighting each other.

Comet.text: Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria. Found on a corpse behind an Illusory Wall near the entrance to the Debate Parlor.

Comet Azur.text: Quest Item: Hermit Village. Comet Azur is obtained by interacting with Primeval Sorcerer Azur, found on the cliffs southeast of the Hermit Village in Mt. Gelmir.

Commander's Standard.text: Received upon defeating Commander O'Neil in Aeonia Swamp located in Caelid.

Common Soldier Cloth Armor.text: Random Drop: Gravesite Plain (North), Castle Ensis, Scadu Altus & Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from a Common Soldier.

Common Soldier Gauntlets.text: Random Drop: Gravesite Plain (North), Castle Ensis, Scadu Altus & Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from a Common Soldier.

Common Soldier Greaves.text: Random Drop: Gravesite Plain (North), Castle Ensis, Scadu Altus & Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from a Common Soldier.

Common Soldier Helm.text: Random Drop: Gravesite Plain (North), Castle Ensis, Scadu Altus & Rauh Base. 3% chance of dropping from a Common Soldier.

Commoner's Garb.text: Chance to drop for Commoner enemies.

Commoner's Garb (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered for Commoner enemies. Can be altered at a Site of Grace or by Boc.

Commoner's Headband.text: Found on top of the head of a serpent statue in Volcano Manor, after the Temple of Eiglay grace.

Commoner's Headband (Altered).text: Chance to drop from Commoner enemies. Cannot be unaltered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Commoner's Shoes.text: Chance to drop for Commoner enemies.

Commoner's Simple Garb.text: Found on a corpse right next to the Gateside Chamber grace inside Stormveil Castle.

Commoner's Simple Garb (Altered).text: Unaltered version can be found on a corpse right next to the Gateside Chamber grace inside Stormveil Castle. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Companion Jar.text: Quest: Jar-Bairn. Obtained from Jar-Bairn in Jarburg, after completing his questline, by giving him Alexander's Innards. Exhaust his dialogue and reset the game, the talisman will be here he was once seated.

Composite Bow.text: Purchase: Bellum Church (Liurnia of the Lakes). 1 is sold for runes 3500 runes by a Nomadic Merchant just down an incline north of Bellum Church, located in northern Liurnia of the Lakes.

Concealing Veil.text: Obtained by defeating the Black Knife Assassin in Sage's Cave in western Altus Plateau.

Confessor Armor.text: Starting gear for the Confessor class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).

Confessor Armor (Altered).text: Starting gear for the Confessor class (unaltered). Purchased unaltered from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir). Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

Confessor Boots.text: Starting gear for the Confessor class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).

Confessor Gloves.text: Starting gear for the Confessor class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).

Confessor Hood.text: Starting gear for the Confessor class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).

Confessor Hood (Altered).text: Starting gear for the Confessor class. (unaltered). Purchased unaltered from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir). Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

Congealed Putrescence.text: Found on the ground in the Stone Coffin Fissure or dropped by Putrescence Slimes.

Consort's Trousers.text: Can be bought from the Hermit Merchant in Altus Plateau. Dropped upon ending Tanith's questline.

Conspectus Scroll.text: Guaranteed Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria. Can be found within a chest in a room to the left of the hallway after the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace in the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Corhyn's Robe.text: Dropped by Brother Corhyn if killed. If Corhyn's questline was not completed, it will appear at the last spot he was seen after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade. If Corhyn was offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness it will be in his location in the Mountaintops of the Giants. If Corhyn was not offered the Tonic of Forgetfulness, it will appear in Leyndell, Ashen Capital after speaking to him and reloading the area.

Cracked Pot.text: 3 are selectable as a Keepsake during Character Creation; choosing this also removes 2 Cracked Pots from Auriza Side Tomb and the one from Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid)'s inventory. 6 (5 if Cracked Pot Keepsake was selected) are sold by various merchants:. Kalé at Church of Elleh (x3) for 300 runes each.

Crafting Kit.text: Purchase: Church of Elleh (Limgrave). Can be bought for 300 from Merchant Kalé. If the player defeats two Shardbearers before acquiring this item from Kalé, then it will move to the inventory of the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold, where its price will be increased to 500 instead.

Cranial Vessel Candlestand.text: Mountaintops of the Giants, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, behind the second imp statue in the dungeon.

Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow.text: Loot: Roundtable Hold. Found behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open inside the Roundtable Hold. This door is reached by going down a flight of stairs in the eastern wing, past Smithing Master Hewg, and then turning around. Found alongside 20 Black-Key Bolts.

Crepus's Vial.text: Obtained by killing Rileigh the Idle, in Altus Plateau, after invading their world to complete the second Volcano Manor assassination.

Crescent Moon Axe.text: Drop: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants). 4% drop chance from the large Exile Soldiers that wield them. 2 can be found in the Stonesword Key-locked cellar with the Iron Whetblade in Stormveil Castle.

Crimson Amber Medallion.text: Keepsake:. May be chosen as a Keepsake when creating a new character. Purchase: Weeping Peninsula (Limgrave). Purchased for 1,500 Runes from the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.

Crimson Bubbletear.text: Guaranteed drop: Minor Erdtree (Mountaintops of the Giants). Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Mountaintops of the Giants, south-west of the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook Site of Grace, along with the right half of the Cerulean Crystal Tear.

Crimson Crystal Tear.text: Loot: Third Church of Marika (Limgrave) / Minor Erdtree (Capital Outskirts)). Left version: in the Third Church of Marika, found in a stone bowl together with the Flask of Wondrous Physick. Right version: Found in a basin under a Minor Erdtree in the Capital Outskirts in Altus Plateau, just north of Leyndell, Royal Capital. Found alongside the Twiggy Cracked Tear and guarded by an Omen and some Commoners.

Crimson Hood.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Found on top of a corpse pile inside Stormveil Castle after completing Roderika's questline. It's on the same corpse pile that the Chrysalids' Memento was initially found on.

Crimson Seed Talisman.text: Loot: Sainted Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau). Obtained from a corpse that behind a semi-transparent fog wall, near the beginning of the dungeon, which can be unlocked by inserting one Stonesword Key into the adjacent imp statue.

Crimson Tear Scarab.text: Loot: Volcano Manor. Found after the Temple of Eiglay. To reach it, jump off the bridge where you first meet a Man-Serpent. It can be seen on a corpse on a ledge.

Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Defeat the Furnace Golem in Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

Crimsonburst Crystal Tear.text: Guaranteed Drop: Minor Erdtree (Weeping Peninsula) (Weeping Peninsula). Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar at the Minor Erdtree in Weeping Peninsula, along with the Opaline Bubbletear.

Crimsonburst Dried Tear.text: Guaranteed Drop: Scadu Altus. Dropped by the Furnace Golem in northern Scadu Altus, found in the middle of the Messmer Soldier encampment just outside of Shadow Keep.

Crimsonspill Crystal Tear.text: Guaranteed Drop: Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau). Dropped by the Wormface miniboss along with the Speckled Hardtear, at the Minor Erdtree in central Altus Plateau west of the Woodfolk Ruins.

Crimsonwhorl Bubbletear.text: Loot: Mountaintops of the Giants. Found on a cliffs' edge in the Mountaintops, at the end of a path that starts to the northeast of the Foot of the Forge Site of Grace and ends just east of the Giants' Gravepost Site of Grace (though it is not reachable from that Site of Grace). Fingercreepers can be found along the path, though they are a minor obstacle to reaching the Bubbletear.

Cross-Naginata.text: Looted from a body in the Gael Tunnel.

Crossed Legs.text: Loot: Stormhill. Located on a corpse sitting on top of some fallen ruins by the cliffs south of Stormhill Shack.

Crossed-Tree Towershield.text: Purchase: Altus Plateau. Purchased from the Nomadic Merchant near the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace in central Altus Plateau for 3800 Runes. This location is southeast of the Altus Plateau Minor Erdtree.

Crucible Axe Armor.text: Received after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau.

Crucible Axe Armor (Altered).text: Received as Crucible Axe Armor after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau. Crucible Axe Armor be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Crucible Axe Helm.text: Received after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau.

Crucible Feather Talisman.text: Obtained from a corpse in Auriza Hero's Grave in the Leyndell, Royal Capital region. Make your way to the area where two chariots ride side-by-side, up and down a slope. At the bottom of this slope is a corpse, hanging off of a ledge above a pit. Drop into the pit from where this corpse lies to land on a beam, and continue dropping down into this pit, until landing on the top of a thin stone archway.

Crucible Gauntlets.text: Received after beating Crucible Knight Duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave located in Altus Plateau. Found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in Deeproot Depths.

Crucible Greaves.text: Received after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau. Found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in Deeproot Depths.

Crucible Hornshield.text: Guaranteed drop: Siofra Aqueduct. The Crucible Hornshield is received upon defeating the Crucible Axe Knight at the Siofra Aqueduct, near the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs Site of Grace.

Crucible Knot Talisman.text: Guaranteed Drop: Village of the Albinaurics (Liurnia of the Lakes). Obtained by killing the Omenkiller boss in Village of the Albinaurics, in southern Liurnia of the Lakes.

Crucible Scale Talisman.text: Loot: Leyndell Catacombs (Leyndell, Royal Capital). Obtained from a corpse in Leyndell Catacombs. The corpse is guarded by an Omen, which can be reached by lowering a fire-breathing pillar, and riding it back upward to reach the upper-level of the room.

Crucible Tree Armor.text: Found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in Deeproot Depths.

Crucible Tree Armor (Altered).text: Received as Crucible Tree Armor after looting a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in the Deeproot Depths. Crucible Tree Armor be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Crucible Tree Helm.text: The Crucible Tree Helm is found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in the Deeproot Depths.

Crusade Insignia.text: Guaranteed Drop from vanquishing the invading Fire Knight Queelign for the first time at either of the following locations:. Belurat, Tower Settlement - Invades in the spiraltree courtyard northeast of the Small Private Altar site of grace. Church of the Crusade - Invades at the northwestern side of the church interior.

Crystal Barrage.text: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 1,500 Runes by Sorceress Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins. Should Sellen die before purchasing this Sorcery from her, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Sellen's Bell Bearing.

Crystal Bud.text: Found widely across Liurnia of the Lakes, typically near trees.

Crystal Burst.text: Guaranteed Drop: Weeping Peninsula. Acquired from defeating the Demi-Human Queen of the Demi-Human Forest Ruins.

Crystal Cave Moss.text: Crystal Cave Moss is harvested in various caves throughout the Lands Between:. Stillwater Cave. Academy Crystal Cave. Sellia Hideaway.

Crystal Dart.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [11], which can be purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore) for 1500 runes.

Crystal Knife.text: Found in a chest inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel located in Liurnia of the Lakes. After taking the first elevator after the Site of Grace down and walking across a wooden beam it is inside the second room on the right, guarded by two distracted Marionette Soldiers.

Crystal Release.text: Guaranteed Drop: Academy Crystal Cave. Acquired from defeating the Crystalian duo guarding the end of the Cave.

Crystal Spear.text: Found inside a chest behind an illusory wall in Sellia Hideaway, located in Caelid.

Crystal Staff.text: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. Found in a treasure chest inside Academy Crystal Cave. The chest is on a raised platform hidden by an illusory wall, which in turn is found to the left just after the door to the room with the Battlemage/fog wall to the boss. Entering the cave requires 2 Stonesword Keys.

Crystal Sword.text: Found after the bridge in the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Crystal Torrent.text: Guaranteed Drop: Caelid. Acquired from defeating the Putrid Crystalians at the bottom of the Sellia Hideaway.

Crystalian Ashes.text: Found in Sellia Hideaway, in a chest guarded by Glintstone Sorcerers.

Cuckoo Glintstone.text: Recipe is included with Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook 1, found on a corpse at a soldier camp northwest of the Lake-Facing Cliffs.

Cuckoo Greatshield.text: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. 4% drop chance from Cuckoo Knights. Four knights can be found on and beside the road leading northeast from East Raya Lucaria Gate Site of Grace to a point just south of Bellum Church.

Cuckoo Knight Armor.text: Chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

Cuckoo Knight Armor (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Cuckoo Knight enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Cuckoo Knight Gauntlets.text: 3% chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

Cuckoo Knight Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

Cuckoo Knight Helm.text: Chance to drop from Cuckoo Knight enemies.

Cuckoo Surcoat.text: Chance to drop from Raya Lucaria Soldier enemies.

Cure Poison.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Cure Poison is sold for runes 800 Runes by Brother Corhyn. Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

Curseblade Mask.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 3% chance of dropping from a Curseblade.

Curseblade Meera.text: Dropped by Curseblade Labirith at the end of Bonny Gaol.

Curseblade's Cirque.text: Drop: Gravesite Plain / Belurat, Tower Settlement / Scadu Altus / Ancient Ruins of Rauh. 3% drop chance from Curseblades (2% drop chance from some of the Curseblades in Scaduview and Ancient Ruins of Rauh). There is an easily reached Curseblade walking down the stairs leading down from the Stagefront Site of Grace in Belurat. By crouching it is possible to backstab it to make the fight easier.

Cursed-Blood Pot.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [12], found on a corpse inside the Rose Church.

Cursemark of Death.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Divine Tower of Liurnia). Area: on the remains of Ranni the Witch's original body atop of the Tower, alongside the Stargazer Heirloom. This area can only be reached from the Carian Study Hall, after placing the Carian Inverted Statue, received from Ranni in exchange for the Fingerslayer Blade of Nokron, Eternal City, on the altar at the entrance.

Curtsy.text: Quest Item: Roundtable Hold. Given to the player by Roderika after levelling a Spirit Ashes up to at least +4 and then talking to her again.

Curved Club.text: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Consecrated Snowfield / Mohgwyn Palace. 2% drop chance from club-wielding Second-Generation Albinauric (their clubs are considerable larger than the actual weapon). 2 club-wielders can be found on a broken bridge east of Academy Gate Town's Site of Grace.

Curved Great Club.text: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Consecrated Snowfield / Mohgwyn Palace. 4% drop from any great club-wielding Second-Generation Albinaurics. Several can be found scattered throughout Temple Quarter in Liurnia. A lone great club-wielder can be found on a broken bridge just east of the Site of Grace in Academy Gate Town.

Curved Sword Talisman.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Obtained from a chest in Stormveil Castle, in the room where the player character gets locked-in with the Banished Knight. This area is only accessible by using the secret side-entrance, suggested by Gatekeeper Gostoc.

Daedicar's Woe.text: Quest Item: Volcano Manor. Obtained from Rya towards the end of her questline, after she realizes the truth of her origin and requests the player to kill her. She will drop it if she is killed. It can also be found lying on the floor after Rya leaves the room:.

Dagger.text: Purchase: Twin Maiden Husks. 1 sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 400 Runes. Loot: Lands Between / Realm of Shadow. A base 4% chance to drop from drop dagger-wielding enemies (Highwaymen, Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Radahn Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, Haligtree Foot Soldiers, and Messmer Foot Soldiers).

Dagger Talisman.text: Loot: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir). Obtained from a corpse in Volcano Manor. From the throne room, just before the waygate leading to Audience Pathway, head west up the stairs, and unlock the semi-transparent fog wall there, by inserting 2 Stonesword Keys into the adjacent imp statue. Upon reaching the edge of a wooden catwalk, turn immediately right and drop onto a catwalk below.

Dancer's Bracer.text: Guaranteed Drop: Cerulean Coast (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from defeating the Dancer of Ranah located in the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

Dancer's Castanets.text: Altus Plateau (Shaded Castle Inner Gate). Quest: Patches the Untethered. After defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy and talking to Patches, he'll move in the hallway before the Castellan's Hall of the Shaded Castle, where he'll give you this item upon talking to him. He'll then return to his initial spot in the Murkwater Cave of Limgrave.

Dancer's Dress.text: Guaranteed Drop: Cerulean Coast (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from defeating the Dancer of Ranah located in the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

Dancer's Dress (Altered).text: Guaranteed Drop: Cerulean Coast (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from altering the Dancer's Dress. Which can be obtained from defeating the Dancer of Ranah located in the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

Dancer's Hood.text: Guaranteed Drop: Cerulean Coast (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from defeating the Dancer of Ranah located in the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

Dancer's Trousers.text: Guaranteed Drop: Cerulean Coast (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from defeating the Dancer of Ranah located in the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

Dancing Blade of Ranah.text: Guaranteed Drop: Southern Nameless Mausoleum (Cerulean Coast). Dropped by the Dancer of Ranah, found inside of the Southern Nameless Mausoleum.

Dane's Blood Footwork.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Dane's Cold Footwork.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Dane's Fire Footwork.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Dane's Flame Art Footwork.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Dane's Footwork.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Dane's Hat.text: Guaranteed Drop: Moorth Ruins (Scadu Altus). Automatically acquired from defeating Dryleaf Dane in an honorable duel near the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace. To challenge Dane, the player must first acquire the May the Best Win gesture, from near the Highroad Cross Site of Grace, then perform the gesture (without canceling it with a roll) in front of Dane.

Dane's Heavy Footwork.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Dane's Keen Footwork.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Dane's Lightning Footwork.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Dane's Magic Footwork.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Dane's Occult Footwork.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Dane's Poison Footwork.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Dane's Quality Footwork.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Dane's Sacred Footwork.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Pillaged from Dane's corpse after successfully defeating the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Dappled Cured Meat.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [18], sold by the Abandoned Merchant (Siofra River) for 6000 runes.

Dappled White Cured Meat.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [18], sold by the Abandoned Merchant (Siofra River) for 6000 runes.

Dark Moon Greatsword.text: Quest reward: Cathedral of Manus Celes (Liurnia of the Lakes). Found at the end of Lunar Princess Ranni's questline, in the spot where she sat underneath the Cathedral of Manus Celes, after giving her the Dark Moon Ring.

Dark Moon Ring.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Raya Lucaria Grand Library). Area: inside the chest near Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon that requires the Discarded Palace Key to open.

Darkness.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for runes 3,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Assassin's Prayerbook.

Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle.text: Purchase: Gravesite Plain. Can be acquired from Thiollier for 6000. If this item was not bought from Thiollier before he moves from his first location, then it can alternatively be bought from Moore for 6000. Can alternatively be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for 6000 after giving them Moore's bell bearing, after he has acquired Thiollier's stock.

Death Knight Armor.text: Loot: Darklight Catacombs (Scadu Altus). Found on the corpse of a Death Knight dangling off a ledge in a somewhat hidden room, which is guarded by a Catacomb Conjurer. The room can be found after the first stone elevator (not counting the elevator between the entrance of the catacombs and its site of grace).

Death Knight Gauntlets.text: Loot: Darklight Catacombs (Scadu Altus). Found on the corpse of a Death Knight dangling off a ledge in a somewhat hidden room, which is guarded by a Catacomb Conjurer. The room can be found after the first stone elevator (not counting the elevator between the entrance of the catacombs and its site of grace).

Death Knight Greaves.text: Loot: Darklight Catacombs (Scadu Altus). Found on the corpse of a Death Knight dangling off a ledge in a somewhat hidden room, which is guarded by a Catacomb Conjurer. The room can be found after the first stone elevator (not counting the elevator between the entrance of the catacombs and its site of grace).

Death Knight Helm.text: Loot: Darklight Catacombs (Scadu Altus). Found on the corpse of a Death Knight dangling off a ledge in a somewhat hidden room, which is guarded by a Catacomb Conjurer. The room can be found after the first stone elevator (not counting the elevator between the entrance of the catacombs and its site of grace).

Death Knight's Longhaft Axe.text: Guaranteed drop: Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base). This weapon is dropped after defeating the Death Knight at Scorpion River Catacombs.

Death Knight's Twin Axes.text: Guaranteed Drop: Fog Rift Catacombs (Gravesite Plain). Dropped by the dual-axe wielding Death Knight at then end of the dungeon.

Death Lightning.text: Trade the Remembrance of the Lichdragon, gained by defeating Lichdragon Fortissax, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Death Mask Helm.text: Guaranteed Drop: Shadow Keep, Church District. Drops from Wego, Fire Knight Elder, who can be found in the middle of the central church, summoning Putrid Corpses.

Death Ritual Spear.text: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants. Dropped by the Death Rite Bird on the Mountaintops of the Giants, found just southwest of Castle Sol. This is the only Death Rite Bird that is active all day, instead of only at night.

Death's Poker.text: Guaranteed drop: Caelid. Dropped by the Death Rite Bird in Caelid, found southeast of the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank Site of Grace at night. The high cliff to the east of the boss can be used to cheese it, as it's rather bad at scaling the rocks. Combined with anti-Those Who Live in Death equipment and ranged attacks will kill it quickly.

Deathbed Dress.text: Guaranteed Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace. WARNING: After defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade, Leyndell, Royal Capital will turn to Leyndell, Ashen Capital, and the dress, along with every item in Leyndell, Royal Capital, will be unobtainable until the next New Game cycle.

Deathbed Smalls.text: This item could not be obtained through normal means.

Deathroot.text: Deathroot can be acquired in the following places:. Defeating the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village in Limgrave. Deathtouched Catacombs at Stormhill in Limgrave, in a chest after defeating the Black Knife Assassin boss. Defeating the Tibia Mariner in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes.

Deathsbane Jerky.text: This item was removed from the game and cannot be obtained by legitimate means.

Dectus Medallion (Left).text: Limgrave (Fort Haight West). Area: inside the chest atop the tower to the side of the blood-obsessed Godrick Knight.

Dectus Medallion (Right).text: Caelid (Fort Faroth). Area: atop the tower just past the shed.

Deep-Purple Lily.text: Deep-Purple Lillies grow on the Cerulean Coast in the Realm of Shadow. They can be looted in the Stone Coffin Fissure. One may be harvested near the Ellac River Cave site of grace.

Deflecting Hardtear.text: Guaranteed drop: Gravesite Plain. Defeat the Furnace Golem in Gravesite Plain.

Dejection.text: Available from the start of the game.

Demi-Human Ashes.text: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog in Impaler's Catacombs.

Demi-Human Queen's Staff.text: Guaranteed drop: Weeping Peninsula. Dropped by the Demi-Human Queen found in the Demi-Human Forest Ruins.

Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh.text: Dropped by Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze at Belurat Gaol.

Depraved Perfumer Carmaan.text: Found in Volcano Manor, in a room only accessible by going through the secret passage behind the illusory wall near the start of the dungeon.

Depraved Perfumer Gloves.text: 3% chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

Depraved Perfumer Headscarf.text: Chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

Depraved Perfumer Robe.text: Chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

Depraved Perfumer Robe (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Depraved Perfumer enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Depraved Perfumer Trousers.text: Chance to drop from Depraved Perfumer enemies.

Desperate Prayer.text: Quest Item: Caelid. Obtained from Sage Gowry after giving Millicent the Valkyrie's Prosthesis from The Shaded Castle followed by purchasing the Pest Threads Incantation from him then exhausting his dialogue.

Devonia's Hammer.text: Guaranteed Drop: Ancient Ruins of Rauh (Land of the Tower). Defeat Crucible Knight Devonia at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. They drop their hammer along with the Crucible Hammer-Helm.

Devourer's Scepter.text: Received upon killing Knight Bernahl. This can be either at the Warmaster Shack in Limgrave, or in during his invasion in Farum Azula.

Dewgem.text: Found near lakes, ponds, and rivers in the Realm of Shadow.

Dewkissed Herba.text: Dewkissed Herba grows underground along the Ainsel and Siofra Rivers. It can be found near the Eternal City.

Dexterity-knot Crystal Tear.text: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. Found in a bowl on a small island in the southern Liurnia of the Lakes, immediately north-west of the Scenic Isle grace, not far from the southern cliffs. Guarded by some Second-Generation Albinaurics.

Diallos's Mask.text: Obtained from Knight Diallos after completing his questline, or by killing him.

Digger's Staff.text: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes/Caelid/Altus Plateau. 2% drop chance from regular and sack-carrying Glintstone Miners found in mines. Plenty are found throughout the entirety of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel, making it a good place to farm for it. Sellia Crystal Tunnel is the earliest farming spot for the staff, though.

Dirty Chainmail.text: Chance to drop from Albinauric enemies that wield it.

Discarded Palace Key.text: Ainsel River (Nokstella Waterfall Basin). Quest: Ranni the Witch. Automatically received upon defeating the Baleful Shadow.

Discus of Light.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for 11,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn after he moves to Goldmask's location in Altus. Should Corhyn die before purchasing this incantation after moving to Goldmask's location, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

Dismounter.text: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Mountaintops of the Giants. 4% drop chance from Kaiden Sellswords. Two Sellswords can be found apart on the path between Stormhill Shack and Warmaster's Shack in Limgrave. Four Sellswords can be found at an unmarked camp northeast of the Agheel Lake North Site of Grace in Limgrave (the camp that contains the Armorer's Cookbook 1).

Distinguished Greatshield.text: Purchase: Hermit Merchant's Shack (Capital Outskirts). 1 is sold for runes 5500 Runes by the Hermit Merchant at the Hermit Merchant's Shack in Capital Outskirts.

Divine Beast Head.text: Guaranteed Drop: Belurat, Tower Settlement (Land of the Tower). Acquired from defeating the Divine Beast Dancing Lion at the Theatre of the Divine Beast.

Divine Beast Helm.text: Random Drop: Enir-Ilim. 5% chance of dropping from a Divine Beast Warrior.

Divine Beast Tornado.text: Loot: Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Drops from the Divine Beast Dancing Lion found by heading east-northeast across the bridge beginning at the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway Site of Grace. The temple's location is just northeast of the Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace but isn't reachable from that spot.

Divine Beast Warrior Armor.text: Random Drop: Enir-Ilim. 5% chance of dropping from a Divine Beast Warrior.

Divine Bird Feathers.text: Divine Bird Feathers is looted from a body at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. It is found in a body of water just east of the Church of the Bud, Main Entrance site of grace. To reach it, head north from the grace and keep to the right in the temple to arrive at the pool, where it's on a body just past a stone gazebo.

Divine Bird Helm.text: Random Drop: Ancient Ruins of Rauh & Enir-Ilim. 5% chance of dropping from a Divine Bird Warrior.

Divine Bird Warrior Armor.text: Random Drop: Ancient Ruins of Rauh & Enir-Ilim. 5% chance of dropping from a Divine Bird Warrior.

Divine Bird Warrior Gauntlets.text: Random Drop: Ancient Ruins of Rauh & Enir-Ilim. 5% chance of dropping from a Divine Bird Warrior.

Divine Bird Warrior Greaves.text: Random Drop: Ancient Ruins of Rauh & Enir-Ilim. 5% chance of dropping from a Divine Bird Warrior.

Divine Bird Warrior Ornis.text: Found by Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace: Head north past the large Scarlet Buds and Kindreds of Rot. Go uphill and activate the Spiritspring and use it to jump on ruins above. There is an opening to the right side which lets you walk on the ledge. Continue on the ledge, jump across the gap and then make your way uphill. You can find this spirit summon inside the treasure chest in the building uphill.

Divine Fortification.text: Guaranteed Drop: Weeping Peninsula. Divine Fortification is obtained upon defeating the Teardrop Scarab found atop a fallen ruin near the Tombsward Ruins.

Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet.text: Can be obtained from Preceptor Seluvis after discovering his secret room and agreeing to take Seluvis's Potion to Nepheli Loux, Warrior. If a different puppet is selected, this one can be bought for 5 Starlight Shards from Seluvis. It can later be found on Pidia's body if the potion was given to someone else.

Dozing Cross-Legged.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle. Found on a corpse on a roof in Stormveil Castle south-west of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace. It is guarded by a Warhawk.

Dragon Communion Flesh.text: Can be crafted after acquiring Igon's Cookbook [2] in Jagged Peak, which is found on a corpse at the end of the cliffs east of the Jagged Peak Mountainside site of grace.

Dragon Communion Harpoon.text: Loot: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion (Jagged Peak). Two can be found on the wing of the dead dragon at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. Craftable:. Crafted with Igon's Cookbook [1].

Dragon Communion Seal.text: Dropped by a spectral Banished Knight located in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave in Limgrave. To find it, start at the Stranded Graveyard Site of Grace and head down the first two ramps in the Grave, then head right in the split to go up another two ramps. The Knight is inside a small room at the end of the ramp and is quite tough for the early game.

Dragon Greatclaw.text: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau. Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel boss guarding the entrance to Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Dragon Halberd.text: Guaranteed Drop: Siofra River. Dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier boss after a gateway portal in the lower Siofra River region.

Dragon Heart.text: There are a total of 23 Dragon Hearts that can be gained in the base game. Various Dragons. 3 unnamed Glintstone Dragons (x1 each). Borealis the Freezing Fog.

Dragon King's Cragblade.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Dragonlord, gained by defeating Dragonlord Placidusax, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Dragon Towershield.text: Loot: Crumbling Farum Azula. Found in a chest in a side area after the Dragon Temple Rooftop, guarded by a Banished Knight. From the Site of Grace, run down to the nearby Ancient Dragon. Left/northeast of it, look over the cliff edge to finding a series of floating rocks to drop down to reach a building.

Dragon's Calorbloom.text: Dragon's Calorbloom may be found growing on the slopes of the Jagged Peak. It does not respawn after being harvested.

Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana.text: Guaranteed Drop: Dragon's Pit (Gravesite Plain). The Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana is received upon defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man at the end of the Dragon's Pit dungeon.

Dragonbolt Blessing.text: Loot: Altus Plateau. Dragonbolt Blessing is found in a treasure chest within Stormcaller Church.

Dragonbolt of Florissax.text: Quest Item: Jagged Peak. Given by the Dragon Communion Priestess at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after giving her Thiollier's Concoction at night and waiting for her to wake up (and then repeatedly talking to her), and then finally defeating Bayle the Dread. This item is mutually exclusive with the Priestess Heart and Flowerstone Gavel.

Dragonclaw.text: Dragon Communion: Limgrave / Caelid / Jagged Peak. Acquired from the altar at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave, the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid, or the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion in the Realm of Shadow for 1 Dragon Heart.

Dragonclaw Shield.text: Guaranteed drop: Capital Outskirts. Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel boss that guards the main entrance to Leyndell, Royal Capital, in Capital Outskirts.

Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman.text: Loot: Drainage Channel (Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree). Obtained from inside a chest. From the Drainage Channel Site of Grace, head east and travel along tree roots, branches, and buttresses to reach the roof of the nearby church, which is full of Pests. Drop through a hole in the roof, and head southwest along the rafters to reach an upper platform, with the chest.

Dragoncrest Shield Talisman.text: Obtained from a corpse that lies on the ground, near Bestial Sanctum, in northern Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. From the front door of the sanctum, head southwest around the side of the sanctum, until reaching a cliff that overlooks a large tree root, close enough to drop to. Drop from here to the branch, to another branch, to a domed rooftop, and then to the first of 3 ring structures, jutting out from the cliffside.

Dragonfire.text: Dragon Communion: Limgrave / Caelid / Jagged Peak. Acquired from the altar at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave, the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid, or the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 1 Dragon Heart.

Dragonice.text: Dragon Communion: Caelid / Jagged Peak. Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 1 Dragon Heart.

Dragonmaw.text: Dragon Communion: Limgrave / Caelid / Jagged Peak. Acquired from the altar at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave, the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid, or the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion in the Realm of Shadow for 1 Dragon Heart.

Dragonscale Blade.text: Guaranteed Drop: Lake of Rot (Ainsel River). Dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier boss in the Lake of Rot. A platform can be raised by buttons in the immediate area, making it slightly easier to fight the boss without constantly being afflicted with Scarlet Rot.

Dragonscale Flesh.text: 1 is received upon defeating the Jagged Peak Drake at the entrance to Jagged Peak, after going through Dragon's Pit. 1 is received upon defeating the Jagged Peak Drake found further on fighting another dragon, near the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace.

Drake Knight Armor.text: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.

Drake Knight Armor (Altered).text: Found unaltered in Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Drake Knight Gauntlets.text: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.

Drake Knight Greaves.text: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.

Drake Knight Helm.text: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.

Drake Knight Helm (Altered).text: Found unaltered in Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

Drawing-Room Key.text: Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor). Quest: Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress. Received from her upon selecting Join Volcano Manor.

Drawstring Holy Grease.text: Recipe is included with Missionary's Cookbook [4], found in the Minor Erdtree Church in Altus Plateau.

Dried Bouquet.text: Loot: Belurat, Tower Settlement (Land of the Tower). Found in a small pavilion southeast of Belurat's Miquella's Cross. The path to it is hidden behind some rubble to the east of the entrance to the tower with the giant Spider Scorpions.

Dryleaf Arm Wraps.text: Loot: Recluses' River (Scadu Altus). Located at the bottom of a waterfall north of the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace, just before the river forks in two different directions.

Dryleaf Arts.text: Quest Reward: Moorth Ruins (Scadu Altus). Obtained from defeating Dryleaf Dane in an honorable duel at the Moorth Ruins site of grace. To challenge Dane to a duel, retrieve the May the Best Win gesture from the Highroat Cross site of grace then perform the gesture to its completion in front of him.

Dryleaf Cuissardes.text: Loot: Recluses' River (Scadu Altus). Located at the bottom of a waterfall north of the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace, just before the river forks in two different directions.

Dryleaf Robe.text: Loot: Recluses' River (Scadu Altus). Located at the bottom of a waterfall north of the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace, just before the river forks in two different directions.

Dryleaf Robe (Altered).text: Loot & Alter Garments: Recluses' River (Scadu Altus). Acquired from altering Dryleaf Robe. Located at the bottom of a waterfall north of the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace, just before the river forks in two different directions.

Dryleaf Seal.text: Loot: Recluses' River (Scadu Altus). Found on one of the cliffs facing the river north of Recluses' River Downstream site of grace.

Dueling Shield.text: Loot: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep). Head north from the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace and up the stairs. Turn left and continue up two more flights of stairs until you reach a Fire Knight facing away from you. Follow the wooden path to the left of the Fire Knight, and on left you will see a buttress attached to the path, leading to a stone floor.

Duelist Greataxe.text: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital. 4% chance to drop from the Grave Warden Duelist enemies that wield it near the West Capital Rampart grace.

Duelist Greaves.text: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist-type enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.

Duelist Helm.text: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, as they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.

Dung Eater Puppet.text: Free the Dung Eater from beneath Leyndell, Royal Capital, then defeat him at the pond where you found Blackguard Big Boggart and then return to the Dung Eater in his cell with Seluvis's Potion. Costs 5 Starlight Shards and is only available after doing the steps above and buying Preceptor Seluvis's first two puppets, then reloading the area by teleporting or exiting to the main menu and re-entering.

Dwelling Arrow.text: Abandoned Merchant in the Siofra River region (x30).

Eccentric's Armor.text: Received after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline.

Eccentric's Breeches.text: Received after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline.

Eccentric's Hood.text: Received after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline.

Eccentric's Hood (Altered).text: Received (unaltered) after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

Eccentric's Manchettes.text: Received after defeating Witch-Hunter Jerren during Sellen's questline.

Eclipse Crest Greatshield.text: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Deeproot Depths / Consecrated Snowfield. 4% drop rate from Greatsword-wielding Mausoleum Knight (excluding the Greatbow-wielding ones). One Greatsword-wielding Knight can be found with its back turned just outside of the Black Knife Catacombs, providing an easy farming spot.

Eclipse Crest Heater Shield.text: Loot: Minor Erdtree (Weeping Peninsula). Found on a corpse atop a large stone archway protruding from a cliff northwest of the Minor Erdtree. Halfway down one of the stone pillars just northwest of the Tree are two stone hexagons connected by a stone bridge. Dropping down the northwest side of the northern hexagon leads to a ledge with the corpse.

Eclipse Shotel.text: Loot: Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants). The Eclipse Shotel is in front of the altar inside the Church of the Eclipse.

Ekzykes's Decay.text: Dragon Communion: Caelid. Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 2 Dragon Hearts after defeating Decaying Ekzykes in Caelid.

Elden Lord Armor.text: Gotten from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Godfrey, First Elden Lord.

Elden Lord Armor (Altered).text: Gotten from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Godfrey, First Elden Lord.

Elden Lord Bracers.text: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Godfrey, First Elden Lord.

Elden Lord Crown.text: Sold by Finger Reader Enia after defeating Godfrey, First Elden Lord.

Elden Lord Greaves.text: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Godfrey, First Elden Lord.

Elden Remembrance.text: Leyndell, Ashen Capital (Elden Throne). Drop: Elden Beast.

Elden Stars.text: Loot: Deeproot Depths. Elden Stars can be looted from a body at the end of a cave filled with giant ants in the Deeproot Depths, located immediately west of the Great Waterfall Crest grace, after climbing up one of the large roots.

Electrify Armament.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for 4,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Dragon Cult Prayerbook.

Electrocharge.text: Loot: Fog Rift Catacombs. Found by dropping down a hole in the second cubicle on the left at the third dropping spike-roof and then taking a left twice to find it in the same rooms as a Catacombs Sorcerer, some Fulgurbloom, and a few Skeletal Slimes.

Eleonora's Poleblade.text: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau. Dropped by the invader Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger at the Second Church of Marika. Eleonora spawns at the Church regardless if the Tarnished is doing Yura's questline or not.

Ember of Messmer.text: Dropped by Messmerfire dogs or found on the ground in Messmer Soldier camps.

Empyrean-Blood Burgeon.text: Empyrean-Blood Burgeons are found near Miquella's Crosses in the Realm of Shadow. Once harvested, they do not respawn until the next playthrough.
