Enraged Divine Beast.text: Trade the Remembrance of the Dancing Lion, dropped by the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Envoy Crown.text: Found on a corpse behind a Giant Oracle Envoy enemy near the Haligtree Canopy site of grace in Miquella's Haligtree.

Envoy's Greathorn.text: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital / Miquella's Haligtree. 2% chance to drop from Giant Oracle Envoy enemies.

Envoy's Horn.text: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital / Miquella's Haligtree. 2% drop chance from small Oracle Envoys. 5 small Envoys (and 1 medium one) can be found west of the East Capital Rampart Site of Grace, just at the entrance to Leyndell, Royal Capital. 3 small Envoys can be found just south of the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, guarded by a non-respawning Valiant Gargoyle.

Envoy's Long Horn.text: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital / Miquella's Haligtree. Large Oracle Envoys have a 4% chance to drop this item.

Erdleaf Flower.text: Erdleaf Flowers are harvested from plants growing on the Altus Plateau. Harvested in Limgrave.

Erdsteel Dagger.text: Received from Kenneth Haight after helping him retake Fort Haight. Can be found in Leyndell, Royal Capital in the sewer area under the wing of Gransax near a fire-spitting Gargoyle Statue. From the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace, proceed northwest along the avenue and drop down in the pit to the far left.

Erdtree Bow.text: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital/Leyndell, Ashen Capital. Found inside a chest that can be accessed by going on the rooftops of the Erdtree Sanctuary in Leyndell by climbing up a root and then dropping down on the side, then entering a window.

Erdtree Greatbow.text: Guaranteed Drop: Fringefolk Hero's Grave (Limgrave). Received when destroying the Chariot in the Hero's Grave, along with 10 Great Arrows. The Chariot is destroyed by dropping one of 3 massive urns on top of it. Doing this requires a ranged weapon and some ammunition, which should then be fired as the Chariot is turning around, signified by the screen shaking and a rumbling sound being made.

Erdtree Greatshield.text: Guaranteed drop: Altus Plateau. Dropped by the Tree Sentinel Duo guarding the southern gate from Altus Plateau to Capital Outskirts.

Erdtree Heal.text: Loot: Leyndell, Ashen Capital. Erdtree Heal is located near the Queen's Bedchamber Site of Grace in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Erdtree Seal.text: Loot: Mt. Gelmir. Found inside a open cell just northwest of the Prison Town Church Site of Grace, located in Volcano Manor. There is an Omenkiller enemy near it. Can also be found by starting at the Guest Hall Site of Grace and backtracking to the top floor of the building, before exiting it across the bridge and taking a right through the large gate to find a bonfire. The Seal is in one of the cells there.

Erdtree Surcoat.text: Chance to drop from Leyndell Soldier enemies.

Erdtree's Favor.text: Obtained from an altar in Fringefolk Hero's Grave, in western Limgrave. This dungeon is accessed from Stranded Graveyard after inserting 2 Stonesword Keys into the nearby imp statue, to unlock the semi-transparent fog wall. Proceed down the ladder and across the poison pond, to reach a ramp, patrolled by an invincible chariot. Proceed down the ramp by hiding in alcoves on the side, to avoid the chariot.

Errant Sorcerer Boots.text: Found on a corpse inside the beastmen-invaded village near the Craftman's Shack site of grace located in Mt. Gelmir.

Errant Sorcerer Manchettes.text: Found on a corpse inside the beastmen-invaded village near the Craftman's Shack site of grace located in Mt. Gelmir.

Errant Sorcerer Robe.text: Found altered on a corpse inside the beastmen-invaded village near the Craftman's Shack site of grace located in Mt. Gelmir. Can be unaltered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Errant Sorcerer Robe (Altered).text: Found on a corpse inside the Hermit Village near the grace Craftman's Shack site of grace located in Mt. Gelmir.

Erudition.text: Quest Item: Liurnia of the Lakes. Received from Thops after giving him the spare Academy Glintstone Key.

Estoc.text: Starting equipment:. The Prisoner origin starts with an Estoc. Purchase: Murkwater Cave (Limgrave) / Liurnia of the Lakes / Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir). One is sold for runes 3,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant in southern Liurnia of the Lakes, next to the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace.

Eternal Darkness.text: Loot: Caelid. Acquired from a corpse inside the Swamp Lookout Tower, guarded by a Bloodhound Knight.

Eternal Sleep Pot.text: Crafted with St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook (1).

Euporia.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim. This armament is technically found in Belurat, Tower Settlement, however, reaching it can only be done through Enir-Ilim. On the stairs past the lightning-aspected Divine Beast Warrior, jump off the path onto a lower staircase and then follow the ledges down until you reach a platform with a Fireproof Pickled Liver.

Exalted Flesh.text: Recipe is included with Armorer's Cookbook [3], which can be purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Eastern Limgrave) north-west of Fort Haight. Found within Morne Tunnel inside the chest within a shack.

Executioner's Greataxe.text: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Crumbling Farum Azula. 4% drop chance from Greataxe-wielding Giant Skeletons with 100 Discovery. 4% drop chance from Greataxe-wielding Giant Beastman Skeletons.

Exile Armor.text: Chance to drop from Exile Soldier enemies.

Exile Gauntlets.text: Chance to drop from Exile Soldier enemies.

Exile Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Exile Soldier enemies.

Exile Hood.text: Chance to drop from Exile Soldier enemies.

Explosive Bolt.text: Random Drop:. Loot:. Caelid. x6 Found on a corpse by the cliffs of the ravine north of Caelem Ruins.

Explosive Ghostflame.text: Guaranteed Drop: Consecrated Snowfield. Acquired from defeating the Death Rite Bird that roams the northern edge of the frozen river at night.

Explosive Greatbolt.text: Loot:. Mt. Gelmir. x5 Found on a corpse guarded by two Abductor Virgins north-west of the Bridge of Iniquity Site of Grace. Volcano Manor.

Explosive Stone.text: Can be purchased in unlimited supply after giving the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing 2 to the Twin Maiden Husks. Dropped by the explosive variety of Miners in Limgrave Tunnels, Morne Tunnel and Gael Tunnel.

Explosive Stone Clump.text: Dropped by the explosive variety of Miners in Limgrave Tunnels, Morne Tunnel and Gael Tunnel.

Extreme Repentance.text: Obtained from angering non-hostile Patches and letting him reduce the player's health to around 50% of their total health bar.

Eye Surcoat.text: Loot: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir). Found on the ground in the arena of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

Eye of Yelough.text: Eye of Yelough is found in lands afflicted by Frenzied Flame, such as the outskirts of Liurnia of the Lakes. Once harvested, it will not respawn until the next playthrough. Ailing Village. Frenzied Flame Village. Yelough Anix Ruins.

Faded Erdleaf Flower.text: Faded Erdleaf Flowers are harvested in Caelid.

Faith-knot Crystal Tear.text: Loot: Weeping Peninsula. Found in a bowl north of Demi-Human Forest Ruins in Weeping Peninsula, near the cliff's edge, guarded over by a few Miranda Sprouts. It's also just east of the Church of Pilgrimage.

Faithful's Canvas Talisman.text: Loot: Sellia Crystal Tunnel (Caelid). Obtained from a corpse in Sellia Crystal Tunnel. The corpse can be found off to the right side of the main path, guarded by two Pests.

Falchion.text: Drop: Limgrave / Coastal Cave (Limgrave) / Demi-Human Forest Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Lakeside Crystal Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Lux Ruins (Altus Plateau) / Volcano Cave (Mt. Gelmir) / Mountaintops of the Giants / Cerulean Coast. 2% drop chance from Demi-Humans wielding falchions, including both shield-wielding and shield-less variants.

Fallingstar Beast Jaw.text: Guaranteed Drop: Mt. Gelmir (Altus Plateau). Acquired by defeating the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast boss in a large crater on Mt. Gelmir, south of the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.

Falx.text: Guaranteed drop: Shadow Keep / Ancient Ruins of Rauh / Enir-Ilim. The Falx is a guaranteed drop depending on how the player interacts with Hornsent after Miquella's Great Rune breaks. If the player summons Hornsent to help defeat Messmer the Impaler, he will invade as a hostile NPC near the Rauh Ancient Ruins Site of Grace. He will drop the Falx upon his defeat.

Family Heads.text: Guaranteed Drop: Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau). Received upon defeating Necromancer Garris, who is found behind two illusory walls in a row inside the Sage's Cave. More specifically, the first illusory wall is found on the first platform to the left in the room with a waterfall just before the other boss of the Cave, while the other is to the right of the two chests the first illusory wall hides.

Fan Daggers.text: Patches in Murkwater Cave (x20). This stock becomes unlimited when he leaves for Liurnia of the Lakes, and for every other location he is at, regardless of if he is met in Liurnia or not.

Fancy Spin.text: Quest Item: Mountaintops of the Giants. Received from Spirit Jellyfish, Aureliette within the Stargazer's Ruins after re-uniting her with her sister by summoning Spirit Jellyfish, Aurelia beside her.

Fang Helm.text: Guaranteed Drop: Land of the Tower (Realm of Shadow). Dropped from the Red Bear NPC bossfight in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

Fanged Imp Ashes.text: Purchase: Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes). Purchased for 1,500 Runes from the Isolated Merchant found south-east from the Main Academy Gate Site of Grace. Keepsake:. May be chosen as a Keepsake when creating a new character.

Fell Omen Cloak.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Morgott, the Omen King.

Festive Garb.text: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. Cannot be altered by yourself or by Boc.

Festive Garb (Altered).text: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. Cannot be unaltered by yourself or by Boc.

Festive Hood.text: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau.

Festive Hood (Altered).text: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

Fetid Pot.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [4], found in Mistwood close to the map for Limgrave, East.

Fia's Hood.text: Dropped by Fia if you complete her questline and give the Twinned armor to D, Beholder of Death.

Fia's Mist.text: Guaranteed Drop: Deeproot Depths. Acquired from defeating Fia's Champions.

Fia's Robe.text: Dropped by Fia if you complete her questline and give the Twinned armor to D (NPC)'s twin brother.

Fia's Robe (Altered).text: Dropped (unaltered) by Fia if you complete her questline and give the Twinned armor to D (NPC)'s twin brother. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Fine Crucible Feather Talisman.text: Loot: Ancient Ruins of Rauh (Land of the Tower). From the Rauh Ancient Ruins East site of grace, travel to the northwest until you reach a room with several large branches and Man-Flies. Jump to the other branch on the left.

Finger Maiden Fillet.text: Found on a corpse inside the Church of Inhibition located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Finger Maiden Robe.text: Found on a corpse inside the Church of Inhibition located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Finger Maiden Robe (Altered).text: Found unaltered on a corpse inside the Church of Inhibition located in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Finger Maiden Shoes.text: Found on a corpse inside the Church of Inhibition located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet.text: Can be acquired from Seluvis once you confront him about his secret puppet workshop at the Three Sisters. Either her or the Jarwight Puppet can be gained from Seluvis for free. If she isn't selected she costs 2 Starlight Shards to buy.

Finger Mimic.text: Found around the Finger Ruins. Finger Ruins of Dheo. Finger Ruins of Rhia.

Finger Robe.text: Guaranteed Drop: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus). Acquired from altering the High Priest Robe, which can be obtained from defeating Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers. To access the bossfight, the player must first defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers, then interact with Ymir's throne in the cathedral. This will make Jolan, Swordhand of Night appear, who will be hostile and proceed to attack the player.

Finger Seal.text: Equipped:. Part of the starting equipment for the Prophet and Confessor Origins. Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks for 800 Runes.

Finger Severer.text: Can be looted near the exit lift out of the Stranded Graveyard.

Finger Snap.text: Quest Item: Limgrave. Received from Merchant Kalé after asking about the howling near Mistwood Ruins.

Fingercreeper Ashes.text: In the Hinterland, between the Finger Ruins of Dheo and the nearest Grace, in the part where there is still grass, you can find a fissure in the ground with a gigantic hand that works as a mini-boss. Behind this creature is a cave that leads to the ashes.

Fingerprint Armor.text: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

Fingerprint Armor (Altered).text: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

Fingerprint Gauntlets.text: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

Fingerprint Grape.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Frenzied Flame Village Outskirts). Drop: Festering Fingerprint Vyke, alongside Vyke's War Spear. He invades before the Church of Inhibition.

Fingerprint Greaves.text: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

Fingerprint Helm.text: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

Fingerprint Nostrum.text: Can be crafted after acquiring Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [2], which is found on a corpse on the path to the hanging bell in the Finger Ruins of Miyr underneath the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.

Fingerprint Stone Shield.text: Loot: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital). Found in the platforming segment leading to the Frenzied Flame Proscription. NOTE: Morgott, the Omen King must be defeated before this area can be accessed. If Morgott is still alive, a golden seal will block the path.

Fingerslayer Blade.text: Nokron, Eternal City (Night's Sacred Ground). Area: inside the treasure chest at the end of the Silver Tear-infested path.

Fire's Deadly Sin.text: Painting Item: Altus Plateau. Left behind by the spirit of an artist located near the southern cliffs at the top of Dominula, Windmill Village, south of the Windmill Heights Site of Grace after acquiring "Flightless Bird" Painting.

Firebone Arrow.text: Recipe is included with Armorer's Cookbook [2], which can be purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Western Limgrave) for 1500 runes.

Firebone Arrow (Fletched).text: Recipe is included with Armorer's Cookbook [2], which can be purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Western Limgrave) for 1500 runes.

Firebone Bolt.text: Recipe is included with Armorer's Cookbook [2], which can be purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Western Limgrave) for 1500 runes.

Fireproof Dried Liver.text: Can be crafted after acquiring the Armorer's Cookbook [1] from a camp of Kaiden Sellswords northeast of the Agheel Lake North Site of Grace. 1 found in a cellar full of Giant Rats entered from Stormveil Castle's the courtyard (it's the one with a Stonesword Key gate leading to the room with the Godskin Prayerbook and Godslayer's Seal).

Fireproof Pickled Liver.text: Can be crafted after acquiring the Forager Brood Cookbook [2] in Gravesite Plain. Talk to the forager brood member located on a small hill, near the cliffs east of Prospect Town. 2 sold for 4,000 Runes by Moore. 1 found in Specimen Storehouse, close to the Storehouse, First Floor site of grace. On the floor by the head of the large antlered creature.

Firespark Perfume Bottle.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain. Acquired from a chest in the southeastern corner of the military encampment by the Castle Front site of grace.

Flail.text: Loot: Limgrave. Found near Gatefront Ruins, located in the black carriage furthest east from Gatefront's marker. Drop: Brother Corhyn. Dropped by Brother Corhyn at any point during his questline depending on the player's actions. It can also be obtained by killing him.

Flamberge.text: Loot: Redmane Castle (Caelid). Found atop a tower to the right of the stairs up to the courtyard with the Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight boss fight, guarded by a Mad Pumpkin Head. WARNING: This door is locked during the Radahn Festival, requiring the defeat of Starscourge Radahn and speaking to Castellan Jerren to reset the Castle to its regular state.

Flame Crest Wooden Shield.text: Loot: Ailing Village (Weeping Peninsula). Found on a corpse in the easternmost cabin in the Village.

Flame Fortification.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for runes 3,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn. Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

Flame Sling.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for small 800 Runes by Brother Corhyn. Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

Flame of the Fell God.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Received upon defeating Adan, Thief of Fire, the boss trapped in the Malefactor's Evergaol.

Flame, Cleanse Me.text: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. Flame, Cleanse Me can be looted from a corpse at the Fire Monk campsite located south of the Church of Vows in eastern Liurnia.

Flame, Fall Upon Them.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for runes 10,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Giant's Prayerbook.

Flame, Grant Me Strength.text: This incantation can be located on a body behind/on the eastern side of Fort Gael in Caelid. It is guarded by two Flame Chariots.

Flame, Protect Me.text: Loot: Mountaintops of the Giants. Flame, Protect Me can be found in the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave in the Mountaintops of the Giants. It is located behind an imp statue fog wall right next to the dungeon's grace. One Stonesword Key is required to access it.

Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Minor Erdtree (Caelid). Dropped along with the Greenburst Crystal Tear by the Putrid Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Caelid, down the cliffs north-east of the Smoldering Church.

Flamedrake Talisman.text: Guaranteed drop: Groveside Cave (Limgrave). Obtained by defeating the Beastman of Farum Azula boss fight at the end of the cave.

Flask of Cerulean Tears.text: Obtained after reaching the Stranded Graveyard at the start of the game.

Flask of Crimson Tears.text: Quest Reward: Stranded Graveyard (Limgrave). Automatically acquired after reaching the Stranded Graveyard at the start of the game.

Flask of Wondrous Physick.text: Found in a basin in the Third Church of Marika, together with one of the two Crimson Crystal Tears. If it hasn't been acquired before defeating two Shardbearers it can instead be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for 500 runes Runes.

Fleeting Microcosm.text: Purchased: Cathedral of Manus Metyr. Fleeting Microcosm may be purchased from Count Ymir for runes 20,000 Runes after ringing the bell at the Finger Ruins of Dheo. He sits on the throne in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr on the Scadu Altus, located in the Realm of Shadow.

Flock's Canvas Talisman.text: Drop: Sage Gowry. Obtained from the dead body of Sage Gowry after completing Millicent's questline, either by assisting her and then killing him, or killing her, and then visiting him to find him already dead.

Flowerstone Gavel.text: Quest item: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion (Jagged Peak). The Flowerstone Gavel (and the Priestess Heart) will be where the Dragon Communion Priestess once stood at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after Bayle the Dread is defeated. WARNING: If the Dragon Communion Priestess is given Thiollier's Concoction, she will not leave this item. Instead the player will receive her spirit ash and spell.

Flowing Curved Sword.text: Loot: Consecrated Snowfield. Found in a chest in the back of a Great Coffin in the middle of the Consecrated Snowfield, starting just southwest of the Inner Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace. At night the Coffin is guarded by two Night's Cavalry, making approaching it during daytime a much better idea.

Foot Soldier Cap.text: Chance to drop from Godrick Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

Foot Soldier Gauntlets.text: Chance to drop from Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

Foot Soldier Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Foot Soldier enemies that wear it.

Foot Soldier Helm.text: Chance to drop from Radahn Foot Soldier enemies.

Foot Soldier Helmet.text: Chance to drop from Raya Lucaria Foot Soldier enemies.

Foot Soldier Tabard.text: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Foot Soldier enemies.

Forked Greatsword.text: Drop: Road's End Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Minor Erdtree Catacombs & War-Dead Catacombs (Caelid) / Sainted Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Wyndham Catacombs (Mt. Gelmir) / Auriza Side Tomb (Capital Outskirts) / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital) / Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield).

Forked Hatchet.text: Drop: Fringefolk Hero's Grave & Stormfoot Catacombs & Murkwater Catacombs (Limgrave) / Impaler's Catacombs (Weeping Peninsula) / Road's End Catacombs & Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Wyndham Catacombs & Sainted Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Minor Erdtree Catacombs & War-Dead Catacombs (Caelid) / Auriza Side Tomb & Leyndell, Royal Capital & Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Capital Outskirts) / Giants' M…

Forked-Tongue Hatchet.text: Drop: Fog Rift Catacombs (Gravesite Plain) / Darklight Catacombs (Scadu Altus) / Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base). 2% drop chance from hatchet-wielding Fanged Imps in the Realm of Shadow.

Formic Rock.text: Found near Ainsel River and other places where giant ants live.

Fortissax's Lightning Spear.text: Trade the Remembrance of the Lichdragon, gained by defeating Lichdragon Fortissax, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Founding Rain of Stars.text: Loot: Heretical Rise, Mountaintops of the Giants. You'll need to walk over an invisible bridge across the valley directly east of the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook Site of Grace.

Four-Toed Fowl Foot.text: Farming: More than 10 of the ideal farming target, Guillemots, can be found on the beach west and northwest of the Fourth Church of Marika in western Weeping Peninsula. Using something silent like the sorcery Freezing Mist or the skill Chilling Mist, or a Bow or Light Bow is ideal since the many birds are likely to take off when alerted.

Freezing Mist.text: Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 6,000 Runes by Preceptor Seluvis. Should Seluvis die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Seluvis's Bell Bearing.

Freezing Pot.text: Recipe is included with Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook 6, found in a room in the south-eastern wall of Caria Manor on the ground level.

Frenzied Burst.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Frenzied Burst drops from a Scarab guarded by Frenzied Rats in the middle of a small forest, directly south of the Church of Inhibition in Liurnia.

Frenzied Flame Seal.text: Loot: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital/Leyndell, Ashen Capital). Received by completing Lightseeker Hyetta's questline by accepting the blessing of the Three Fingers and then touching her.

Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle.text: Loot: Abandoned Church (Abyssal Woods). Pillaged from a seated corpse located by the northern wall of the Church Ruins.

Frenzyflame Stone.text: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. Found on a ledge southeast of the Ruined Labyrinth Site of Grace, southwest of the Minor Erdtree of East Liurnia. Found on a corpse sitting in a ring of chairs southeast of the Frenzied Flame Village Outskirts Site of Grace. Quest Item: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

Freyja's Armor.text: Guaranteed Drop & Loot from Redmane Freyja at either of the following locations:. Specimen Storehouse - If the player chooses to kill her by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace, as it is the first location where she's vulnerable to being attacked.

Freyja's Armor (Altered).text: Acquired from altering Freyja's Armor. Which can be acquired once per playthrough (outside of having it be left by another player during online play) from either of the following locations:. Specimen Storehouse - If the player chooses to kill her by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace, as it is the first location where she's vulnerable to being attacked.

Freyja's Blood Greatsword.text: Drop: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep) / Enir-Ilim. This weapon can be obtained wherever Redmane Freyja dies. If you gave her Freyja's Letter, you can find Freyja's Greatsword on her body after defeating her during the boss against Needle Knight Leda and her allies. Otherwise, it can be found by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace after defeating Leda and her allies.

If you gave her Freyja's Letter, you can find Freyja's Greatsword on her body after defeating her during the boss against Needle Knight Leda and her allies. Otherwise, it can be found by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace after defeating Leda and her allies.

Frozen Armament.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Acquired from felling a Scarab on the road northwest of the Behind Caria Manor Site of Grace.

Frozen Lightning Spear.text: Guaranteed Drop: Ainsel River. Frozen Lightning Spear is acquired after defeating the Dragonkin Soldier of Nokstella.

Frozen Maggot.text: Found in the Belurat Gaol, Lamenter's Gaol and Bonny Gaol. Also dropped by the Shadow Prisoners.

Frozen Needle.text: Loot: Kingsrealm Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes). Found inside a chest after beating the Royal Revenant boss inside the Kingsrealm Ruins.

Frozen Raisin.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [23], found in the Consecrated Snowfield, north of the Consecrated Snowfield grace.

Fulgurbloom.text: Fulgurbloom grows abundantly in spots where lightning strikes regularly. This is most common in Altus Plateau but there are also some spots in Limgrave and Mountaintops of the Giants. In Limgrave, 14 flowers can be found early on the hill just north of the Agheel Lake North site of grace or east of the Gatefront site of grace. In Liurnia, 14 can be found in the waters east of Tetsu's Rise.

Full Moon Crossbow.text: Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes). Found inside a chest up a tower on the rooftops of Raya Lucaria.

Fur Leggings.text: Fur Leggings have a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors.

Fur Raiment.text: Fur Raiment has a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors.

Furious Blade of Ansbach.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim. Complete Sir Ansbach's questline while siding with him against Needle Knight Leda and defeat Promised Consort Radahn and then this Incantation (as well as Ansbach's Set and the Obsidian Lamina) can be found on his body, just to the right after entering the boss arena again.

Furlcalling Finger Remedy.text: Sold by Merchant Kalé in Church of Elleh (x5). Sold by Patches in Murkwater Cave (x3). Sold by Gatekeeper Gostoc in Stormveil Castle (x4).

Furled Finger's Trick-Mirror.text: Purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

Furnace Keeper's Note.text: Loot: Scadu Altus. Acquired from inside a tent by th wall east of the Shadow Keeps main gate.

Furnace Visage.text: Guaranteed drop from any Furnace Golem. x3 can be obtained from Hornsent (character) if he is given a Scorpion Stew. A Furnace Visage has an 8% chance to drop from the 6 Messmer Foot Soldiers by the ruined Furnace Golem immediately south of Shadow Keep, northeast of the Messmer Soldier camp.

Gaius's Armor.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 12000 from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Commander Gaius.

Gaius's Gauntlets.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 8000 from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Commander Gaius.

Gaius's Greaves.text: Guaranteed Drop: Scaduview (Shadow Keep). Dropped from a wolf-riding Albinauric Archer near the Albinauric's Shack, which can be found by the road between Commander Gaius's arena and the Scadutree Chalice.

Gaius's Helm.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 8000 from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Commander Gaius.

Gargoyle's Black Axe.text: Guaranteed drop: Grand Lift of Rold (Forbidden Lands). Received upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold, along with the Gargoyle's Black Blades.

Gargoyle's Black Blades.text: Guaranteed drop: Grand Lift of Rold (Forbidden Lands). Received upon defeating Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold, along with the Gargoyle's Black Axe.

Gargoyle's Black Halberd.text: Dropped upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred guarding the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid.

Gargoyle's Blackblade.text: Guaranteed drop: Bestial Sanctum (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow). Dropped upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred outside of the Bestial Sanctum, along with the Gargoyle's Black Halberd.

Gargoyle's Great Axe.text: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau. Received upon defeating the Valiant Gargoyle enemy just north of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace located in Altus Plateau.

Gargoyle's Greatsword.text: Guaranteed drop: Siofra Aqueduct (Siofra River). Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyles duo boss, along with the Gargoyle's Twinblade.

Gargoyle's Halberd.text: Received upon defeating the Gargoyle enemy near the West Capital Rampart grace, located in Leyndell.

Gargoyle's Twinblade.text: Guaranteed Drop: Siofra River. Dropped by the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss, along with the Gargoyle's Greatsword.

Gas Stone.text: Found lying amongst the slag heaps in the ruined forges of the Realm of Shadow.

Gauntlets of Night.text: Loot: Bonny Gaol (Scadu Altus). Recovered from a body lying on a guillotine-table. Located on a somewhat hidden floor of the gaol. To reach this floor, the player must progress through the dungeon until they reach a jar-elevator that has already begun to move on its own.

Gauntlets of Solitude.text: Guaranteed Drop: Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from defeating the Blackgaol Knight located in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

Gavel of Haima.text: Converted Fringe Tower, north-east Liurnia of the Lakes, not to be mistaken with the Converted Tower in the south-west. You will need to use the Erudition gesture given by Thops in front of the statue of Marika. This will reveal a hidden ladder to the top of the tower with a treasure chest that contains the spell, alongside Cannon of Haima.

Gazing Finger.text: Trade: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers. The weapon can be obtained upon trading the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

Gelmir Glintstone Staff.text: Drop: Mt. Gelmir. 11.11% drop chance from the egg-headed Man-Serpent near the throne in Volcano Manor, right before Rykard's teleporter at the end of the area.

Gelmir Knight Armor.text: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is.

Gelmir Knight Armor (Altered).text: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Gelmir Knight Gauntlets.text: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is.

Gelmir Knight Greaves.text: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is.

Gelmir Knight Helm.text: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is.

Gelmir's Fury.text: Quest Item: Volcano Manor. Acquired from Knight Bernahl in the Drawing Room of Volcano Manor after successfully defeating Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm with him. This sorcery will be left unobtainable for the rest of the playthrough should Bernahl die before the player joins Volcano Manor.

Ghiza's Wheel.text: Guaranteed Drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir). Dropped by the Inquisitor Ghiza invader in the Volcano Manor.

Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [1.text: Found in a gazebo just after the Nokron, Eternal City Site of Grace, found when entering Nokron, Eternal City from the big crater in Limgrave.

Ghostflame Bloom.text: Ghostflame Bloom may be harvested around Charo's Hidden Grave.

Ghostflame Breath.text: Dragon Communion: Limgrave / Caelid / Jagged Peak. Acquired from the altar at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 3 Dragon Hearts.

Ghostflame Torch.text: Loot: Siofra River. Found on a corpse on the rooftops near the entrance of Nokron, Eternal City. This section of rooftops can only be accessed when entering through the crater in Limgrave (only accessible after deating Starscourge Radahn).

Giant Golden Arc.text: Loot: Scadu Altus. Found in the Ruins of Unte, within the courtyard blocked by a deactivated Furnace Golem. Reactivate the Furnace Golem with a Hefty Furnace Pot thrown from the top of one of the outer ruins in order to enter the courtyard. The incantation can be found in a chest within the courtyard shrine.

Giant Rat Ashes.text: Found on a corpse in the stable just northeast of the West Windmill Pasture.

Giant's Prayerbook.text: Found in a Chest at the top of the Guardians' Garrison tower, guarded by Chief Guardian Arghanthy.

Giant's Red Braid.text: Trade: Finger Reader Enia. Trade the Remembrance of the Fire Giant, gained by defeating Fire Giant, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Giant's Seal.text: Loot: Mountaintops of the Giants. Found near a Fire Prelate enemy inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, reached by taking an elevator down and then sending it up again, then pulling the elevator's lever to ride down another floor using a hidden compartment and then finally climbing up a ladder to the left to find the room.

Giant-Crusher.text: Found inside a carriage south of Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace, located in Altus Plateau.

Giantsflame Take Thee.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for runes 13,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Giant's Prayerbook.

Gilded Foot Soldier Cap.text: Chance to drop from Leyndell Foot Soldier enemies.

Gilded Greatshield.text: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula. 4% drop chance from Godrick Knights. One spear-wielding Knight can be found at Gatefront Ruins. Two greatsword-wielding Knights can be found inside of the Godrick Soldier camp between Warmaster's Shack and Deathtouched Catacombs.

Gilded Iron Shield.text: Loot: Church of Pilgrimage (Weeping Peninsula). Found on a corpse in the small graveyard west of the Church. It's on the westernmost grave, reached in an almost straight line west from the Sacred Tear in the church.

Glaive.text: Dropped by Graveyard Skeleton enemies that wield it such as the one near the Sellia Backstreets grace in Caelid.

Glass Shard.text: Patches in Murkwater Cave (unlimited stock). Found scattered throughout the Lands Between, often as bait to lure the player into ambushes.

Glintblade Phalanx.text: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 2,500 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Royal House Scroll.

Glintblade Trio.text: Loot: Castle Ensis. After progressing through the chapel section, go through the iron gate and fall off a ledge directly to the left. Go around the cliff and climb up the ladders to the rooftop of the chapel. Head northwest and jump down onto a platform, and you will find a corpse that has the spell.

Glinting Nail.text: Can be crafted after acquiring the Finger-Weaver's Cookbook [1], on a corpse located inside the Finger-Weaver's Hovel. The shack can be accessed from an incline found in the southwestern corner of the Finger Ruins of Rhia.

Glintslab Firefly.text: Found in Castle Ensis and in the lake around the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.

Glintstone Arc.text: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold. One of the starting spells of the Astrologer Origin. x1 Sold for 1,500 Runes by Sorceress Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins. x1 Sold for 1,500 Runes by Sorcerer Thops at Church of Irith.

Glintstone Breath.text: Dragon Communion: Caelid. Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 1 Dragon Heart.

Glintstone Cometshard.text: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 12,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Conspectus Scroll.

Glintstone Firefly.text: Found near large, blue crystals found in Liurnia of the Lakes and Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. In Liurnia of the Lakes, well over a dozen can be found by heading to the Folly on the Lake Site of Grace near the Village of the Albinaurics and heading southwest. There are some Crystalians throughout the path but it is otherwise largely dangerfree.

Glintstone Icecrag.text: Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 7,500 Runes by Preceptor Seluvis. Should Seluvis die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Seluvis's Bell Bearing.

Glintstone Kris.text: Received if siding with Sorceress Sellen against Castellan Jerren in Academy of Raya Lucaria near the end of her questline.

Glintstone Nail.text: Purchased: Cathedral of Manus Metyr. Glintstone Nail may be purchased from Count Ymir for runes 12,000 Runes after ringing the bell in the Finger Ruins of Rhia.

Glintstone Nails.text: Purchased: Cathedral of Manus Metyr. Glintstone Nails may be purchased from Count Ymir for runes 12,000 Runes after ringing the bell in the Finger Ruins of Rhia.

Glintstone Pebble.text: Equipped:. One of the starting spells of the Astrologer Origin. Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Scadu Altus. x1 Sold for 1,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins.

Glintstone Scarab.text: Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes). The Glintstone Scarab is found inside a chest near the Glintstone Sorcerers who summon the giant rolling ball after the Debate Parlor Site of Grace in Raya Lucaria.

Glintstone Scrap.text: Some can be found in the Limgrave Tunnels. Drops from the Glintstone variety of Miners. Can be purchased in unlimited quantity from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing 1.

Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes.text: Dropped by the Spiritcaller Snail in Road's End Catacombs.

Glintstone Staff.text: Equip:. Starting equipment for the Prisoner class. Guaranteed drop: Limgrave. Guaranteed drop from a Sorcerer Noble just south of Waypoint Ruins, just west of the graveyard with Wolves (one-time drop only).

Glintstone Stars.text: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Caelid / Roundtable Hold. x1 Sold for 3,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins. x1 Sold for 3,000 Runes by Sage Gowry after he has repaired the snapped Unalloyed Gold Needle.

Glintstone Whetblade.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Debate Parlor). Area: On a corpse in the room below two Glintstone Sorcerers. Proceed north from the Site of Grace, immediately turn west after entering the large courtyard and continue up the destroyed staircase.

Gloried Attire.text: Loot: Rauh Base (Land of the Tower). Acquired from a corpse near the edge of a small cliff, found in the forest northwest of the Ravine North site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Rugalea the Great Red Bear.

Glovewort Crystal Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Charo's Hidden Grave. Dropped by the Furnace Golem found among the western cliffs of Charo's Hidden Grave. This Furnace Golem has armored legs, requiring Hefty Fire Pots or Hefty Furnace Pots thrown into its head-basket to defeat it.

Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [1].text: Dropped by the Lightning-attuned Erdtree Burial Watchdog at the end of Wyndham Catacombs.

Glowstone.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [1], sold by Merchant Kalé.

Godfrey Icon.text: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau. Obtained from the Golden Lineage Evergaol in southern Altus Plateau, by defeating Godefroy the Grafted.

Godrick Knight Armor.text: Chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies.

Godrick Knight Armor (Altered).text: Chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies. Can be altered by Boc.

Godrick Knight Gauntlets.text: 3% chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies.

Godrick Knight Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies.

Godrick Knight Helm.text: Chance to drop from Godrick Knight enemies.

Godrick Soldier Ashes.text: Found in a cemetery on the west side of Stormhill.

Godrick Soldier Gauntlets.text: Chance to drop by Godrick Soldier enemies.

Godrick Soldier Greaves.text: Chance to drop by Godrick Soldier enemies.

Godrick Soldier Helm.text: Chance to drop from Godrick Soldier enemies.

Godrick's Great Rune.text: Upon defeat of Godrick the Grafted. Restored at the Divine Tower of Limgrave, accessible from the sending gate past the Limgrave Tower Bridge Site of Grace within Stormveil Castle.

Godskin Apostle Bracelets.text: Received alongside with the rest of the set upon defeating the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

Godskin Apostle Hood.text: Received alongside with the rest of the set upon defeating the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

Godskin Apostle Robe.text: Received alongside with the rest of the set upon defeating the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

Godskin Apostle Trousers.text: Received alongside with the rest of the set upon defeating the Godskin Apostle boss at the bottom of the Divine Tower of Caelid.

Godskin Noble Bracelets.text: Part of the Godskin Noble Set, acquired after defeating the Godskin Noble at the Liurnia Tower Bridge.

Godskin Noble Hood.text: Part of the Godskin Noble Set, acquired after defeating the Godskin Noble at the Liurnia Tower Bridge.

Godskin Noble Robe.text: Part of the Godskin Noble Set, acquired after defeating the Godskin Noble at the Liurnia Tower Bridge.

Godskin Noble Trousers.text: Part of the Godskin Noble Set, acquired after defeating the Godskin Noble at the Liurnia Tower Bridge.

Godskin Peeler.text: Guaranteed Drop: Dominula, Windmill Village (Altus Plateau). Dropped by the Godskin Apostle at the end of Dominula, Windmill Village.

Godskin Prayerbook.text: Stormveil Castle: found inside a chest behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open. The cellar entrance can be found to the left of the courtyard if entered via the main gate and is guarded over by some rats.

Godskin Stitcher.text: Guaranteed drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir). Received upon defeating the Godskin Noble boss found in Volcano Manor.

Godskin Swaddling Cloth.text: Obtained from the Spiritcaller's Cave in northeastern Mountaintops of the Giants, by defeating all of the bosses at the end of the dungeon.

Godslayer's Greatsword.text: Loot: Divine Tower of Caelid (Caelid). Found in a treasure chest at the end of the Divine Tower of Caelid, behind the Godskin Apostle boss.

Godslayer's Seal.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle. Found inside a chest behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open. The cellar entrance can be found to the left in the castle courtyard (the one just before the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace) if entered via the main gate and is guarded over by four rats.

Gold Firefly.text: Found near waters close to Minor Erdtrees.

Gold Scarab.text: Obtained by defeating the dual Cleanrot Knight in the Abandoned Cave in central Caelid. This cave can be reached by heading east of the Smoldering Wall, and using a large dead tree root to traverse a canyon.

Gold Tattoo (Arm).text: Obtained after defeating The Noble Broken Mask invader in Leyndell, Royal Capital. He appears after using Law of Regression on the Radagon statue.

Gold Tattoo (Chest).text: Obtained after defeating The Noble Broken Mask invader in Leyndell, Royal Capital. He appears after using Law of Regression on the Radagon statue.

Gold Tattoo (Leg).text: Obtained after defeating The Noble Broken Mask invader in Leyndell, Royal Capital. He appears after using Law of Regression on the Radagon statue.

Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot.text: Recipe is included with Missionary's Cookbook [2], sold by Patches for 800 runes. Purchased from Patches in Murkwater Cave (x3).

Gold-Tinged Excrement.text: Gold-Tinged Excrement is found hidden in forests and thickets throughout the Lands Between.

Golden Arcs.text: Loot: Scadu Altus. Found in an already opened chest within the pit in Moorth Ruins in a shrine guarded by three Inquisitors.

Golden Arrow.text: Sold by the Hermit Merchant of Capital Outskirts for 120 Runes.

Golden Beast Crest Shield.text: Guaranteed drop: Chapel of Anticipation. Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation, along with the Ornamental Straight Sword. The Chapel can be revisited by using the "Precipice of Anticipation" Waygate at The Four Belfries, which is the second waygate from the top.

Golden Bolt.text: Random Drop:. Loot:. Purchase:. Purchased from the Hermit Merchant of Capital Outskirts for 120 Runes.

Golden Braid.text: Loot: Shaman Village. It can be found in the Shaman Village in front of the Grandmother in the trunk of a decayed tree on a hill.

Golden Centipede.text: Some non-respawnable centipedes are found in areas associated with either Those Who Live in Death or the Golden Order. Two found in Siofra Aqueduct, just before the fog gate to the Valiant Gargoyles duo boss. Found in Siofra Aqueduct in a room hidden behind a waterfall after, also just before the Valiant Gargoyles. Six found near the Minor Erdtree Church, at the base of a large tree.

Golden Epitaph.text: Found at the entrance of Auriza Hero's Grave. Requires a Stonesword Key to access and is guarded by a Basilisk.

Golden Great Arrow.text: Purchase:. Purchased from the Hermit Merchant of Capital Outskirts for 500 runes. Loot:. 10 Golden Great Arrows can be found inside a chest in the Sage's Cave.

Golden Greatshield.text: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Mt. Gelmir / Leyndell, Royal Capital. 4% drop chance from Leyndell Knights (excluding the Greatbow-wielding ones but including the frenzied ones). The earliest Leyndell Knight can be found wandering alone just south of the Artist's Shack in Liurnia.

Golden Halberd.text: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave. Received upon defeating the Tree Sentinel in Limgrave.

Golden Lightning Fortification.text: Guaranteed Drop: Crumbling Farum Azula. Drops from a Scarab south of the Dragon Temple Lift Site of Grace, near an Ancient Dragon.

Golden Lion Shield.text: Quest Reward: Specimen Storehouse (Shadow Keep). Received from Freyja by the Storehouse, Seventh Floor site of grace, after having given her the "Letter for Freyja" key item, which in of itself can be acquired from Sir Ansbach after giving him the Secret Rite Scroll.

Golden Order Flail.text: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Obtained after defeating The Noble Broken Mask invader in Leyndell, Royal Capital, who appears after using Law of Regression on the Radagon statue found after an elevator beside the Erdtree Sanctuary Site of Grace.

Golden Order Greatsword.text: Guaranteed drop: Cave of the Forlorn (Consecrated Snowfield). Received upon defeating the Misbegotten Crusader at the end of the Cave of the Forlorn, located in the Consecrated Snowfield.

Golden Order Principia.text: Right above the Erdtree Sanctuary grace, on a corpse sitting on an elevated chair. To reach it, you need to head outside along the path that leads to the Queen's Bedchamber where a Black Knife Assassin will attack you.

Golden Order Seal.text: Loot: Capital Outskirts. Found at the tree inside of the Minor Erdtree Church, southwest of Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Golden Order Totality.text: Quest Item: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Received from Goldmask after telling him the truth about Radagon of the Golden Order.

Golden Rowa.text: Essentially Altus Plateau's equivalent of the regular Rowa Fruit, it can be found in similar spots (bushes). Around Mirage Rise, west-southwest of Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau), are a fair amount as well as in between the Rise and the Bower of Bounty site of grace a bit further east.

Golden Seed.text: Chapel of Anticipation. One of the possible choices of a Keepsake during Character Creation. Limgrave. Near Stormhill Shack on the road beyond Stormgate.

Golden Sunflower.text: Found near Minor Erdtrees in the Altus Plateau. Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau) has the highest concentration, though a decent amount can also be found around the Minor Erdtree (Capital Outskirts). The only known enemy to drop this item is a variant of Wandering Nobles that carries the Noble's Estoc and Aristocrat Hat (8% drop rate).

Golden Tailoring Tools.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Church of Vows). Area: inside the treasure chest to the side of the basin, alongside the Golden Sewing Needle.

Golden Vow.text: Loot: Mt. Gelmir. Located inside the Corpse-Stench Shack east of the broken stone bridge on the Road of Iniquity. Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater will also invade at this same spot.

Goldmask's Rags.text: Complete Goldmask's questline, then reload the area to loot the armor set from where you found him.

Golem Fist.text: Random Drop: Taylew's Ruined Forge (Rauh Base). 3% chance of dropping from Golem Smiths that use this weapon. ER Enemy Golem Smith Smithscript Fist.png|A golem smith that will drop this item. (Note how the color of its fists are different from the rest of its body). ER Enemy Golem Smith Unarmed.png|A normal golem smith for reference.

Golem Greatbow.text: Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Stormhill / Greyoll's Dragonbarrow / Liurnia of the Lakes / Capital Outskirts / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Leyndell, Ashen Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants / Scadu Altus / Charo's Hidden Grave. 10% chance to drop from Guardian Golem enemies that wield it (5% from non-respawning ones).

Golem's Great Arrow.text: |-|Retail=. Retail: Random Drop:. 5% chance of dropping from Greatbow-wielding Guardian Golems. (Always drops in a bundle of x5 arrows at a time.). |-|1.00=.

Golem's Halberd.text: Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Stormhill / Greyoll's Dragonbarrow / Liurnia of the Lakes / Capital Outskirts / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Leyndell, Ashen Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. 10% chance to drop from Guardian Golem enemies that wield it (5% from non-respawning ones).

Golem's Magic Arrow.text: Random Drop:. 5% chance of dropping from the magic greatbow-wielding Guardian Golems guarding the path to the Colosseum in Caelid. (Always drops in a bundle of x5 arrows at a time.).

Gourmet Scorpion Stew.text: Quest Reward: Belurat, Tower Settlement. Given by the Hornsent Grandam if spoken to after defeating Messmer the Impaler. A second one can be gained by speaking to her until she falls asleep and then reloading the area and returning to her.

Grace Mimic.text: Recipe is included with Missionary's Cookbook [2], sold by Patches for 800 runes. Sold by Patches in Murkwater Cave (x15).

Grafted Blade Greatsword.text: Guaranteed Drop: Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula). Defeat the Leonine Misbegotten at the end of the castle.

Grafted Dragon.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Grafted, gained by defeating Godrick the Grafted, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Grave Cricket.text: Found in Charo's Hidden Grave and around stone coffins on the Cerulean Coast.

Grave Keeper's Brainpan.text: Found scattered around Charo's Hidden Grave.

Grave Scythe.text: Has a base 2% drop chance from the Skeleton enemies wielding it.

Grave Violet.text: Grave Violets can be harvested in catacombs throughout the Lands Between. Jarburg. Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

Gravebird Anklets.text: Loot: Scadu Altus (Realm of Shadow). Found on a corpse leaning against one of the statues in the poison swamp, located past the cave north of Moorth Ruins.

Gravebird Armor.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow). Located next to an arch-covered coffin, on a hill next to the rocky mountain walls, northwest of the entrance to Belurat Gaol.

Gravebird Bracelets.text: Loot: Pillar Path (Gravesite Plain). Found on a corpse that's seated on a stone platform, located on the road between the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace and the Supressing Pillar.

Gravebird Helm.text: Loot: Spiral Rise (Enir-Ilim). Can be found on top of a stone altar in one of the floors above the Spiral Rise site of grace. To reach this item, get passed the section with the Gravebirds, then past the rooftops with the snowstorm-conjuring Divine Beast Warrior, until re-entering the spiral rise to witness an Inquisitor taking an elevator up.

Gravebird's Blackquill Armor.text: Loot: Rauh Base (Land of the Tower). Found on a corpse on top of a hill that's littered with gravebird statues, by the river north of the Temple Town site of grace.

Gravekeeper Cloak.text: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist-type enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.

Gravekeeper Cloak (Altered).text: Can only be obtained unaltered as a rare drop from Duelist-type enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Gravel Stone.text: Found in lands once beset by ancient dragons.

Gravel Stone Seal.text: Guaranteed loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Dropped by a specific spear-wielding Leyndell Knight, found just to the left when standing outside of the front gate to the Fortified Manor.

Graven-Mass Talisman.text: Loot: Albinauric Rise (Consecrated Snowfield). Obtained from a chest atop the Albinauric Rise.

Graven-School Talisman.text: Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes). Obtained from a large pile of crystals in Raya Lucaria Academy. From the room west of the Debate Parlor, just before the fight with the Red Wolf of Radagon, look for an empty bookshelf on the north side of the room, which is an illusory wall. Dispell it, head into the next room, and climb a ladder.

Gravitational Missile.text: Dropped by the Fallingstar Beast found in the crater north of the Finger Ruins of Dheo.

Gravity Stone Chunk.text: Chest in Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid. This item may be purchased in unlimited supply from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing. The Bell Bearing is dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter that invades at the Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow)'s shack. Dropped as loot from Starcallers.

Gravity Stone Fan.text: Chest in Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid. This item may be purchased in unlimited supply from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing. The Bell Bearing is dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter that invades at the Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow)'s shack. Dropped as loot from Starcallers.

Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing.text: Guaranteed Drop: Isolated Merchant's Shack (Dragonbarrow). Dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter outside the Isolated Merchant’s shack at nighttime.

Gravity Well.text: Guaranteed Drop: Academy of Raya Lucaria. Acquired from defeating the Alabaster Lord that appears at the end of the graveyard, by the elevator that leads up to the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace.

Greasemonger's Bell Bearing.text: Loot: Scadu Altus. Acquired from a rope-strung pot that can be found hanging from the rocky mountain wall, west of the road between the Bridge Leading to Village site of grace and the Church District Highroad site of grace. The ledge overlooking the pot is occupied by a pack of wolves. The pot must be destroyed with a projectile for the item to become accessible.

Great Arrow.text: Patches in Murkwater Cave (x10). Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region (x8).

Great Club.text: Guaranteed Drop: Old Altus Tunnel (Altus Plateau). Received upon defeating the Stonedigger Troll located inside the Old Altus Tunnel. It requires two Stonesword Keys to access.

Great Glintstone Shard.text: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 2,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Academy Scroll.

Great Heal.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for runes 9,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn after he moves to Altus Plateau. Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

Great Horned Headband.text: Great Horned Headband has a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors.

Great Katana.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain. Found on a corpse in the lake on the northern Gravesite Plain, west of Abandoned Ailing Village, where the Ghostflame Dragon is fought. Comes equipped with the Ash of War: Overhead Stance by default.

Great Knife.text: Starting equipment for the Bandit class. 2% drop chance from Small Demi-Humans. The earliest farming spot is just inside Lakeside Crystal Cave, where one can be found hiding inside of a bush next to a regular Demi-Human. The most efficient farming spot is just north of the Craftsman's Shack Site of Grace on Mt. Gelmir, where four of them are hiding amongst a flock of Sheep.

Great Mace.text: Loot: Bellum Highway (Liurnia of the Lakes). Found inside a chest in a tent around the southern set of trebuchets before the Grand Lift of Dectus in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Great Omenkiller Cleaver.text: Guaranteed drop: Perfumer's Grotto (Altus Plateau) / Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir). Received upon defeating the Omenkiller & Miranda the Blighted Bloom duo boss inside the Perfumer's Grotto in Altus Plateau. Dropped once by an Omenkiller in Volcano Manor, found by a bonfire behind a gate just before the bridge leading to the building with the Guest Hall Site of Grace.

Great Oracular Bubble.text: Guaranteed Drop: Siofra River. Acquired from felling a Scarab surrounded by Claymen inside of a large building on the southwestern quarter of the level with the Dragonkin Soldier. The level can be accessed from Siofra river through a Portal found on some ruins south of the Worshippers' Woods Site of Grace.

Great Stars.text: Loot: Altus Plateau. Found inside a wandering caravan near the Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace. Guaranteed Drop: Writheblood Ruins (Altus Plateau). As of patch 1.06, this weapon is also dropped by Magnus the Beast Claw upon defeat.

Great Turtle Shell.text: Loot: Weeping Peninsula. Found atop the tower to the south of Oridys's Rise. Only reachable by using the spiritspring near the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace to jump to the top of the tower.

Great Épée.text: Loot: Limgrave. Acquired from a treasure chest by a tent in a Campsite by some Fallen Ruins east of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. It is guarded by two Kaiden Mercenaries and a particularly eagle-eyed Noble Sorcerer.

Great-Jar's Arsenal.text: Rewarded by the Great Jar, after defeating 3 Great Jar's Warriors, in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. This area can only be approached from Deep Siofra Well. Speaking with the Great Jar will cause 3 duelist summon signs to appear on the ground. Defeat all 3 duelists in turn to be rewarded with the talisman.

Greataxe.text: Loot: Limgrave. Found inside a carriage hauled by two Trolls that is heading south on the road west of the Waypoint Ruins in Limgrave. The carriage must be stopped before the chest can be opened, requiring at least one troll be either killed or incapacitated.

Greatblade Phalanx.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Acquired from defeating Bols, Carian Knight in the Cuckoo's Evergaol.

Greatbow.text: Loot: Altus Plateau. Found inside a chest on top of the Highway Lookout Tower in northern Altus, just on the border to the Capital Outskirts. Drop: Caelid / Altus Plateau & Leyndell, Royal Capital / Deeproot Depths / Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree (Miquella's Haligtree) / Scadu Altus / Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base) / Shadow Keep.

Greathelm.text: Bought from the Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid).

Greathood.text: Having seen "Sorcerer" Painting is required in order to get that item. Found on the ground after reaching the place that is depicted in the painting, on a bridge west of Mountaintops of the Giants.

Greathorn Hammer.text: Greathorn Hammer has a 2% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Warriors who wield it.

Greatjar.text: Loot: Belurat Gaol (Gravesite Plain). Found by the Greatjar altar towards the end of the dungeon. Once arrived at the final open area, past the maze of jars. There will be an idle jar-elevator to the right side of the bottomless fissure. Jumping down, on top of this hanging jar will make it begin to ascend.

Greatshield Soldier Ashes.text: Found on a corpse in Nokron, Eternal City, south-east of the Nokron, Eternal City Site of Grace.

Greatshield Talisman.text: Loot: Altus Plateau. Obtained from a chest, within a black carriage, east of Erdtree-Gazing Hill Site of Grace, in western Altus Plateau. The location is more precisely east southeast of Lux Ruins and almost straight north from the Grand Lift of Dectus.

Greatsword.text: Loot: Caelid. The found in a chest on the backside of a Carriage beside the road heading northwest from Caelem Ruins. The location is southwest of the Minor Erdtree in Caelid and the Minor Erdtree Catacombs.

Greatsword of Damnation.text: Trade: Finger Reader Enia. Trade the Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame, gained by defeating Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Greatsword of Radahn (Light).text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of a God and a Lord, gained by defeating the Promised Consort Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Greatsword of Radahn (Lord).text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of a God and a Lord, gained by defeating the Promised Consort Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Greatsword of Solitude.text: Guaranteed drop: Western Nameless Mausoleum (Gravesite Plain). Dropped by the Knight of the Solitary Gaol found inside of the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

Greaves of Night.text: Loot: Bonny Gaol (Scadu Altus). Recovered from a body lying on a guillotine-table. Located on a somewhat hidden floor of the gaol. To reach this floor, the player must progress through the dungeon until they reach a jar-elevator that has already begun to move on its own.

Greaves of Solitude.text: Guaranteed Drop: Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from defeating the Blackgaol Knight located in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

Green Turtle Talisman.text: Loot: Summonwater Village (Limgrave). Obtained from a chest in the cellar of Summonwater Village, in northern Limgrave. The cellar is locked behind a semi-transparent fog wall that can be unlocked by inserting one Stonesword Key into the adjacent imp statue.

Greenburst Crystal Tear.text: Guaranteed Drop: Minor Erdtree (Caelid) (Caelid). Dropped by the Putrid Avatar at the north-western Minor Erdtree in Caelid, near the Smoldering Church where you fight Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater and along with the Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear.

Greenspill Crystal Tear.text: Loot: Minor Erdtree (Limgrave). Found at an altar near Mistwood's Minor Erdtree, along with the Spiked Cracked Tear.

Greyoll's Roar.text: Dragon Communion: Caelid. Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 3 Dragon Hearts after felling Elder Dragon Greyoll.

Grossmesser.text: Drop: Tombsward Catacombs (Weeping Peninsula) / Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Caelid Catacombs (Caelid) / Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau) / Gelmir Hero's Grave (Mt. Gelmir) / Stone Coffin Fissure. 2% drop chance from the Skeleton enemies that wield it. They will solely be armed with the Grossmesser.

Guardian Bracers.text: 1.5% chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies that wear it.

Guardian Garb.text: Chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies that wear it. Cannot be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Guardian Garb (Full Bloom).text: Chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies that wear it, such as the ones in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Cannot be unaltered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Guardian Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies.

Guardian Mask.text: Chance to drop from Erdtree Guardian enemies.

Guardian's Swordspear.text: Erdtree Guardian enemies have a ~2% chance to drop this item.

Guilty Hood.text: Found on a corpse in a ditch near the Avenue Balcony site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Sold by the Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir) for 500 runes.

Gurranq's Beast Claw.text: Quest Item: Bestial Sanctum, Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. Gurranq's Beast Claw is rewarded from Gurranq after giving him the eight Deathroot. (However, only after Gurranq has been calmed down after he turns hostile on the player's return to him after consuming the fourth Deathroot.).

Haima Glintstone Crown.text: Guaranteed drop: Altus Plateau. A Battlemage enemy drops the entire set the first time you defeat him, directly north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace, up on a hill behind the bridge where you first meet Goldmask.

Halberd.text: Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge (x1). Starting equipment of the Vagabond class.

Haligbone Arrow.text: Recipe is included with Missionary's Cookbook [4], found in the Minor Erdtree Church in Altus Plateau.

Haligbone Arrow (Fletched).text: Recipe is included with Missionary's Cookbook [4], found in the Minor Erdtree Church in Altus Plateau.

Haligbone Bolt.text: Recipe is included with Missionary's Cookbook [4], found in the Minor Erdtree Church in Altus Plateau.

Haligdrake Talisman.text: Obtained from a corpse in Stranded Graveyard, in western Limgrave. This corpse can be seen from the beginning of the game, hanging from a cliff behind where the player wakes up after dying at the Chapel of Anticipation, but cannot be accessed from inside the cave.

Haligtree Crest Greatshield.text: Drop: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Has a 4% drop chance from one specific Haligtree Knight standing at the northern side of the chapel beyond the Drainage Channel Site of Grace.

Haligtree Crest Surcoat.text: Chance to drop from Haligtree Soldiers.

Haligtree Gauntlets.text: Chance to drop from Haligtree Soldier enemies.

Haligtree Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Haligtree Soldier enemies.

Haligtree Helm.text: Chance to drop from Haligtree Soldier enemies.

Haligtree Knight Armor.text: Chance to drop from Haligtree Knight enemies.

Haligtree Knight Armor (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Haligtree Knight enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Haligtree Knight Gauntlets.text: 3% chance to drop from Haligtree Knight enemies.

Haligtree Knight Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Haligtree Knight enemies.

Haligtree Knight Helm.text: Found on a corpse up a ladder near the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left).text: Mountaintops of the Giants (Castle Sol Rooftop). Area: atop the tower past Commander Niall.

Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Village of the Albinaurics). Quest: Old Albus. Hit his pot-form to dispell the disguise and talk to him.

Haligtree Soldier Ashes.text: Found in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, under a large chalice on a balcony on the north side of the dungeon. From the Prayer Room Site of Grace, take the third beam on the right to a small chapel then take the opposite beam to the outer wall. There is a room below the left end of the wall with several Cleanrot Knights and past the left exit is the chalice.

Hammer.text: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau). The Hammer is located on the upper floor of the Fortified Manor to the left of the entrance window, right next to the Sanctified Whetblade. This is the same spot where Smithing Master Hewg sits in Roundtable Hold.

Hammer Talisman.text: Drop: Stormhill (Limgrave). Obtained by defeating Recusant Henricus in northern Stormhill near the Limgrave Colosseum, north of Stormhill Shack. WARNING: Be aware that joining Henricus's faction, Volcano Manor, will permanently prevent him from invading unless that character starts a new Journey. Need to test if lightning the Forge of Giants prevents the invasion, as it does with Ensha.

Hand Axe.text: Purchase: Limgrave. 1 is sold for runes 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant located in eastern Limgrave in the Mistwood, south of the Minor Erdtree there.

Hand Ballista.text: Loot: Forest Lookout Tower (Weeping Peninsula). Found in a chest on top of the Forest Lookout Tower in the Weeping Peninsula, located southwest of the Bridge of Sacrifice from Limgrave.

Hand of Malenia.text: Trade: Finger Reader Enia. Trade the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess, gained by defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Harp Bow.text: Loot: Altus Plateau. Found on top of a cliff east of Sainted Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau. Requires having examined the "Champion's Song" Painting just inside the northeastern section of the wall around Shaded Castle.

Hawk Crest Wooden Shield.text: Location: Stormveil Castle. Found in room that requires a Stonesword Key to open, near the Grafted Scion and the elevator shortcut back up to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace. This is the same room as the one that has the Miséricorde and Iron Whetblade.

Heal.text: Equipped:. Heal is a starting spell for the Prophet origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for runes 1,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn.

Heal from Afar.text: Loot: Scadu Altus. North of Moorth Ruins there are two small bodies of water. At the northern edge of the southern body of water is a small cave tunnel with a Miranda Blossom and three Perfumers, with the incantation lying under a glowing tree at the end.

Heart of Bayle.text: Guaranteed Drop: Jagged Peak (Gravesite Plain). Dropped by Bayle the Dread after his defeat.

Heartening Cry.text: Received from Castellan Jerren when talking to him on the podium at the start of the Radhan Festival.

Heater Shield.text: Equipment:. One is part of the starting equipment for the Vagabond Origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold. One is sold for runes 1,500 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks.

Hefty Beast Bone.text: Bears. Can be purchased in unlimited quantity from the Twin Maiden Husks, for 250 runes each, after giving them Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing.

Hefty Cracked Pot.text: 1 found on a corpse in the Scorched Ruins. 3 found in the Belurat Gaol. 1 is found in a treasure chest on a wooden platform in the large vertical shaft. The other 2 are found in the maze-like room of large pots.

Hefty Fly Pot.text: Recipe obtained with Greater Potentate's Cookbook 10.

Hefty Scimitar.text: Starting Weapon: Heavy Knight. The Hefty Scimitar is the starting weapon for the Heavy Knight. Purchase: Limgrave. The Hefty Scimitar is purchased from the Nomadic Merchant in eastern Limgrave for 2,400 Runes.

Helm of Night.text: Loot: Bonny Gaol (Scadu Altus). Recovered from a body lying on a guillotine-table. Located on a somewhat hidden floor of the gaol. To reach this floor, the player must progress through the dungeon until they reach a jar-elevator that has already begun to move on its own.

Helm of Solitude.text: Guaranteed Drop: Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from defeating the Blackgaol Knight located in the Western Nameless Mausoleum.

Helphen's Steeple.text: Guaranteed drop: Mountaintops of the Giants. Dropped by a Tibia Mariner in the Mountaintops, overlooking Castle Sol and not far from the Snow Valley Ruins Overlook Site of Grace and where you fight the Mountaintops' Death Rite Bird.

Herba.text: Can be found in thickets and other common areas in the Lands Between.

Herbalist's Bell Bearing.text: Loot: Pillar Path (Gravesite Plain). Acquired from a rope-strung pot that can be found hanging from a mountain wall on the west side of the channel that leads south to the Dragon's Pit, near where the Ancient Dragon-Man can invade. The pot must be destroyed with a projectile for the item to become accessible.

Hierodas Glintstone Crown.text: Loot: Hermit Village Mt. Gelmir. Found on a corpse east of the southernmost houses in the village.

High Page Clothes.text: Chance to drop from High Page enemies that wear it, such as the one near the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

High Page Clothes (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from High Page enemies that wear it, such as the one near the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

High Page Hood.text: Chance to drop from High Page enemies that wear it, such as the one near the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

High Priest Gloves.text: Guaranteed Drop: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus). Acquired after defeating Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers. To access the bossfight, the player must first defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers, then interact with Ymir's throne in the cathedral. This will make Jolan, Swordhand of Night appear, who will be hostile and proceed to attack the player.

High Priest Hat.text: Guaranteed Drop: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus). Acquired after defeating Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers. To access the bossfight, the player must first defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers, then interact with Ymir's throne in the cathedral. This will make Jolan, Swordhand of Night appear, who will be hostile and proceed to attack the player.

High Priest Robe.text: Guaranteed Drop: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus). Acquired after defeating Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers. To access the bossfight, the player must first defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers, then interact with Ymir's throne in the cathedral. This will make Jolan, Swordhand of Night appear, who will be hostile and proceed to attack the player.

High Priest Undergarments.text: Guaranteed Drop: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus). Acquired after defeating Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers. To access the bossfight, the player must first defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers, then interact with Ymir's throne in the cathedral. This will make Jolan, Swordhand of Night appear, who will be hostile and proceed to attack the player.

Highland Attire.text: Loot: Scadu Altus. Acquired from a corpse in the forest northeast of the Highland Cross site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Ralva the Great Red Bear.

Highland Axe.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Found in Stormveil Castle under a painting inside the room with a roaming Grafted Scion, across from the room with the elevator shortcut up to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.

Highwayman Cloth Armor.text: Chance to drop from Highwayman enemies, such as the ones inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

Highwayman Gauntlets.text: 3% chance to drop from Highwayman enemies, such as the ones inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

Highwayman Hood.text: Chance to drop from Highwayman enemies such as the ones inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave.

Holy Grease.text: Can be crafted after picking up the Missionary's Cookbook [4] at the Minor Erdtree Church in Altus Plateau. Two found on a small piece of stone on the left-hand side of the path from the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace to Minor Erdtree Church. Found on top of a wrecked wagon near the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Minor Erdtree (East Liurnia) (Liurnia of the Lakes). Dropped by one of the two Erdtree Avatars in Liurnia of the Lakes, specifically the one found at the northeastern Minor Erdtree, alongside the Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear and Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear.

Holyproof Dried Liver.text: Can be crafted after acquiring the Missionary's Cookbook 6 from a cell in the bottom of dark tower in Volcano Manor. The tower is found beside the lava lake after the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace, and is entered through an open window before descending further down through ladders and stairs. 2 are found on the rafters of the Inverted Carian Study Hall.

Holyproof Pickled Liver.text: Crafted with Forager Brood Cookbook [4]. x2 can be bought from Moore for 4,000 Runes. x1 can be found on a corpse in the Shadow Keep. x1 can be found in Enir-Ilim.

Honed Bolt.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for 7,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Dragon Cult Prayerbook.

Hookclaws.text: Found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle, near the Stormveil Cliffside grace.
