Horn Bow.text: Loot: Siofra River. Found on a corpse in a niche in the lower levels of the bridge to the lower, southern version of Hallowhorn Grounds, east of the Siofra River Bank Site of Grace.

Horn-Strewn Excrement.text: Horn-Tinged Excrement is found in the forests at the northern Rauh Base.

Horned Bairn.text: Guaranteed Drop: Gravesite Plain. Defeat the Ulcerated Tree Spirit near the Ellac River Site of Grace.

Horned Warrior Armor.text: Random Drop: Belurat, Tower Settlement, Ancient Ruins of Rauh & Enir-Ilim. 3% chance of dropping from a Horned Warrior.

Horned Warrior Gauntlets.text: Random Drop: Belurat, Tower Settlement, Ancient Ruins of Rauh & Enir-Ilim. 3% chance of dropping from a Horned Warrior.

Horned Warrior Greaves.text: Random Drop: Belurat, Tower Settlement, Ancient Ruins of Rauh & Enir-Ilim. 3% chance of dropping from a Horned Warrior.

Horned Warrior Helm.text: Random Drop: Belurat, Tower Settlement, Ancient Ruins of Rauh & Enir-Ilim. 3% chance of dropping from a Horned Warrior.

Horned Warrior's Greatsword.text: Guaranteed Drop: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Obtained from the Wind-aspected Divine Beast Warrior found towards the end of Enir-Ilim on the bridge to the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace.

Horned Warrior's Sword.text: Drop: Belurat, Tower Settlement / Rauh Base / Midra's Manse / Ancient Ruins of Rauh. 4% drop rate from dual-wielding Horned Warriors. One can be found in the Belurat Tower Settlement Swamp. An easy one to farm is located just up the stairs from the Small Private Altar Site of Grace in Belurat, Tower Settlement.

Horse Crest Wooden Shield.text: Purchase: Murkwater Cave (Limgrave) / Liurnia of the Lakes / Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir). 1 is sold for runes 1,000 Runes from Patches in Murkwater Cave. It's also available when he's a merchant at the Scenic Isle Site of Grace in southern Liurnia of the Lakes (northwest of Laskyar Ruins), and at Volcano Manor.

Hoslow's Armor.text: Reward for completing an NPC invasion of the Volcano Manor questline that sends you to the Mountaintops of the Giants.

Hoslow's Armor (Altered).text: Reward for completing an NPC invasion of the Volcano Manor questline that sends you to the Mountaintops of the Giants. Altered by Boc.

Hoslow's Gauntlets.text: Murder Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood.

Hoslow's Greaves.text: Murder Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood.

Hoslow's Helm.text: Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood.

Hoslow's Oath.text: Quest Item: Mountaintops of the Giants. Given to the player by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood when invading him by the Shack of the Lofty as the last target of the Volcano Manor assassinations questline. He will approach from the shack and perform the gesture himself before engaging in combat. The gesture is received when he completes the animation.

Hoslow's Petal Whip.text: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants. Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood after invading him in the Mountaintops of the Giants for the final contract from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress. Guaranteed Drop: Jarburg. Dropped by Diallos at the end of his questline.

Host's Trick-Mirror.text: Purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

Howl of Shabriri.text: Loot: Frenzy-Flaming Tower (Liurnia of the Lakes). Howl of Shabriri is located in a treasure chest on the second floor of the Tower, located southeast of the Grand Lift of Dectus.

Human Bone Shard.text: Found by hunting Those Who Live in Death.

Ice Crest Shield.text: Loot: Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes). Upon entering Caria Manor, follow the right hand wall past a small staircase, where a large Fingercreeper will ambush you. Continue following the wall instead of going up the stairs and you will eventually reach an item on a rocky outcropping near a Sorcery Scarab and a gathering of Fingercreepers. That stand-alone item is the shield.

Icerind Hatchet.text: Loot: Temple Quarter (Liurnia of the Lakes). Found inside a chest in a small, broken tower in southern Temple Quarter, located south-west of Academy of Raya Lucaria. It's on a straight track southeast of the Temple Quarter Site of Grace, on the island just south of the Temple Quarter map icon.

Icon Shield.text: Loot: Woodfolk Ruins (Altus Plateau). Found on the right side inside the northernmost building at Woodfolk Ruins.

Idus Sword.text: Starting Weapon: Idus Knight. The Idus Sword is the starting weapon for the Idus Knight. Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. Found early into the Laskyar Ruins past the Nomadic Merchant in the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace. Northwest of the merchant, following the rock wall which seats the Malefactor's Evergaol, there will be a tree with two Revenant Followers.

Igon's Armor.text: Quest reward & Loot: Jagged Peak. Acquired from Igon's body after completing his questline. Assuming that Igon has not been killed by the player near the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace, the player must first defeat the Jagged Peak Drake found past the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace. (Note: only the drake with the boss health-bar needs to be killed in order to progress.).

Igon's Armor (Altered).text: Quest reward & Alter Garment: Jagged Peak. Acquired from altering Igon's Armor. Which can be acquired from Igon's body after completing his questline. Assuming that Igon has not been killed by the player near the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace, the player must first defeat the Jagged Peak Drake found past the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace.

Igon's Bell Bearing.text: Guaranteed Drop / Quest Reward: Gravesite Plain / Jagged Peak. Acquired from killing Igon at any of his physical locations or from completing his questline. Note: Killing Igon at Gravesite Plain will prevent the player from acquiring Igon's Furled Finger and Ash of War: Igon's Drake Hunt in the future. The player will also be unable to summon Igon for the fight against Bayle the Dread.

Igon's Furled Finger.text: Given by Igon as part of his questline. It allows the player to summon him during their fight with Bayle the Dread.

Igon's Gauntlets.text: Quest reward & Loot: Jagged Peak. Acquired from Igon's body after completing his questline. Assuming that Igon has not been killed by the player near the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace, the player must first defeat the Jagged Peak Drake found past the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace. (Note: only the drake with the boss health-bar needs to be killed in order to progress.).

Igon's Greatbow.text: Quest Reward / Guaranteed Drop: Gravesite Plain / Jagged Peak. Acquired from Igon's corpse after either completing his questline or killing him at any of his possible locations. This item may come with Ash of War: Igon's Drake Hunt already attached only if the player choses to fulfill Igon's questline.

Igon's Harpoon.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Purchased for 1,000 from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Igon's Bell Bearing.

Igon's Helm.text: Quest reward & Loot: Jagged Peak. Acquired from Igon's body after completing his questline. Assuming that Igon has not been killed by the player near the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace, the player must first defeat the Jagged Peak Drake found past the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace. (Note: only the drake with the boss health-bar needs to be killed in order to progress.).

Igon's Helm (Altered).text: Quest reward & Alter Garment: Jagged Peak. Acquired from altering Igon's Helm. Which can be acquired from Igon's body after completing his questline. Assuming that Igon has not been killed by the player near the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace, the player must first defeat the Jagged Peak Drake found past the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace.

Igon's Loincloth.text: Quest reward & Loot: Jagged Peak. Acquired from Igon's body after completing his questline. Assuming that Igon has not been killed by the player near the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace, the player must first defeat the Jagged Peak Drake found past the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace. (Note: only the drake with the boss health-bar needs to be killed in order to progress.).

Iji's Mirrorhelm.text: Can be looted from War Counselor Iji after completing Blaidd's questline.

Imbued Sword Key.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Four Belfries). Area: found in the chest near the Site of Grace. Liurnia of the Lakes (Debate Parlor). Area: found on the rooftop section of Raya Lucaria Academy, north-west of the Site of Grace.

Immunizing Cured Meat.text: Recipe is included with Armorer's Cookbook [5], found on a corpse in the back door shortcut room on the south side of Redmane Castle. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Northern Liurnia).

Immunizing Horn Charm.text: Loot: Ainsel River. Found on a corpse in an ant's nest in southwest Ainsel River, near Ainsel River Downstream.

Immunizing White Cured Meat.text: Recipe is included with Armorer's Cookbook [5], found on a corpse in the back door shortcut room on the south side of Redmane Castle.

Immutable Shield.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold by Brother Corhyn for 10,000 Runes after telling Goldmask that Radagon is Marika. Should Corhyn die but before purchasing this Incantation after solving Goldmask's puzzle, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

Imp Head (Cat).text: Drop: Lands Between. Has a base 0.5% chance to drop from Cat-headed Imps found all throughout various catacombs, including the Stormfoot Catacombs to the northwest of the Church of Elleh.

Imp Head (Corpse).text: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau). Found on a corpse on the streets of Leyndell, Royal Capital. Can be accessed by going south from the giant door leading to the area where the Grand Lift of Rold is located. WARNING: If Maliketh is defeated before this item is acquired it will become unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

Imp Head (Elder).text: Loot: Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield). Found on a corpse in front of an Erdtree Burial Watchdog enemy inside the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.

Imp Head (Fanged).text: Drop: Lands Between. Has a base 0.5% chance to drop from Fanged-headed Imps found all throughout various catacombs, such as the ones inside the Cliffbottom Catacombs located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Imp Head (Lion).text: Loot: Scorpion River Catacombs (Land of the Tower). Found on a somewhat hidden ledge in the catacombs. Once having reached the great hall with the arching bridge and the two giant falling spike traps. Get passed the first set of falling spikes and climb the ladder by the second spike trap. This item can be found on top of the wall immediately in front of the ladder.

Imp Head (Long-Tongued).text: Drop: Lands Between. Has a base 0.5% chance to drop from Long-tongued-headed Imps found inside the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

Imp Head (Wolf).text: Loot: Minor Erdtree Catacombs (Caelid). Found on a corpse inside the Minor Erdtree Catacombs. Dropped by Imp enemies with the same face. Drop: Lands Between. Has a base 1.5% chance to drop from Wolf-headed Imps found inside various catacombs, such as the Fringefolk Hero's Grave.

Imprisoned Merchant's Bell Bearing.text: Dropped by Imprisoned Merchant (Moghwyn Dynasty Mausoleum).

Incantation Scarab.text: Quest Reward: Dragon-Burnt Ruins (Limgrave). Obtain the "Homing Instinct" Painting from the Artist's Shack in Limgrave. Interact with the spirit of the painter southwest of the Dragon-Burnt Ruins, located beside a gravestone.

Inescapable Frenzy.text: Loot: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital/Leyndell, Ashen Capital). Inescapable Frenzy is found on top of a coffin near the bottom of the Frenzied Flame Proscription, which can be reached after defeating Mohg, the Omen.

Inner Order.text: Given to players when interacting with D, Beholder of Death towards the end of Siofra Aqueduct.

Inquisitor Ashes.text: Found in a corpse at Enir-Ilim, close to the Spiral Rise site of grace.

Inquisitor's Girandole.text: Guaranteed Drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir). Received upon defeating the Abductor Virgin duo boss in Volcano Manor.

Inseparable Sword.text: Guaranteed drop: Siofra Aqueduct (Siofra River) / Deeproot Depths. Obtained after the death of D, Beholder of Death, meaning there are two ways to obtain this weapon. The first way is the regular one, which is slower and require that the questlines of both D's and also Fia, Deathbed Companion, is completed, whereafter it is found where Fia sat in Deeproot Depths.

Intelligence-knot Crystal Tear.text: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. Found in a bowl at the bottom of a cliff south of the Caria Manor in Liurnia of the Lakes, guarded by several small Fingercreepers and one large one. From the Sorcerer's Isle Site of Grace, right next to Testu's Rise, head north along the coast until a low-lying and forested area is found and then continue north.

Inverted Hawk Heater Shield.text: Loot: Siofra River. Found on top of the hill next to the Siofra River Bank Site of Grace. The bottom of the hill starts east of the Grace, then leads up to the west.

Inverted Hawk Towershield.text: Drop: Nokron, Eternal City. 1% drop chance from Greatshield-wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers. Starting from the Nokron, Eternal City Site of Grace, three Greatshield-wielders can be found at the gazebo just to the east. A fourth one can be found at the tree in a corner northeast of the gazebo, and a fifth one is just outside of the narrow path down to the Mimic Tear.

Invigorating Cured Meat.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [2], sold by Merchant Kalé.

Invigorating White Cured Meat.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [2], sold by Merchant Kalé.

Irina's Letter.text: Weeping Peninsula (Bridge of Sacrifice). Quest: Irina of Morne. Talk to her twice and select Deliver the letter. Alternatively, it is dropped by her upon death.

Iris of Grace.text: Two can be found in the Realm of Shadow:. Shadow Keep: Left to the Storehouse, First Floor you can find and elevator. Go down to the room full of Jar Innards and look around. Scadutree Base: Found in a church in the route to the Scadutree Avatar, behind the Tree-Worship Sanctum.

Iris of Occultation.text: Two can be found in the Realm of Shadow:. Fort of Reprimand: Enter the fort and turn to the left. Look for a hole on the floor and drop. The iris will be close by along with two enemies ambushing you. Church District: Drain the water to access the lower section of the Church District. There will be two Ulcerated Tree Spirit in different areas. The one on the north will reward you the iris upon defeating it.

Iron Ball.text: Drop: Blackguard Big Boggart. Received upon killing Blackguard Big Boggart.

Iron Cleaver.text: Drop: Morne Tunnel & Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) / Unsightly Catacombs & Leyndell, Royal Capital (Capital Outskirts) / Cave of the Forlorn & Miquella's Haligtree (Consecrated Snowfield) / Scadu Altus / Charo's Hidden Grave. 2% drop chance from cleaver-wielding Misbegotten.

Iron Gauntlets.text: Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region.

Iron Greatsword.text: Drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital / Miquella's Haligtree. 4% drop chance from Misbegotten Warriors. 2 Warriors can be found among the Misbegotten southeast the East Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, before the elevator to the Forbidden Lands.

Iron Helmet.text: Sold by Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula.

Iron Kasa.text: Dropped by Yura only once he his possessed by Shabriri during his questline.

Iron Rivet Armor.text: Guaranteed Drop: Land of the Tower (Realm of Shadow). Dropped from the Red Bear NPC bossfight in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

Iron Rivet Gauntlets.text: Guaranteed Drop: Land of the Tower (Realm of Shadow). Dropped from the Red Bear NPC bossfight in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

Iron Rivet Greaves.text: Guaranteed Drop: Land of the Tower (Realm of Shadow). Dropped from the Red Bear NPC bossfight in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

Iron Roundshield.text: Purchase: Limgrave. One is sold for runes 900 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant found just southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.

Iron Spear.text: Drop: Nokron, Eternal City. 2% drop from the spear wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers near the Nokron, Eternal City grace.

Iron Whetblade.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). From the room with the Grafted Scion, head through the doorway in the north-west corner to enter a small courtyard. On your right is an Imp Statue Sealed room which contains the whetblade. Requires one Stonesword Key and is guarded by two large axe-wielding Exile Soldiers.

Ironjar Aromatic.text: Can be crafted after acquiring the Perfumer's Cookbook 3 from Auriza Side Tomb.

Ivory Sickle.text: Found near the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Ivory-Draped Tabard.text: Chance to drop from Haligtree Foot Soldier enemies.

Jar.text: Follow Iron Fist Alexander's questline until you see him on Mt. Gelmir. Talk to him and exhaust his dialogue, and he will grant you the Jar.

Jar Cannon.text: Guaranteed Drop: Volcano Cave (Mt. Gelmir). Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot inside of Volcano Cave.

Jarwight Puppet.text: Can be acquired from Seluvis once you confront him about his secret puppet workshop at the Three Sisters. Either him or the Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet can be gained from Seluvis for free. If he isn't selected he costs 3 Starlight Shards to buy.

Jawbone Axe.text: Drop: Siofra River / Uld Palace Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Ainsel River. 2% drop chance from axe-wielding Ancestral Follower Warriors, including the bow-wielding ones. 3 can be found just northwest of the Worshippers' Woods in Lower Siofra River. Several can be found by the Ruined Labyrinth Site of Grace in southern Uld Palace Ruins.

Jellyfish Shield.text: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. Found on a dead body with four Jellyfish around it, north of the Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace.

Jump for Joy.text: Available from the start of the game.

Juvenile Scholar Cap.text: Complete the "Resurrection" Painting from the Artist's Shack in Liurnia of the Lakes. The location of the painter's spirit is the graveyard south of Caria Manor.

Juvenile Scholar Robe.text: Requires having seen the "Resurrection" Painting inside the Artist's Shack in Liurnia of the Lakes. The location depicted in the painting can be found south east of the Behind Caria Manor site of grace in Liurnia of the Lakes. The set will be dropped on the ground once reaching destination.

Kaiden Armor.text: Chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

Kaiden Gauntlets.text: 3% chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

Kaiden Helm.text: Chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

Kaiden Sellsword Ashes.text: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog in the Cliffbottom Catacombs, Liurnia of the Lakes.

Kaiden Trousers.text: Chance to drop from Kaiden Sellsword enemies.

Karolos Glintstone Crown.text: Guaranteed drop: Academy of Raya Lucaria Liurnia of the Lakes. Dropped by a Crystal Crab found by taking a left after the fountain after the Debate Parlor Site of Grace, and then keeping to the left after passing under the bridge.

Katar.text: Loot: Fort Gael (Caelid). Found inside a chest in Fort Gael.

Kindred of Rot Ashes.text: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade in Caelid Catacombs.

Kindred of Rot's Exultation.text: Obtained by defeating Kindred of Rot in Seethewater Cave in central Mt. Gelmir.

Kite Shield.text: Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes. One is sold for runes 1,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant next to the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace, at the southern end of Liurnia's great lake.

Knifeprint Clue.text: Given by Fia as part of her questline.

Knight Armor.text: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

Knight Gauntlets.text: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

Knight Greaves.text: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

Knight Helm.text: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

Knight's Greatsword.text: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Mt. Gelmir / Altus Plateau / Deeproot Depths / Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. 4% drop chance from various sword-wielding knight enemies: Godrick Knights, Cuckoo Knights, Leyndell Knights and Mausoleum Knights. 2 sword-wielding Godrick Knights can be found at the camp between the Warmaster's Shack and the Saintsbridge Site of Grace.

Knight's Lightning Spear.text: Loot: Scorpion River Catacombs. After arriving in the room with a spiked falling roof, keep to the right to find a ladder in one of the small safe spots around the corner (in the second half of the room) and climb up it.

Knot Resin.text: Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Greasemonger's Bell Bearing. Commonly found in Gravesite Plain and Scadu Altus.

Kukri.text: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula. The Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace sells an unlimited quantity for 60 a piece. Loot:. x4 are looted off a corpse north-east of the Church of Elleh.

Lacerating Crossed-Tree.text: Quest Reward: Highroad Cross (Scadu Altus). Received from talking to Needle Knight Leda, by the Highroad Cross site of grace after successfully assisting her in assassinating the vengeful Hornsent at Shadow Keep. The player must kill Hornsent in the co-invasion with Leda in order to acquire this item.

Lamenting Visage.text: Loot: Lamenter's Gaol (Gravesite Plain). Can be found by starting from the pit with Living Jar Warriors and the Gaol Lower Level Key is, then climbing back up the way into the pit taking the first door on the left, and then going through the illusory wall at the end of the small corridor and opening a locked door with the aforementioned key.

Lance.text: Loot: Limgrave. Found on a corpse on a squarish ruin, northeast of the Warmaster's Shack.

Lance Talisman.text: Obtained from the northeastern-most tip of Stormhill directly west of the Divine Tower of Limgrave.

Land Squirt Ashes.text: Found in Liurnia of the Lakes, at the foot of the cliffs east of Academy Gate Town.

Land of Reeds Armor.text: Starting gear for the Samurai class. Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow).

Land of Reeds Armor (Altered).text: Starting gear for the Samurai class (unaltered). Purchased unaltered from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow). Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

Land of Reeds Gauntlets.text: Starting gear for the Samurai class. Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow).

Land of Reeds Greaves.text: Starting gear for the Samurai class. Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow).

Land of Reeds Helm.text: Starting gear for Samurai origin. Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow).

Lands Between Rune.text: Can be selected as a keepsake during character creation.

Lansseax's Glaive.text: Lansseax's Glaive is obtained by defeating Ancient Dragon Lansseax on the Altus Plateau, south of the Rampartside Path site of grace outside of the wall to the Capital Outskirts.

Lantern.text: Isolated Merchant in his shack in the Weeping Peninsula region (x1). Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace in the Liurnia of the Lakes region (x1).

Large Club.text: Loot: Limgrave. Found on a corpse near a group of Demi-Human enemies a bit south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol, located in Limgrave. The easiest way to reach it is to head to the Spiritspring south-southeast of the Evergaol and then heading west.

Large Glintstone Scrap.text: Some can be found in the Morne Tunnel. Drops from the Glintstone variety of Miners.

Large Leather Shield.text: Equipment:. One is part of the starting gear for the Hero Origin. Purchase: Church of Elleh (Limgrave). One is sold for runes 600 Runes by Merchant Kalé.

Larval Tear.text: A total of 18 of these can be acquired per playthrough. Another 9 can be found Realm of Shadow. Limgrave. Dropped by a Runebear that transforms from a Wandering Noble after death. This enemy can be found east of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace, on an incline overlooking the highway. Liurnia of the Lakes.

Law of Causality.text: Given by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing after defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood and choosing to talk "About the Lord of Blood's Cocoon". Can also be bought from the Twin Maiden Husks for 5,000 Runes after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Law of Regression.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for 10,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Golden Order Principia.

Lazuli Glintstone Crown.text: Guaranteed drop: Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes). Dropped by a Crystal Crab inside a tower after jumping down two wooden platform after the top one, accessed via the rooftops found to the left after the Debate Parlor Site of Grace in the academy.

Lazuli Glintstone Sword.text: Dropped by Lazuli Glintstone Sorcerers with a 2% drop rate. One can be easily reached just outside of the room with the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace, just before the Red Wolf of Radagon in Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Lazuli Robe.text: Chance to drop from Lazuli Sorcerer enemies that wear it.

Leaden Hardtear.text: Guaranteed drop: Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir). Dropped along with the Cerulean Hidden Tear by the Ulcerated Tree Spirit miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Mt. Gelmir, east of the Road of Iniquity Site of Grace.

Leather Arm Wraps.text: Loot: Scadu Altus & Rauh Base (Land of the Tower). Acquired from a corpse in the forest northeast of the Highland Cross site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Ralva the Great Red Bear. Also found on a corpse near the edge of a small cliff, in the forest northwest of the Ravine North site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Rugalea the Great Red Bear.

Leather Crown.text: Loot: Scadu Altus. Acquired from a corpse in the forest northeast of the Highland Cross site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Ralva the Great Red Bear.

Leather Headband.text: Loot: Rauh Base (Land of the Tower). Acquired from a corpse near the edge of a small cliff, found in the forest northwest of the Ravine North site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Rugalea the Great Red Bear.

Leather Leg Wraps.text: Loot: Scadu Altus & Rauh Base (Land of the Tower). Acquired from a corpse in the forest northeast of the Highland Cross site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Ralva the Great Red Bear. Also found on a corpse near the edge of a small cliff, in the forest northwest of the Ravine North site of grace and in close proximity the territory patrolled by Rugalea the Great Red Bear.

Leather Trousers.text: Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region.

Leather-Draped Tabard.text: Chance to drop from Leyndell Foot Soldier enemies.

Leda's Armor.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Recovered from the body of Needle Knight Leda in the hallway after the Miquellan Loyalists bossfight.

Leda's Rune.text: Dropped by Leda if she is killed before reaching Enir-Ilim.

Leda's Sword.text: Guaranteed drop: Enir-Ilim. Received after defeating Leda and her allies in their boss fight near the top of Enir-Ilim.

Leontiel's Armor.text: Defeat Knight Leontiel after she invades in the Wailing Dunes. She appears on the northern end close to the War-Dead Catacombs, after Starscourge Radahn is defeated.

Leontiel's Boots.text: Defeat Knight Leontiel after she invades in the Wailing Dunes. She appears on the northern end close to the War-Dead Catacombs, after Starscourge Radahn is defeated.

Leontiel's Greatsword.text: Guaranteed Drop: Wailing Dunes (Caelid). Received after defeating Knight Leontiel after she invades in the Wailing Dunes. Starscourge Radahn must be defeated prior, then she will invade near the entrance to War-Dead Catacombs in the northern part of the area.

Leontiel's Hat.text: Defeat Knight Leontiel after she invades in the Wailing Dunes. She appears on the northern end close to the War-Dead Catacombs, after Starscourge Radahn is defeated.

Leontiel's Leather Gloves.text: Defeat Knight Leontiel after she invades in the Wailing Dunes. She appears on the northern end close to the War-Dead Catacombs, after Starscourge Radahn is defeated.

Let Us Go Together.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim. Automatically acquired after dying to the grab attack of Promised Consort Radahn. If Radahn is slain without ever dying to his grab, the gesture appears on the arena floor as an item after the fight. This is a recurring gesture throughout FromSoftware's souls-like games. 's variant of the animation is also used in:.

Letter for Freyja.text: Obtained from Sir Ansbach as part of his questline.

Letter to Bernahl.text: Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor). Quest: Recusant Bernahl. Talk to him after hunting down Rileigh the Idle under Tanith's request.

Letter to Patches.text: Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor). Quest: Patches. Talk to him after hunting down Old Knight Istvan under Tanith's request.

Leyndell Knight Armor.text: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

Leyndell Knight Armor (Altered).text: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

Leyndell Knight Gauntlets.text: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

Leyndell Knight Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

Leyndell Knight Helm.text: Chance to drop from Leyndell Knight enemies.

Leyndell Soldier Ashes.text: Found on a corpse in Sainted Hero's Grave, before falling through a collapsing floor.

Leyndell Soldier Gauntlets.text: Chance to drop from Leyndell Soldier enemies.

Leyndell Soldier Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Leyndell Soldier enemies.

Leyndell Soldier Helm.text: Chance to drop from Leyndell Soldier enemies.

Lhutel the Headless.text: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade in Tombsward Catacombs, Weeping Peninsula.

Light Crossbow.text: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula. 1 is sold for runes 1,500 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace, north of Castle Morne itself.

Light of Miquella.text: Trade: Remembrance of a God and a Lord. Trade with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate the remembrance (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Minor Erdtree (Liurnia of the Lakes). Dropped by one of the two Erdtree Avatars in Liurnia of the Lakes, specifically the one found at the northeastern Minor Erdtree, alongside the Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear and Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear.

Lightningproof Dried Liver.text: Can be crafted after acquiring the Ancient Dragon Apostle's Cookbook [4] from a round building atop floating stone walls making a bridge upwards in Crumbling Farum Azula. It is found past the Dragon Temple Lift Site of Grace, straight across the courtyard and jumping atop two buildings on the right to get across a gap. Following across the ascending pseudo-bridge, it is guarded by 2 Giant Skeleton Beastmen.

Lightningproof Pickled Liver.text: Can be crafted after acquiring the Forager Brood Cookbook [3] in Ellac River Downstream (Gravesite Plain). Talk to the forager brood member located near the cliffs and mountain-wall, north of the small forest inhabited by a herd of lightning sheep, northeast of the Cerulean Coast site of grace. 2 sold for runes 4,000 Runes by Moore.

Lion Greatbow.text: Trade: Remembrance of the Starscourge. Trade the Remembrance of the Starscourge with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough either way).

Lionel's Armor.text: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Lionel's Armor (Altered).text: Gained by altering Lionel's Armor, which is found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Lionel's Gauntlets.text: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Lionel's Greaves.text: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Lionel's Helm.text: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Litany of Proper Death.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Sold by D, Hunter of the Dead for 2,500 rune Runes after speaking to Gurranq in the Bestial Sanctum.

Lizard Greatsword.text: Drop: Fog Rift Catacombs (Fog Rift Catacombs) / Scorpion River Catacombs (Rauh Base). 2% drop chance from Greatsword-wielding, Lion-Headed Imps found in.

Lone Wolf Ashes.text: Given by Renna the Witch in the Church of Elleh, after the player receives the Spectral Steed Whistle from Melina. Also sold for 500 runes Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks if any Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes is activated without picking it up.

Longbow.text: Starting Equipment: Samurai. 1 is part of the Samurai origin's starting equipment. Purchase: Roundtable Hold. 1 is sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for runes 1,200 Runes.

Longhaft Axe.text: Drop: Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula) / Revenger's Shack (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Unsightly Catacombs & Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) / Cave of the Forlorn & Miquella's Haligtree (Consecrated Snowfield) / Scadu Altus. 2% drop chance to drop from the larger, Scaly Misbegotten enemies that wield it. One can be found atop the pile of bodies in the Castle Morne courtyard.

Longsword.text: Starting armament of the Vagabond origin. Purchased from Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 1,000 Runes.

Longtail Cat Talisman.text: Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes). Obtained from a corpse at the bottom of the lift in the Academy. From the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace, head back outside and ride the lift down to the bottom (jump off the lift to the platform, near the bottom, because falling off the lift, even at its lowest point, is a lethal fall).

Lord of Blood's Exultation.text: Drop: Leyndell Catacombs (Leyndell, Royal Capital). The Lord of Blood's Exultation is obtained by defeating the Esgar, Priest of Blood, in Leyndell Catacombs beneath Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Lord of Blood's Favor.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (nearest Fallen Ruins of the Lake). Received from White Mask Varré at the Rose Church after fulfilling one of the following requirements:. Invade and defeat Magnus the Beast Claw at the Writheblood Ruins in the Altus Plateau. Invade Magnus three times.

Lord of Blood's Robe.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood.

Lord of Blood's Robe (Altered).text: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Mohg, Lord of Blood. Can be altered at a Site of Grace or by Boc.

Lord's Aid.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Lord's Aid is sold for runes 2,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Two Fingers' Prayerbook.

Lord's Divine Fortification.text: Quest Item / Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Received from Gideon after discussing the haligtree roots, once Malenia, Blade of Miquella has been defeated. Can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks for 3,500 Runes if the player does not talk to Gideon about the roots before unleashing the Rune of Death.

Lord's Heal.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for runes 8,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows, after giving either of them the Two Fingers' Prayerbook.

Lordsworn's Greatsword.text: Loot: Gatefront Ruins (Limgrave). Found in the chest on a carriage just southeast of the Gatefront Site of Grace.

Lordsworn's Shield.text: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Deeproot Depths / Altus Plateau / Miquella's Haligtree. 2% drop chance from any Spear-and-Greatshield-wielding Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, or Haligtree Soldiers. There are several Spear-and-Greatshield Soldiers in Gatefront Ruins, with one of them standing just south of the Site of Grace.

Lordsworn's Straight Sword.text: Soldier enemies of every faction that wield this weapon have a 2% drop rate for it. This includes Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, and Haligtree Soldiers. Can be farmed from the very beginning of the game, at Gatefront Ruins, where some Godrick Soldiers wield this sword.

Loretta's Greatbow.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Acquired from defeating the apparition of Royal Knight Loretta guarding the Royal Moongazing Grounds of Caria Manor.

Loretta's Mastery.text: Guaranteed Drop: Miquella's Haligtree. Acquired from defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree standing guard at the Haligtree Promenade.

Loretta's War Sickle.text: Received upon defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

Lost Ashes of War.text: There is a limited number of Lost Ashes of War that can be acquired each playthrough, totaling 15 in the base game and 5 in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Lands Between: 1x sold by the Isolated Merchant in his shack in the Weeping Peninsula region. 1x sold by the Isolated Merchant hidden among the trees south of the Main Academy Gate grace, Liurnia of the Lakes.

Loyal Knight's Cookbook.text: Loot: Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain). Found in a chest inside the building that has the Castle Ensis Checkpoint site of grace and Miquella's Cross on its rooftop.

Lucerne.text: Found north of the Liurnia Highway North grace, near a broken wagon.

Lucidity.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Acquired from defeating Preceptor Miriam in the inverted version of Carian Study Hall.

Lulling Branch.text: Crafted with St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [3].

Lusat's Glintstone Crown.text: Loot: Sellia Hideaway Caelid. Can be found on Lusat's body along with the rest of the set, in a pit near the end of the area, after Sellen's questline has been completed.

Lusat's Glintstone Staff.text: Loot: Caelid. Found inside a chest after the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk boss fight in Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

Lusat's Manchettes.text: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway cave to loot the Lusat armor set.

Lusat's Robe.text: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway cave to loot the Lusat armor set.

Mace.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. One is sold for runes 800 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks.

Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes.text: Dropped by the Erdtree Burial Watchdog duo in the Minor Erdtree Catacombs.

Madding Hand.text: Guaranteed Drop: Abyssal Woods. Obtained from the killing the Madding Hand (NPC) in the Abyssal Woods, located south of the Woodland Trail Site of Grace.

Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Minor Erdtree (Liurnia of the Lakes). Dropped by one of the two Erdtree Avatars in Liurnia of the Lakes, specifically the one found at the northeastern Minor Erdtree, alongside the Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear and Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear.

Magicbone Arrow.text: Craftable after obtaining the Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4] found in a chest in a room in the Academy of Raya Lucaria, left of the door after the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace.

Magma Blade.text: Drop: Volcano Manor. 1% drop chance from the Man-Serpents wielding flaming swords. There are two Man-Serpents that drop this weapon, both of which can be found on the same path: from the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace, head up the elevator back into the Manor and the first Magma Blade-wielding Man-Serpent can be found on the bridge out of the tower, followed by the second one on the walkway after the second tower.

Magma Breath.text: Dragon Communion: Limgrave / Caelid / Jagged Peak. Acquired from the altar at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave, Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid, and the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 1 Dragon Heart after defeating the Magma Wyrm south of Fort Laiedd at Mt. Gelmir.

Magma Shot.text: Quest Item: Volcano Manor. Acquired from Tanith after successfully felling the first assassination target, Old Knight Istvan. Loot: Volcano Manor. If Old Knight Istvan is assassinated after Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy is killed, {{.

Magma Whip Candlestick.text: Quest Reward: Patches. The reward from Patches in Volcano Manor after defeating Great Horned Tragoth. He won't give it to the player the first time he is spoken too. Instead, the area has to be reloaded in some way (either via teleporting or by exiting and re-entering the game) and he can be spoken to again to gain the weapon.

Magma Wyrm's Scalesword.text: Guaranteed Drop: Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes). Received upon defeating Magma Wyrm Makar at the end of the dungeon.

Main-gauche.text: Found inside of Shadow Keep. From the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace, head up the western stairs and take a right after the first stair, then take a right again in the corridor to arrive in a small room with a Black Knight. The dagger can be found on a body in the left corner.

Malenia's Armor.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Malenia's Armor (Altered).text: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Malenia's Gauntlet.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Malenia's Great Rune.text: Upon the defeat of Malenia, Blade of Miquella. Restored at the Isolated Divine Tower, accessible from the Tower of Return in the Weeping Peninsula.

Malenia's Greaves.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Malenia's Winged Helm.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Malformed Dragon Armor.text: Received upon defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.

Malformed Dragon Gauntlets.text: Received upon defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.

Malformed Dragon Greaves.text: Received upon defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.

Malformed Dragon Helm.text: Received upon defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.

Maliketh's Armor.text: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Maliketh's Armor (Altered).text: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Maliketh's Black Blade.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Black Blade, gained by defeating the Maliketh, the Black Blade, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Maliketh's Gauntlets.text: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Maliketh's Greaves.text: Bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Maliketh's Helm.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Man-Fly Ashes.text: Found as loot in the Village of Flies.

Man-Serpent Ashes.text: Found in the hall containing several Wandering Nobles and Man-Serpents in Volcano Manor, before the sending gate leading to Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

Man-Serpent's Shield.text: Drop: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir). 4% drop chance from the sword-and-shield-wielding Man-Serpents found throughout the Manor. One can be found just outside of the Guest Hall Site of Grace. 3.03% drop chance from the Magma Blade-and-shield-wielding Manserpents found in the Manor.

Manor Towershield.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle. From the Secluded Cell Site of Grace, head back towards the Living Jars, then turn right and follow the wall upon reaching the next level up the ramp to find a wooden scaffolding. At the end of the scaffolding is a ledge that can be jumped up to and the followed to the right to find a door.

Mantis Blade.text: Guaranteed Drop: Gelmir Hero's Grave (Mt. Gelmir). Dropped by a Cemetery Shade found in a nook in Gelmir Hero's Grave, just before the final stretch of lava leading to the room with the Boss. Only dropped the first time it's killed. As the Chariot moves on this path, it will follow the Tarnished down and can kill either them or the Shade, making a vigilant eye on both the enemy and the Hero Grave's path a good idea.

Mantle of Thorns.text: Guaranteed Drop: Shadow Keep. After draining the water from the Shadow Keep Church District, defeat the Ulcerated Tree Spirit beside a large dead tree.

Map: Siofra River.text: Underground area beneath Mistwood and Caelid.

Marais Executioner's Sword.text: Guaranteed drop: The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau). Defeat Elemer of the Briar at the top of the castle.

Marais Mask.text: Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan.

Marais Robe.text: Dropped by Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan.

Margit's Shackle.text: Sold by Patches in Murkwater Cave (x1).

Marika's Hammer.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Elden Remembrance, gained by defeating the Elden Beast, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Marika's Scarseal.text: Obtained from a corpse in northwestern Siofra River, at the base of a waterfall behind the Dragonkin Soldier boss fight arena.

Marika's Soreseal.text: Obtained from a chalice in southeastern Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. The chalice resides inside a room locked by a semi-transparent fog wall, which can be unlocked by inserting one Stonesword Key into the adjacent imp statue. From Elphael Inner Wall, head east to the courtyard once guarded by an Erdtree Avatar, and climb down the ladder at the southeast end of this area.

Marionette Soldier Armor.text: Chance to drop from Marionette Soldier enemies.

Marionette Soldier Ashes.text: Found in the graveyard near the start of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, on a corpse hanging off a ledge accessed via a short tunnel.

Marionette Soldier Birdhelm.text: Chance to drop from Avionette Soldier enemies.

Marionette Soldier Helm.text: Chance to drop from Marionette Soldier enemies.

Marred Leather Shield.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle. Located halfway up the wooden walkway to the side entrance of the castle that Gostoc recommends, found just after the Stormveil Cliffside Site of Grace.

Marred Wooden Shield.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle. Drop down the north side of the tower on the left on the wall north of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace, then continue dropping down until a broken, thorned tower is reached with the shield.

Mask of Confidence.text: Loot: Inverted Carian Study Hall (Liurnia of the Lakes). After inverting the study hall with the Carian Inverted Statue, defeat the first 3 Fingercreepers and then take the left path when the walkway splits. Dropping down on the end of that left path and then turning around leads to a small nook with the item.

Mass of Putrescence.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain (Stone Coffin Fissure). Found in the Stone Coffin Fissure by jumping to a lower ledge near the Fissure Waypoint Site of Grace.

Maternal Staff.text: Guaranteed drop: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus). Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, after having slain Metyr, Mother of Fingers.

Mausoleum Gauntlets.text: 1.5% chance to drop from Mausoleum Soldier enemies.

Mausoleum Greaves.text: 1.5% chance to drop from Mausoleum Soldier enemies.

Mausoleum Knight Armor.text: 3% chance to drop from Mausoleum Knight enemies.

Mausoleum Knight Armor (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Mausoleum Knight enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Mausoleum Knight Gauntlets.text: 3% chance to drop from Mausoleum Knight enemies.

Mausoleum Knight Greaves.text: 3% chance to drop from Mausoleum Knight enemies.

Mausoleum Soldier Ashes.text: Found on a corpse on a cliff in the northernmost point of the north-west part of Deeproot Depths. Straight north of The Nameless Eternal City Site of Grace.

Mausoleum Surcoat.text: 1.5% chance to drop from Mausoleum Soldier enemies.

May the Best Win.text: Loot: Scadu Altus. Found on the ground, slightly north of the Highway Cross Site of Grace.

Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing.text: Guaranteed Drop: Church of Vows (Liurnia of the Lakes). Dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter inside the Church of Vows at nighttime.

Medicine Peddler's Bell Bearing.text: Guaranteed Drop: Hermit Merchant's Shack in Capital Outskirts. Dropped by the Bell Bearing Hunter outside the Hermit Merchant’s shack at nighttime.

Melted Mushroom.text: Found around in the underground Eternal City and the surrounding Ainsel and Siofra Rivers.

Memory Stone.text: A total of 8 memory stones can be acquired:. Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 3,000 runes. Found in a chest at the top of towers:. Oridys's Rise in the Weeping Peninsula region (three tortoise puzzle).

Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.page: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse
Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.text: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Underground Roadside). Quest: retrieved from the corpse of the Dung Eater, after he has received his final fifth Seedbed Curse.

Message from Leda.text: Found in the vicinity of any Miquella's Cross after defeating Messmer the Impaler (including the Highroad Cross if Leda is not present).

Messmer Soldier Armor.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 1.5% chance of dropping from a Messmer Soldier.

Messmer Soldier Armor (Altered).text: Random Drop & Alter Garment: Realm of Shadow. Acquired from altering Messmer Soldier Armor. Which has a 1.5% chance of dropping from a Messmer Soldier.

Messmer Soldier Gauntlets.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 1.5% chance of dropping from a Messmer Soldier.

Messmer Soldier Greaves.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 1.5% chance of dropping from a Messmer Soldier.

Messmer Soldier Helm.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 1.5% chance of dropping from a Messmer Soldier.

Messmer Soldier Shield.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 2% chance of dropping from Messmer Soldiers who carry this item.

Messmer Soldier's Axe.text: Drop: Gravesite Plain / Cerulean Coast / Charo's Hidden Grave / Scadu Altus / Rauh Base / Abyssal Woods / Ruins of Rauh. 2% drop chance from any axe-wielding Messmer Soldiers. 2 axe-wielders (and 2 spear-wielders) can be found down a ladder from the Stake of Marika in Fog Rift Fort, reached by dropping down the cliff by the Scadu Altus, West Site of Grace.

Messmer Soldier's Blood Axe.text: Drop: Gravesite Plain / Cerulean Coast / Charo's Hidden Grave / Scadu Altus / Rauh Base / Abyssal Woods / Ruins of Rauh. 2% drop chance from any axe-wielding Messmer Soldiers. 2 axe-wielders (and 2 spear-wielders) can be found down a ladder from the Stake of Marika in Fog Rift Fort, reached by dropping down the cliff by the Scadu Altus, West Site of Grace.

Messmer Soldier's Blood Spear.text: Drop: Realm of Shadow. There is a base 2.00% chance where Messmer Soldiers can drop this weapon. Three wielding spears can be found at a camp to the west from Moorth Ruins site of grace.

Messmer Soldier's Cold Axe.text: Drop: Gravesite Plain / Cerulean Coast / Charo's Hidden Grave / Scadu Altus / Rauh Base / Abyssal Woods / Ruins of Rauh. 2% drop chance from any axe-wielding Messmer Soldiers. 2 axe-wielders (and 2 spear-wielders) can be found down a ladder from the Stake of Marika in Fog Rift Fort, reached by dropping down the cliff by the Scadu Altus, West Site of Grace.
