Messmer's Armor.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 15000 from Enia, after defeating Messmer the Impaler.

Messmer's Gauntlets.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Messmer the Impaler.

Messmer's Greaves.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Messmer the Impaler.

Messmer's Helm.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Messmer the Impaler.

Messmer's Helm (Altered).text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Acquired from altering Messmer's Helm. Which can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Messmer the Impaler.

Messmer's Kindling.text: Dropped by Messmer the Impaler at the top of the Shadow Keep.

Messmer's Orb.text: Trade: Remembrance of the Impaler. Exchange the Remembrance with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. The remembrance is acquired by defeating Messmer the Impaler. After the Remembrance is acquired, a Wandering Mausoleum or Remembrance Duplication Coffins can be used to duplicate it. The spell can only be acquired once per new game cycle, regardless of how many remembrances are held.

Messmerfire Grease.text: Belurat, Tower Settlement (Land of the Tower). x1 found in the underground sewers, southeast of the Belurat, Tower Settlement site of grace. x1 found in the corner of a small alleyway south of the street leading to the Small Private Altar site of grace. Fog Rift Fort (Scadu Altus).

Meteor Bolt.text: Random Drop:. Loot:. Purchase:. Liurnia of the Lakes.

Meteoric Ore Blade.text: Loot: Caelid Waypoint Ruins (Caelid). Found in the underground chambers in the northwest section of the Caelid Waypoint Ruins. It is inside of a chest behind a door in the far corner of the room.

Meteorite.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Acquired from defeating the Onyx Lord at the Royal Grave Evergaol.

Meteorite Staff.text: Loot: Caelid. Found inside a broken tower with Miranda Sprouts in the southwestern part of Street of Sages Ruins, in the northwestern corner of the Swamp of Aeonia.

Meteorite of Astel.text: Guaranteed Drop: Consecrated Snowfield. Acquired from defeating the Astel, Stars of Darkness bossfight that lurks at the end of Yelough Anix Tunnel.

Midra's Flame of Frenzy.text: Trade: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame. The remembrance is acquired by defeating Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame. Exchange the Remembrance with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. After the Remembrance is acquired, a Wandering Mausoleum or Remembrance Duplication Coffins can be used to duplicate it.

Milady.text: Loot: Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain). The weapon can be found in a chest at the top of a watchtower in Castle Ensis. The watchtower can be reached from the Castle-Lord's Chamber Site of Grace by heading out the small arched doorway onto a stone balcony, jumping over the ledge, and continuing downwards on the rock facings. You can then head up the watchtower via a set of stairs and ladders.

Millicent's Prosthesis.text: Obtained from Millicent, after killing her, at almost any time after she equips the Valkyrie's Prosthesis given by the player. The first location where she can be killed, and drop the talisman, is the Windmill Heights site of grace at Dominula, Windmill Village.

Mimic Tear Ashes.text: In a treasure chest behind a Stonesword Key imp statue in Nokron, Eternal City.

Mimic's Veil.text: Found in a treasure chest in Stormveil Castle, in a room patrolled by a single Banished Knight.

Miniature Ranni.text: Found in a coffin on the northernmost, upper level of the Ainsel River once Ranni has been given the Fingerslayer Blade. Can be talked to at any Site of Grace in the Ainsel River Main as well as the Ranni's Chamber Site of Grace in Ranni's Rise.

Miquella's Great Rune.text: Upon the defeat of the Scadutree Avatar.

Miquella's Lily.text: Miquella's Lilies are scattered across the Lands Between, particularly around sacred areas associated with Miquella or the Haligtree. These flowers do not respawn once harvested until the next playthrough. 4% drop from only the Haligtree Soldiers and Haligtree Knights found in the graveyard after the Drainage Channel site of grace.

Miquella's Needle.text: Miquella's Haligtree (Malenia, Goddess of Rot). Area: after completeling Millicent's questline by assisting her against her sisters to retrieve the Unalloyed Gold Needle, defeat Malenia, Blade of Miquella and, upon reloading the area, interact with the Scarlet Aeonia flower.

Miquellan Knight's Sword.text: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, near the Prayer Room Site of Grace. After exiting the Grace in it to continue forward there will be a parapet on the right that leads to a tower with a ladder on the other side. Climbing that ladder leads to the sword's location.

Mirage Riddle.text: Acquired from the Mirage Rise Imp Statue west of the Bower of Bounty Site of Grace in Altus Plateau.

Miranda Powder.text: Obtained by defeating miranda blossoms and miranda sprouts.

Miranda Sprout Ashes.text: Found behind an illusory wall in Caelid Catacombs.

Miriam's Vanishing.text: Available for purchase from Count Ymir upon first meeting him in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr. The Twin Maiden Husks sell Miriam's Vanishing if given Ymir's Bell Bearing.

Misbegotten Shortbow.text: Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Cave of the Forlorn & Miquella's Haligtree (Consecrated Snowfield). 2% drop chance from Winged Misbegotten enemies. A group of 3 can be found just southeast of the Ailing Village Outskirts Site of Grace in Weeping Peninsula, along the cliffs. 2 can be found on one of the small towers connected to the Beside the Rampart Gaol Site of Grace in Castle Morne.

Miséricorde.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Looted off a corpse that's only accessible behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open. The fog wall is near the roaming Grafted Scion inside Stormveil Castle and the elevator shortcut back up to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.

Mohg's Great Rune.text: Obtained upon defeat of Mohg, Lord of Blood in Mohgwyn Palace. Restored at the Divine Tower of East Altus found past the elevator used to access the Forbidden Lands.

Mohg's Shackle.text: Loot: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital). At the bottom of the large room full of pipes. The item is guarded by two Giant Crayfish.

Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear.text: Trade: Finger Reader Enia. Trade the Remembrance of the Blood Lord, dropped by Mohg, Lord of Blood, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Moldmonger's Bell Bearing.text: Loot: Recluses' River (Scadu Altus). Acquired from a rope-strung pot that can be found hanging from a rocky mountain wall directly east of the Recluses' River Downstream site of grace. The pot must be destroyed with a projectile for the item to become accessible.

Monk's Flameblade.text: Drop: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants). 4% chance to drop from Fire Monk enemies that wield it within the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave. Note that it does NOT drop from any Blackflame Monks that wield it. From the Site of Grace at the entrance, head further down the stairs into the Grave and take a right to find an illusory wall in the corner.

Monk's Flamemace.text: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Fort Laiedd (Mt. Gelmir) / Mountaintops of the Giants. 4% drop chance from mace-wielding Fire Monks. Mace-wielding Blackflame Monks cannot drop this weapon. A camp with two Fire Monks can be found at a camp southwest of the Scenic Isle Site of Grace in southern Liurnia.

Monk's Missive.text: After defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight it can be found in the next Site of Grace along with May the Best Win gesture. Go east until you find a grace with Dryleaf Dane nearby. Use the gesture to have a fight that rewards you with the Dryleaf Arts.

Moon of Nokstella.text: Loot: Nokstella, Eternal City (Siofra River). Obtained from a chest, underneath the throne, in northwestern Nokstella, Eternal City.

Moonrithyll's Knight Sword.text: Guaranteed drop: Castle Ensis. Moonrithyll's Knight Sword can be obtained after defeating the NPC Moonrithyll, Carian Knight. She's found outside of the chapel halfway on the path between the Castle Ensis Checkpoint and Castle-Lord's Chamber Sites of Grace.

Moonveil.text: Guaranteed Drop: Gael Tunnel (Caelid). Dropped by the Magma Wyrm in Gael Tunnel.

Moore's Bell Bearing.text: Guaranteed Drop & Loot from Moore. Its location and availability can be determined by the player's dialogue-choices as they talk to Moore about the breaking of Miquella's great rune:. Scadu Altus - If the player tells Moore to "Remain sad forever". Moore will quietly move to the cliffs north of the Church of the Crusade, where he can be found huddled up next to a motionless forager brood.

Morgott's Cursed Sword.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Omen King, gained by defeating the Morgott, the Omen King, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Morgott's Great Rune.text: Upon defeat of Morgott, the Omen King. Restored at the Divine Tower of East Altus found past the elevator used to access the Forbidden Lands.

Morning Star.text: Loot: Weeping Peninsula (Limgrave). Found in a broken down black carriage south of Bridge of Sacrifice and Irina in the Weeping Peninsula region.

Mottled Necklace.text: Obtained from a corpse in Siofra River, which lies at the end of a broken bridge, leading to Nokron, Eternal City. This area can only be reached from a waygate at one of The Four Belfries, next to a message that reads "Night Sky Unceasing".

Multilayered Ring of Light.text: Guaranteed Drop: Stone Coffin Fissure. Defeat the Phantom Misbegotten Warrior found past the Fissure Waypoint Site of Grace along the main path through the area.

Mushroom.text: Mushrooms grow throughout the Lands Between, especially in wetlands, making them fairly common in Liurnia of the Lakes and Limgrave. The Stormfoot Catacombs have two just outside the entrance, hidden in the grass. The Folly on the Lake site of grace in southern Liurnia of the Lakes has two just east of the Grace, with four more a bit to the north under a fallen stone structure.

Mushroom Arms.text: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.

Mushroom Body.text: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.

Mushroom Crown.text: Loot: Lake of Rot. Found on a corpse on top of a pillar in some ruins in the southeastern part of Lake of Rot.

Mushroom Head.text: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.

Mushroom Legs.text: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir.

My Lord.text: Quest Item: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Received from Boc the Seamster after obtaining any alterable Demigod Attire, giving him the Gold Sewing Needle, followed by allowing him to call the player "Lord" at the East Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

My Thanks.text: Quest Item: Volcano Manor. Found in the same spot as the Volcano Manor Apparition used to be at the end of the hallway after defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

Nagakiba.text: Loot: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Mountaintops of the Giants. The Nagakiba is either dropped by Bloody Finger Hunter Yura at the end of his questline at the Second Church of Marika or after being killed by the player.

Nailstone.text: Found in the Finger Ruins of Rhia and the Finger Ruins of Dheo.

Nanaya's Torch.text: Loot: Abyssal Woods. Found on a body inside of Midra's Manse. From the Midra's Library Site of Grace head west and jump across the rafters and bookcases to reach the northern wall and then continue west. Note that this requires pulling a lever to raise a bookcase at the end.

Nascent Butterfly.text: Abandoned Merchant in the Siofra River region (x5). Dropped with a 20% chance by two of the Ancestral Follower Shaman in the Ancestral Woods area of Siofra River. They are found surrounded by rats in the north-west of the area, looking out over the flooded ruins. No other shamans drop the item.

Navy Hood.text: Loot: East Windmill Pasture (Altus Plateau). Found on one of the corpses near the East Windmill Pasture.

Nectarblood Burgeon.text: Nectarblood Burgeons grow in the Garden of Deep Purple. Once harvested, they will not respawn until the next playthrough. Found around the Cerulean Coast Cross site of grace.

Nepheli Loux Puppet.text: Can be obtained through Preceptor Seluvis's questline, if Seluvis's Potion is given to Nepheli Loux.

Neutralizing Boluses.text: Recipe is included with Armorer's Cookbook [2], which can be purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Western Limgrave) for 1500 runes. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Western Limgrave). Infinitely purchasable from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Medicine Peddler's Bell Bearing.

New Cross Map.text: Given by Hornsent (character) as part of his questline.

Night Comet.text: Loot: Caelid. Acquired from a treasure chest blocked by a magic barrier in the middle of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. To dispel the barrier, light this specific barrier, light the brazier in the southwestern tower of the town.

Night Maiden Armor.text: Chance to drop from Night Maiden enemies.

Night Maiden Twin Crown.text: Chance to drop from Night Maiden enemies.

Night Maiden's Mist.text: Purchase: Caelid / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 5,000 Runes by Sage Gowry after he has repaired the snapped Unalloyed Gold Needle. Should Gowry die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Gowry's Bell Bearing.

Night Shard.text: Purchase: Caelid / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 4,000 Runes by Sage Gowry after he has repaired the snapped Unalloyed Gold Needle. Should Gowry die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Gowry's Bell Bearing.

Night's Cavalry Armor.text: Received upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield.

Night's Cavalry Armor (Altered).text: Received unaltered upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Night's Cavalry Gauntlets.text: Received upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield.

Night's Cavalry Greaves.text: Received upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield.

Night's Cavalry Helm.text: Received upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield.

Night's Cavalry Helm (Altered).text: Received unaltered upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Nightmaiden & Swordstress Puppets.text: Found in a chest in Nokstella, Eternal City, in a room unlocked using a Stonesword Key. From the Nokstella, Eternal City Site of Grace, simply head up the stairs until there is long bridge to your right, and the correct building will be on your left.

Nightrider Flail.text: Guaranteed Drop: Weeping Peninsula. Drop from the Night's Cavalry located in the Weeping Peninsula, found near the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace at night.

Nightrider Glaive.text: Guaranteed Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes. Dropped together with the Ash of War: Giant Hunt by a Night's Cavalry miniboss in Liurnia of the Lakes, immediately north of the East Raya Lucaria Gate grace where the Finger Reader Crone is. The Night's Cavalry only comes out during nighttime.

Noble Presence.text: Guaranteed Drop: Volcano Manor. Noble Presence is acquired by defeating the Godskin Noble found at the Temple of Eiglay on Mt. Gelmir.

Noble Sorcerer Ashes.text: Dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog at the end of Stormfoot Catacombs.

Noble's Estoc.text: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Mountaintops of the Giants / Consecrated Snowfield. Low (0.5%) drop chance from those Wandering Noble enemies that wield it, specifically the ones wearing the Aristocrat Hat and Aristocrat Coat. There are two immediately to the north of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace in eastern Limgrave, following a torch bearer.

Noble's Gloves.text: Found on one of the corpses near the East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau.

Noble's Slender Sword.text: Dropped by Wandering Nobles that wield it with a 0.5% drop rate. These specific nobles are distinguished by wearing the Aristocrat Garb (Altered) and Aristocrat Boots. Sword-and-torch-wielding nobles will not drop the sword. The Carriage on the road that runs north from the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace has several of these Nobles in its caravan.

Noble's Traveling Garb.text: Found on one of the corpses near the East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau.

Noble's Trousers.text: Found on one of the corpses near the East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau.

Nod In Thought.text: Quest Item: Limgrave. Given to the player after becoming Sorceress Sellen's apprentice by Waypoint Ruins.

Nomad Ashes.text: Found on a corpse in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, hanging off a ledge on the second broken curved staircase. From the Underground Roadside Site of Grace, head to the far left end of the corridor, through the locked shortcut gate and go to the spiraling stair on the right. Carefully drop down to the left to get to a second set of spiraling stairs.

Nomadic Merchant's Chapeau.text: Found behind breakable decor after the Cathedral of the Forsaken site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Requires using a Nomadic Merchant enemy to destroy it using his frenzied flame attack.

Nomadic Merchant's Finery.text: Found behind breakable decor after the Cathedral of the Forsaken site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Requires using a Nomadic Merchant enemy to destroy it using his frenzied flame attack.

Nomadic Merchant's Finery (Altered).text: Found unaltered behind breakable decor after the Cathedral of the Forsaken site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Requires using a Nomadic Merchant enemy to destroy it using his frenzied flame attack. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Nomadic Merchant's Trousers.text: Found behind breakable decor after the Cathedral of the Forsaken site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Requires using a Nomadic Merchant enemy to destroy it using his frenzied flame attack.

Note: Below the Capital.text: Purchased from the Hermit Merchant of the Capital Outskirts for 800 Runes.

Note: Demi-human Mobs.text: Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region.

Note: Flask of Wondrous Physick.text: The Note: Flask of Wondrous Physick is sold by Merchant Kalé, who can be found at the Church of Elleh near a Site of Grace.

Note: Land Squirts.text: Sol by the Nomadic Merchant (Western Limgrave) southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.

Note: Sealed Spiritsprings.text: Purchase: Gravesite Plain / Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 1000 from Moore or from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Moore's Bell Bearing.

Note: Stonedigger Trolls.text: Sold by the Nomadic Merchant (Western Limgrave) southeast of Coastal Cave, beneath the collapsed structure.

Note: The Lord of Frenzied Flame.page: Note: The Lord of Frenzied Flame

Note: The Preceptor's Secret.text: Purchased from the Isolated Merchant outside of Raya Lucaria for 1,200 Runes.

Note: Wandering Mausoleum.text: Isolated Merchant in his shack in the Weeping Peninsula region (x1).

Note: Waypoint Ruins.text: The Note: Waypoint Ruins can be purchased from Merchant Kalé, who can be found at the Church of Elleh near the Site of Grace.

Nox Bracelets.text: 3% chance to drop from Nox Monk, Nox Swordstress, and Nox Nightmaiden enemies in Nokron and Nokstella.

Nox Flowing Hammer.text: Loot: Nokron, Eternal City (Siofra River). Found on a corpse in Night's Sacred Ground, located in Nokron, Eternal City. It is found near the Mimic Tear Ashes. From the Ancestral Woods Site of Grace, head down into the Eternal City until you reach the room with a Giant Silver Tear.

Nox Flowing Sword.text: Guaranteed Drop: Sellia, Town of Sorcery (Caelid). Received upon defeating the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk duo boss in Sellia, Town of Sorcery, just east of the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid. Accessing the duo requires lighting the three braziers in the town to remove a seal.

Nox Mirrorhelm.text: Loot: Liurnia of the Lakes. The Nox Mirrorhelm is located at the Cliffbottom Catacombs in southeast Liurnia. It is found on body placed behind a stonesword key imp statue that is unlocked with one Stonesword Key.

Nox Monk Armor.text: Chance to drop from Nox Monk enemies.

Nox Monk Armor (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Nox Monk enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Nox Monk Hood.text: Chance to drop from Nox Monk enemies.

Nox Monk Hood (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Nox Monk enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Nox Swordstress Armor.text: Chance to drop from Nox Swordstress enemies.

Nox Swordstress Armor (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Nox Swordstress enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Nox Swordstress Crown.text: Chance to drop from Nox Swordstress enemies.

Nox Swordstress Crown (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Nox Swordstress enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

O Mother.text: Loot: Bonny Village. Acquired from a headless corpse performing the gesture under a tree, found near some cliffs at the northeastern edge of Bonny Village.

O, Flame!.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for runes 6,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Fire Monks' Prayerbook.

Oathseeker Knight Armor.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from a corpse on a ledge by the front-entrance-way to the Church of Benediction.

Oathseeker Knight Gauntlets.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from a corpse on a ledge by the front-entrance-way to the Church of Benediction.

Oathseeker Knight Greaves.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from a corpse on a ledge by the front-entrance-way to the Church of Benediction.

Oathseeker Knight Helm.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from a corpse on a ledge by the front-entrance-way to the Church of Benediction.

Obsidian Lamina.text: Quest reward: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Available after successfully assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Specimen Storehouse. Then defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The item can be recovered from Ansbach's body, which can be found seated against one of the walls close to the entrance of the boss arena.

Octopus Head.text: Chance to drop from Land Octopus enemies.

Official's Attire.text: Hidden within a room that you can only reach from the elevator ride that leads down to the Forbidden Lands grace.

Oil Pot.text: Craftable after purchasing the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [17] from the Abandoned Merchant (Siofra River) for 1000 runes.

Oil-Soaked Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Scadu Altus. Dropped by the Furnace Golem found in the water near the Castle Watering Hole Site of Grace just outside of the Shadow Keep in Scadu Altus.

Okina Mask.text: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants. Received upon defeating the NPC invader Bloody Finger Okina near the Church of Repose.

Old Aristocrat Cowl.text: Dropped by the Wandering Noble wearing the cowl, walking with a large banner and bearing a horn. There are two in the vicinity of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One will be up the hill to the east, and the other will be north along the road. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass will allow the Tarnished to kill the noble uncontested.

Old Aristocrat Gown.text: Dropped by the Wandering Noble wearing the cowl, walking with a large banner and bearing a horn. There are two in the vicinity of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One will be up the hill to the east, and the other will be north along the road. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass will allow the Tarnished to kill the noble uncontested.

Old Aristocrat Shoes.text: Dropped by the Wandering Noble wearing the cowl, walking with a large banner and bearing a horn. There are two in the vicinity of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One will be up the hill to the east, and the other will be north along the road. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass will allow the Tarnished to kill the noble uncontested.

Old Lord's Talisman.text: Loot: Crumbling Farum Azula. Obtained from a chest in Crumbling Farum Azula guarded by three Beastmen and an invading Recusant Bernahl. From Beside the Great Bridge, climb up to the bridge, and head north, down some stairs and eventually a ladder, to reach a long walkway, where the invasion occurs. The chest is in the tower at the end of this walkway.

Old Sorcerer's Legwraps.text: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway cave to loot the Lusat armor set.

Olivinus Glintstone Crown.text: Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria Liurnia of the Lakes. Found on a body reached by taking a left after the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace and going through an illusory wall, then jumping over the railing to the left and climbing a series of rocks at the end of that path.

Omen Armor.text: Received at the of Dung Eater's questline once you kill him.

Omen Bairn.text: Guaranteed Drop: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital). Guaranteed drop from a specific Cleaver-wielding Omen by the ladder leading up to the wooden, double-door shortcut to the Underground Roadside Site of Grace.

Omen Cleaver.text: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. 4% drop chance from sword-wielding Omens. One can be found just outside of hte Liftside Chamber Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle, sitting beside a Stray (a Beast-Repellent Torch can help keep the latter away to make the fight easier).

Omen Gauntlets.text: Received at the of Dung Eater's questline once you kill him.

Omen Greaves.text: Received at the of Dung Eater's questline once you kill him.

Omen Helm.text: Received at the end of Dung Eater's questline once you kill him.

Omenkiller Boots.text: Received upon defeating an Omenkiller inside the Perfumer's Ruin located in Altus Plateau.

Omenkiller Long Gloves.text: Received upon defeating an Omenkiller inside the Perfumer's Ruin located in Altus Plateau.

Omenkiller Robe.text: Received upon defeating an Omenkiller inside the Perfumer's Ruin located in Altus Plateau.

Omenkiller Rollo.text: Dropped by the Fell Twins who are encountered on the bridge leading to the Divine Tower of East Altus.

Omensmirk Mask.text: Guaranteed drop: Leyndell, Royal Capital. Dropped by an Omenkiller enemy right outside the Lower Capital Church Site of Grace.

One-Eyed Shield.text: Guaranteed Drop: Guardians' Garrison (Mountaintops of the Giants). Dropped by Chief Guardian Arghanthy in the Guardians' Garrison in Mountaintops of the Giants.

Onyx Lord's Greatsword.text: Guaranteed drop: Sealed Tunnel (Capital Outskirts). Dropped by the Onyx Lord boss at the end of the Sealed Tunnel in Capital Outskirts.

Opaline Bubbletear.text: Guaranteed drop: Minor Erdtree (Weeping Peninsula). Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar at the Weeping Peninsula's Minor Erdtree, along with the Crimsonburst Crystal Tear.

Opaline Hardtear.text: Guaranteed drop: Minor Erdtree (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow). Dropped along with the Stonebarb Cracked Tear by the Putrid Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow, north of Fort Faroth.

Opaline Pickled Liver.text: Can be crafted after acquiring the Forager Brood Cookbook [5] in Scadu Altus. Talk to the forager brood member located near the poison swamp-waters, by the cliffs overlooking the Castle Watering Hole. This swamp can be accessed through an underground cave system found north of Moorth Ruins.

Oracle Bubbles.text: Siofra River region: in the ruins near the Mistwood entrance (Siofra River Well) to the underground region. It's on top of the large, broken statue. To get to it, head to the next level up in the ruins, then carefully traverse the ruins' beams to get to the area above the statue to drop down on the Teardrop Scarab and kill it to get the drop.

Oracle Envoy Ashes.text: Found near the start of Miquella's Haligtree, guarded by several Oracle Envoys.

Order Healing.text: Guaranteed Drop: Nokron, Eternal City. Drops from a Scarab found in the circular room in the southeastern quarter of Siofra Aqueduct, past the Crucible Tree Knight.

Order's Blade.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Sold by D, Hunter of the Dead for 3,000 rune Runes after speaking to Gurranq in the Bestial Sanctum.

Ordovis's Greatsword.text: Guaranteed drop: Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau). Ordovis's Greatsword is received upon defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis and Crucible Knight duo boss at the bottom of the Auriza Hero's Grave.

Ornamental Straight Sword.text: Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation, either by beating it first try when starting the game or when visiting again through The Four Belfries in west Liurnia of the Lakes.

Outer God Heirloom.text: Loot: Prospect Town (Gravesite Plain). It can be found inside a chest inside a small building.

Outer Order.text: Given to the player when talking to Melina in the Minor Erdtree Church.

Page Ashes.text: Cliffbottom Catacombs, the same floor with the lever that opens the boss room.

Page Garb.text: Chance to drop from Page enemies.

Page Garb (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Page enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Page Hood.text: Chance to drop from Page enemies.

Page Trousers.text: Chance to drop from Page enemies.

Parrying Dagger.text: 1 can be bought from Patches for 1,600 Runes in any of his locations (Murkwater Cave is the earliest).

Partisan.text: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Mt. Gelmir / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Deeproot Depths. Can be dropped from Knight enemies that wield it, such as the Godrick Knight in the Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave, or the two Leyndell Knight near the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace in Mt. Gelmir.

Pata.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain (Realm of Shadow). Acquired from a corpse on a ledge by the front-entrance-way to the Church of Benediction.

Patches' Crouch.text: Quest Item: Limgrave. Obtained from Patches after he returns to Murkwater Cave from The Shaded Castle and surrenders the fight.

Pearl Shield Talisman.text: Found inside a chest in a small camp of Messmer soldiers in the woods. Southwest of the Taylew's Ruined Forge Site of Grace.

Pearldrake Talisman.text: Obtained from a corpse on the north end of the western isolated platform in Crumbling Farum Azula. This area is only accessible via the waygate at the first of The Four Belfrys in western Liurnia of the Lakes, next to a message that reads "Crumbling Lands". After traveling through the waygate, drop down several platforms to reach a pair of Beastmen and drop from the northern edge of this platform to find the corpse.

Pearlescent Scale.text: Dropped by lamprey in the Finger Ruins of Rhia and Dheo.

Pelt of Ralva.text: Guaranteed Drop: Scadu Altus (Realm of Shadow). Dropped from Ralva the Great Red Bear whom can be found by a pond in a forest, located northeast of the Highroad Cross site of grace.

Perfume Bottle.text: There are ten Perfume Bottles to be found throughout the Lands Between. Most of them are located on or around the Altus Plateau, where the Perfumers were previously based. x1 in Caelid, in the Street of Sages Ruins. x1 sold by the Hermit Merchant in the Capital Outskirts for 2,000 runes. x2 In Perfumer's Ruins. One is guarded by an Omenkiller.

Perfumed Oil of Ranah.text: Loot: Cerulean Coast. Found on the island where the Southern Nameless Mausoleum containing the Dancer of Ranah is located, on a hill northwest of the mausoleum.

Perfumer Gloves.text: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

Perfumer Hood.text: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

Perfumer Robe.text: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

Perfumer Robe (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Perfumer enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Perfumer Sarong.text: Chance to drop from Perfumer enemies.

Perfumer Tricia.text: Dropped by Perfumer Tricia & Misbegotten Warrior in Unsightly Catacombs.

Perfumer's Bolt.text: Random Drop:. Perfumers. Noble Page (5x, 10% chance for regular Page variant and 25% chance for High Page variant).

Perfumer's Shield.text: Drop: Altus Plateau/Leyndell, Royal Capital/Scadu Altus/Shadow Keep. 2% drop chance from Perfumer enemies in the base game. Several can be found throughout Perfumer's Grotto, making it a good place to farm for this shield. 4% drop chance from Perfumers found in Shadow of the Erdtree.

Perfumer's Talisman.text: Obtained from a chest in the cellar of Perfumer's Ruins, in southwestern Mt. Gelmir.

Perfumer's Traveling Garb.text: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid.

Perfumer's Traveling Garb (Altered).text: Found unaltered on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Pest Threads.text: Quest Item / Purchase: Gowry's Shack (Caelid). Sold for runes 7,500 Runes by Sage Gowry after giving Millicent the Valkyrie's Prosthesis.

Pest's Glaive.text: Chance to drop from Kindred of Rot enemies.

Pest-Thread Spears.text: Loot: Ancient Ruins of Rauh. From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West Site of Grace, head west into the ruins and take the elevator up inside of it. Exit the ruins and head across the small body of water to the ruin with Scarlet Rot puddles, and go to the far-left back corner to find the spell.

Phantom Bloody Finger.text: Automatically and temporarily acquired when invading another world. Which Phantom Finger gets obtained depends on what invasion-item was being used to invade said world.

Phantom Great Rune.text: Automatically and temporarily acquired when invading another world after having activated Mohg's Great Rune through the use of a Rune Arc in one's own world.

Phantom Recusant Finger.text: Automatically and temporarily acquired when invading another world. Which Phantom Finger gets obtained depends on what invasion-item was being used to invade said world.

Pickaxe.text: 2% drop chance from miners found in mining galleries throughout the Lands Between.

Pickled Turtle Neck.text: Purchase: Limgrave. 3 are sold by the Nomadic Merchant in northern Limgrave for runes 800 Runes each. Loot: Weeping Peninsula / Stormveil Castle / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. 1 is found in Castle Morne, in the prison cell next to the Beside the Rampart Gaol Site of Grace (note that a Skeletal Slime is lying in ambush above).

Pike.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Found on a corpse inside Stormveil Castle, in the open area with flamethrower enemies.

Pillory Shield.text: Loot: Gaol Cave (Caelid). After using the lever to open all the cages in the cave, drop down forwards from the lever platform and turn left, and then a now-opened caged cave on the left contains this item and an Old Fang.

Piquebone Arrow.text: Craftable: Grave Keeper's Cookbook [1]. x1 Thin Beast Bones. x2 Congealed Putrescence. x1 Human Bone Shard.

Piquebone Arrow (Fletched).text: Craftable: Grave Keeper's Cookbook [1]. x1 Thin Beast Bones. x2 Congealed Putrescence. x1 Human Bone Shard.

Piquebone Bolt.text: Craftable: Grave Keeper's Cookbook [1]. x2 Thin Beast Bones. x2 Congealed Putrescence. x1 Human Bone Shard.

Placidusax's Ruin.text: Trade Enia a Remembrance of the Dragonlord.

Point Downwards.text: Available from the start of the game.

Point Forwards.text: Available from the start of the game.

Point Upwards.text: Available from the start of the game.

Poisonbloom.text: Poisonbloom can be harvested in swamps around the Lands Between. The flowers glow pink. Dropped by miranda blossoms and miranda sprouts.

Poisonbone Arrow.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [3], sold by Nomadic Merchant (Northern Limgrave).

Poisonbone Arrow (Fletched).text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [3], sold by Nomadic Merchant (Northern Limgrave).

Poisonbone Bolt.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [3], sold by Nomadic Merchant (Northern Limgrave).

Poisonbone Dart.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [14], found on a corpse within Smoldering Church.

Poisoned Hand.text: Loot: Belurat, Tower Settlement (Land of the Tower). Found by the northern edge of the poison swamp that can only be accessed through the sewers. The Well Depths Key is needed to access this area.

Poisoned Stone.text: This item may be purchased in unlimited supply from the Nomadic Merchant (Caelid Highway North). Dropped by the poison variety of Miners.

Poisoned Stone Clump.text: This item may be purchased in unlimited supply from the Nomadic Merchant (Caelid Highway North). Dropped by the poison variety of Miners.

Poleblade of the Bud.text: Trade: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud. Trade the Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

Polite Bow.text: Quest Item: Caelid. Received by interacting with Finger Maiden Therolina inside Redmane Castle, before the boss fight with Starscourge Radahn.

Prattling Pate \"Apologies\".text: Loot: Altus Plateau. Acquired from a corpse in the Unsightly Catacombs, it can be found near the lever that opens the heavy gate to the boss room.

Prattling Pate \"Hello\".text: Loot: Limgrave. Acquired from a corpse hidden behind the first Flame Pillar in the Stormfoot Catacombs.

Prattling Pate \"Lamentation\".text: Loot: Lamenter's Gaol. The Prattling Pate is found on a corpse inside the Lamenter's Goal. Enter the dungeon and progress till you see an opening on the left before the first door. After crossing the stone bridge, enter the room on the left, and the item will be found on a dead body.

Prattling Pate \"My beloved\".text: Miquella's Haligtree, all the way up in the canopy at the start on a branch.

Prattling Pate \"Please help\".text: In the Impaler's Catacombs, in the first watery room with zombies.

Prattling Pate \"Thank you\".text: Loot: Weeping Peninsula. Acquired from a corpse in Tombsward Catacombs towards the end of the path on the first level, in the room to the left of the flame pillar.

Prattling Pate \"Wonderful\".text: Cliffbottom Catacombs, in the pit at the bottom of the staircase after the elevator.

Prattling Pate \"You're beautiful\".text: Can be looted from a body in the Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir.

Prayer.text: Quest Item: Roundtable Hold. Given to the player after telling Brother Corhyn that they can still see the Guidance of Grace when they first meet him at the Roundtable Hold.

Preceptor's Big Hat.text: Loot: Seluvis's Rise (Liurnia of the Lakes). Found on Seluvis's body after giving Ranni the Witch the Fingerslayer Blade.

Preceptor's Gloves.text: Found after advancing Ranni's questline until Seluvis dies, inside Seluvis's Rise located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Preceptor's Long Gown.text: Found after finishing Ranni's questline inside Seluvis's Rise located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Preceptor's Long Gown (Altered).text: Found after finishing Ranni's questline (unaltered) inside Seluvis's Rise located in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Preceptor's Trousers.text: Found after finishing Ranni's questline inside Seluvis's Rise located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Prelate's Inferno Crozier.text: Prelate's Inferno Crozier is dropped by a Fire Prelate in Fort Laiedd, west of the Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir. Prelate's Inferno Crozier will only drop one time in each playthrough.

Preserving Boluses.text: Craftable after obtaining the Armorer's Cookbook [6] from a corpse on ledge just to the northwest of Siofra River Bank. Sold by the Nomadic Merchant near the Astray from Caelid Highway North site of grace.

Priestess Heart.text: Loot: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion (Foot of the Jagged Peak). Found along with the Flowerstone Gavel at the spot where the Dragon Communion Priestess normally stands, after Bayle the Dread is defeated. Will not be there if the Priestess has been given Thiollier's Concoction, making it mutually exclusive with the Ancient Dragon Florissax Spirit Ash and Dragonbolt of Florissax Incantation.

Primal Glintstone Blade.text: Loot: Stargazer's Ruins (Mountaintops of the Giants). Obtained from a chest in the cellar of Stargazer's Ruins. The cellar is locked by a seal, which can be dispelled by summoning the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes near the NPC jellyfish that speaks, near the center of the ruins. Note that the NPC jellyfish does respawn, if killed.

Prince of Death's Cyst.text: Obtained by killing a Runebear in Deeproot Depths, in a cave behind a waterfall, northeast of the Deeproot Depths site of grace.

Prince of Death's Pustule.text: Obtained from a corpse next to the giant root-like face underneath Stormveil Castle.

Prince of Death's Staff.text: Loot: Deeproot Depths. Found on top of a building reached by running up the roots northeast of The Nameless Eternal City grace.

Prisoner Clothing.text: Starting gear for the Prisoner class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River).

Prisoner Iron Mask.text: Starting gear for the Prisoner class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River).

Prisoner Trousers.text: Starting gear for the Prisoner class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River).

Prophet Blindfold.text: Starting gear for the Prophet class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts).

Prophet Robe.text: Starting gear for the Prophet class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts).

Prophet Robe (Altered).text: Starting gear for the Prophet class (unaltered). Purchased unaltered from Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts). Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

Prophet Trousers.text: Starting gear for the Prophet class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts).

Prosthesis-Wearer Heirloom.text: Quest reward: Caelid. Obtained from Millicent in central Caelid, after giving her the Unalloyed Gold Needle and waiting for her to recover.

Protection of the Erdtree.text: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau. Protection of the Erdtree is obtained upon defeating a Teardrop Scarab located on a square platform upon a hill southeast of the Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace.

Pulley Bow.text: Loot: Mt. Gelmir. Found on a corpse at the very top of a tower just west of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.

Pulley Crossbow.text: Loot: Craftsman's Shack (Mt. Gelmir). Found on a corpse near the Craftsman's Shack Site of Grace, on top of the wooden platforms just outside.

Pumpkin Helm.text: Drop: Lands Between. Has a base 3% chance to drop from Mad Pumpkin Head enemies.

Pureblood Knight's Medal.text: Rose Church in Liurnia of the Lakes (Fallen Ruins of the Lake). After receiving the Bloody Finger from White Mask Varré as a reward for soaking the Lord of Blood's Favor, speak to him again to obtain the Pureblood Knight's Medal.

Purifying Crystal Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Second Church of Marika (Altus Plateau). Dropped by Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger when she invades in the Second Church of Marika. This happens after Bloody Hunter Yura's moves there, either due to progressing his questline or by his death.

Putrescence Cleaver.text: Trade: Remembrance of Putrescence. Trade the Remembrance of Putrescence with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Putrid Corpse Ashes.text: Dropped by the Frenzied Duelist at the end of Gaol Cave.

Queelign's Blood Greatsword.text: Quest reward: Shadow Keep, Church District. This weapon can be obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation. That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.

Queelign's Cold Greatsword.text: Quest reward: Shadow Keep, Church District. This weapon can be obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation. That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.

Queelign's Fire Greatsword.text: Quest reward: Shadow Keep, Church District. This weapon can be obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation. That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.

Queelign's Flame Art Greatsword.text: Quest reward: Shadow Keep, Church District. This weapon can be obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation. That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.

Queelign's Greatsword.text: Quest reward: Shadow Keep, Church District. This weapon can be obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation. That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.

That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.

That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.

That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.

That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.

That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.

That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.

That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.

Queelign's Sacred Greatsword.text: Quest reward: Shadow Keep, Church District. This weapon can be obtained in the Shadow Keep after giving Fire Knight Queelign the Iris of Occultation. That makes this weapon mutually exclusive with the Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash, requiring a second Journey to get both on the same character.

Queen's Bracelets.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

Queen's Crescent Crown.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeated Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

Queen's Leggings.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

Queen's Robe.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.

Rabbath's Cannon.text: Loot: Rabbath's Rise (Scadu Altus). Found in the study of Rabbath's Rise. Can be accessed by ascending using a nearby Sealed Spiritspring or by descending down the rise from the cliffs southeast of Shaman Village.

Rabbath's Greatbolt.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Purchased for 800 from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Spellmachinist's Bell Bearing.

Rada Fruit.text: Can be found commonly throughout the Gravesite Plain and the Realm of Shadow. 10 are sold by Moore. Sold in unlimited quantity by the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Herbalist's Bell Bearing.

Radagon Icon.text: Obtained from a chest in Raya Lucaria Academy in central Liurnia of the Lakes. From Debate Parlor, head out into the courtyard, and right around the building. Jump over a fence, climb a ladder, and jump through a broken window to reach an upper landing, where the chest resides.

Radagon's Rings of Light.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for 7,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Golden Order Principia.

Radagon's Scarseal.text: Drop: Weeping Evergaol (Weeping Peninsula). Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss found in the evergaol, just northeast of the Fourth Church of Marika.

Radagon's Soreseal.text: Loot: Fort Faroth (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow). Found among the rats in the barn, reached from the roof of the fort. From the entrance, climb up the ladder and drop down from the tower onto the fort's roof. Drop down the hole on the other side of the gallows and go left and forwards of the ladder, then jump across to a second walkway.

Radahn Soldier Ashes.text: Found in the War-Dead Catacombs. From the main hall, take the back right set of stairs and go through the tunnel forward until there is a window to the right, just before the dead-end, that can be jumped out of to get to a platform. Take the stairs to the left up to a couple of Imps and it's found in a small room full of Scarlet Rot.

Radahn Soldier Gauntlets.text: 1.5% chance to drop from Radahn Soldier enemies.

Radahn Soldier Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Radahn Soldier enemies.

Radahn Soldier Helm.text: Chance to drop from Radahn Soldier enemies.

Radahn's Gauntlets.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

Radahn's Great Rune.text: Upon defeat of Starscourge Radahn. Restored at the Divine Tower of Caelid north of the grace Dragonbarrow West Site of Grace.

Radahn's Greaves.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

Radahn's Lion Armor.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

Radahn's Lion Armor (Altered).text: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Starscourge Radahn. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Radahn's Redmane Helm.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

Radahn's Spear.text: Loot:. Found throughout the Wailing Dunes. Purchase. Purchaseable from Finger Reader Enia for 800 Runes after defeating Starscourge Radahn.

Radiant Baldachin's Blessing.text: Quest Reward: Deeproot Depths. Given by Fia after handing her the Cursemark of Death. Only obtainable once per Journey.

Radiant Gold Mask.text: Can be found on a corpse at the edge of the north part of the broken bridge in Altus Plateau.

Raging Wolf Armor (Altered).text: Defeat Vargram the Raging Wolf and modify with Boc.

Raging Wolf Helm.text: Obtained as part of Bernahl's Volcano Manor quest. You will have to defeat two NPCs in a scripted invasion together with Bernahl in the Fortified Manor, Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Rain of Fire.text: Drop: Shadow Keep. Dropped by a Fire Knight in Shadow Keep that uses this spell, together with Salza's Hood. He's found at the end of the bridge just west of the West Rampart Site of Grace in the westernmost part of the Keep, and will try to target the player for large sections of the bridge unless line-of-sight is broken or Torrent is used to outrun the fire rain.

Rainbow Stone.text: Recipe is included with the Crafting Kit.

Rainbow Stone Arrow.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7], found on the broken bridge to the east of Stormveil Castle.

Rainbow Stone Arrow (Fletched).text: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. x10 Found among slugs in the first maze of pipes before the first shortcut.

Rakshasa Armor.text: Guaranteed Drop: Recluses' River (Scadu Altus). Acquired from defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

Rakshasa Gauntlets.text: Guaranteed Drop: Recluses' River (Scadu Altus). Acquired from defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

Rakshasa Greaves.text: Guaranteed Drop: Recluses' River (Scadu Altus). Acquired from defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

Rakshasa Helm.text: Guaranteed Drop: Recluses' River (Scadu Altus). Acquired from defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

Rakshasa's Great Katana.text: Guaranteed Drop: Eastern Nameless Mausoleum (Scadu Altus). Gained by defeating Rakshasa in the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum.

Rallying Cry.text: Available from the start of the game.

Rancor Pot.text: Craftable after obtaining the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [9], which is found behind a Stonesword Key barrier in the Tombsward Catacombs, in the Weeping Peninsula. Grave Violets are available in catacombs, as well as Jarburg. Human Bone Shards drop from Skeletons as well as Dominula Dancers.

Rancorcall.text: Guaranteed Drop: Stormveil Castle. Acquired from felling the Scarab on the road down to the Visage of Godwyn, southwest of the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace.

Ranni's Dark Moon.text: Chelona's Rise, in the south-west of the Moonfolk Ruins. You'll have to solve the puzzle with the three spirit turtles. One is right next to the Rise, the other at the cliff south-east of the Lunar Estate Ruins on a ledge and the third is flying above the evergaol portal in the north-west. You'll have to start at Chelona's Rise and travel to each location by foot/horse, otherwise the turtles don't spawn.

Rapier.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. One is sold for runes 1,000 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks.

Raptor Talons.text: Loot: Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau). Found inside Sage's Cave. They can be found inside a chest just beyond a room containing four skeletons, hidden behind an Illusory Wall.

Raptor's Black Feathers.text: Loot: Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau). Found inside a chest behind an illusory wall inside Sage's Cave.

Rapture.text: Recieved by interacting with the Two Fingers in the Roundtable Hold.

Rauh Burrow.text: Found at the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

Raw Meat Dumpling.text: Guaranteed Drop: Lands Between / Realm of Shadow. A 100% one-time drop from the Living Jar Warriors.

Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes.text: Found in a chest in Road's End Catacombs, behind an illusory wall near the end of the dungeon.

Raya Lucarian Gauntlets.text: 1.5% chance to drop from Raya Lucaria Soldier enemies.

Raya Lucarian Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Soldier enemies.

Raya Lucarian Helm.text: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Soldier enemies.

Raya Lucarian Robe.text: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Sorcerer enemies.

Recusant Finger.text: Obtainable after accepting Tanith's proposition and joining the Volcano Manor as a Recusant, it can be found on the table within the drawing-room of Volcano Manor.

Red Bear's Claw.text: Guaranteed Drop: Northern Nameless Mausoleum (accessed through Rauh Base). Acquired from defeating the Red Bear NPC bossfight in the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

Red Branch Shortbow.text: Drop: Tombsward Ruins (Weeping Peninsula) / Academy of Raya Lucaria & Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Redmane Castle (Caelid) / Shaded Castle & Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) / Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain). 4% chance to drop from Pages and Noble Pages. 2 regular Pages can be found in the underground part of Tombsward Ruins.

Red Crest Heater Shield.text: Purchase: Altus Plateau. One is sold for runes 2,500 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant just north of the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace, or southwest of the Minor Erdtree in Altus Plateau.

Red Fulgurbloom.text: Red Fulgurbloom grows on the Jagged Peak near the Southern Shore of the Realm of Shadow.

Red Letter.text: Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor). Quest: Tanith. Found in the drawing-room, after Rileigh the Idle has been disposed of.

Red Lightning Pot.text: Crafted with Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook 1.

Red Thorn Roundshield.text: Equipped:. One is part of the start gear for the Samurai class. Purhase: Weeping Peninsula. One is sold for runes 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant on the path to Castle Morne, at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.

Red-Feathered Branchsword.text: Obtained from a Deathbird in central Liurnia of the Lakes, which spawns at night, northeast of Scenic Isle.

Red-Hot Whetblade.text: Caelid (Chamber Outside the Plaza). Area: inside the building north-west of the Site of Grace, past the Abductor Virgin.

Redflesh Mushroom.text: Redflesh Mushrooms may be harvested in the Realm of Shadow. They are found commonly throughout the Gravesite Plain. One found on a corpse in the Scorched Ruins.

Redmane Fire Pot.text: Crafted with Armorer's Cookbook [4]. Note that this location is not available when the Radahn Festival is active.

Redmane Greatshield.text: Drop: Caelid. 4% drop chance from Redmane Knights (except for the Greatbow-wielding ones). A lone Redmane Knight can be found in a small camp a bit southwest of the Smoldering Wall Site of Grace. Three Redmane Knights can be found atop Fort Gael (ignoring the Greatbow-wielder outside of the Fort, since it can't drop the Greatshield).

Redmane Knight Armor.text: Chance to drop from Redmane Knight enemies.

Redmane Knight Armor (Altered).text: Chance to drop unaltered from Redmane Knight enemies. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Redmane Knight Gauntlets.text: 3% chance to drop from Redmane Knight enemies.

Redmane Knight Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Redmane Knight enemies.

Redmane Knight Helm.text: Chance to drop from Redmane Knight enemies.

Redmane Knight Ogha.text: Dropped by the Putrid Tree Spirit in War-Dead Catacombs.

Redmane Surcoat.text: Chance to drop from Radahn Soldier enemies.

Reduvia.text: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave. Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus near Murkwater Cave after defeating him. Beware that progressing through the game can prevent this invasion from happening, more specifically by defeating all the major Limgrave bosses (Flying Dragon Agheel, Mad Pumpkin Head, Margit, the Fell Omen, Tibia Mariner, and Tree Sentinel).

Reed Great Katana.text: Loot: Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. Found on a corpse close to the Fort Faroth site of grace, sitting on top of a large malformed skull next to where Greyoll lies.

Regal Omen Bairn.text: Trade the Remembrance of the Omen King, gained by defeating Morgott, the Omen King, and 5000 Runes with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Regalia of Eochaid.text: Loot: Gaol Cave (Caelid). Found on a ledge at the beach bordering Caelid and Limgrave, to the east of the Third Church of Marika. It can be reached through the Gaol Cave or by using Torrent to perform some tricky jumps to ascend the cliff face onto its ledge.

Rejection.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for runes 1,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn. Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Corhyn's Bell Bearing.

Rejuvenating Boluses.text: Recipe is included with Missionary's Cookbook [7], sold by Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants) for 7500 runes.

Rellana's Armor.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 15000 from Enia, after defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight.

Rellana's Cameo.text: Found in: Castle Ensis. Found just behind Moonrithyll, Carian Knight, lying on an altar.

Rellana's Gloves.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight.

Rellana's Greaves.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight.

Rellana's Helm.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 10000 from Enia, after defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight.

Rellana's Twin Blades.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight, gained by defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Rellana's Twin Moons.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight, gained by defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Remembrance Duplication Coffins to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Remembrance of Hoarah Loux.text: Leyndell, Ashen Capital (Queen's Bedchamber). Drop: Godfrey, First Elden Lord.

Remembrance of a God and a Lord.page: Remembrance of a God and a Lord
Remembrance of a God and a Lord.text: Enir-Ilim (Top of tower). Drop: Remembrance of a God and a Lord. alongside Circlet of Light.

Remembrance of the Black Blade.text: Crumbling Farum Azula (Beside the Great Bridge). Drop: Maliketh, the Black Blade.

Remembrance of the Blasphemous.text: Mt. Gelmir (Audience Pathway). Drop: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, alongside Rykard's Great Rune.

Remembrance of the Blood Lord.text: Mohgwyn Palace (Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint). Drop: Mohg, Lord of Blood, alongside Mohg's Great Rune.

Remembrance of the Dragonlord.text: Crumbling Farum Azula (Besides the Great Bridge). Drop: Dragonlord Placidusax.

Remembrance of the Fire Giant.text: Mountaintops of the Giants (Foot of the Forge). Drop: Fire Giant.

Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen.page: Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen
Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Debate Parlor). Drop: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, alongside Great Rune of the Unborn.

Remembrance of the Grafted.text: Limgrave (Secluded Cell). Drop: Godrick the Grafted, alongside Godrick's Great Rune.

Remembrance of the Lichdragon.text: Deeproot Depths (Prince of Death's Throne). Drop: Lichdragon Fortissax.

Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flam.page: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame
Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flam.text: Drop: Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame.

Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers.page: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers

Remembrance of the Naturalborn.text: Ainsel River (Grand Cloister). Drop: Astel, Naturalborn of the Void.

Remembrance of the Omen King.text: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Queen's Bedchamber). Drop: Morgott, the Omen King, alongside Morgott's Great Rune.

Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor.text: Dropped by the Regal Ancestor Spirit in Nokron, Eternal City.

Remembrance of the Rot Goddess.text: Miquella's Haligtree (Haligtree Roots). Drop: Malenia, Blade of Miquella. alongside Malenia's Great Rune.

Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud.page: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud
Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud.text: Drop: Romina, Saint of the Bud.

Remembrance of the Starscourge.text: Caelid. Drop: Starscourge Radahn, alongside Radahn's Great Rune.

Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight.page: Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight

Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider.page: Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider

Rennala's Full Moon.text: Trade the Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen, gained by defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Repeating Crossbow.text: Loot: Scadu Altus. Found alongside the road just south of the Ghostflame Dragon north of the Moorth Highway, South Site of Grace and southwest of Moorth Ruins.

Rest.text: Available from the start of the game.

Retaliatory Crossed-Tree.text: Quest Reward: Highroad Cross (Scadu Altus). Received from talking to Needle Knight Leda, by the Highroad Cross site of grace after successfully assisting her in assassinating Ansbach at Specimen Storehouse. The player must kill Ansbach in the co-invasion with Leda in order to acquire this item, as killing him in the player's own world will not unlock the dialogue option that has her give away this item.

Revered Spirit Ash.text: There are a total of 25 Revered Spirit Ashes within the Land of Shadow. Gravesite Plain contains 9 of them. One is at the eastern cliff on an altar, near a waterfall, to the west of the Church of Consolation and east of Scorched Ruins. One is in the Abandoned Ailing Village on an altar surrounded by fly enemies.

Reverential Bow.text: Given to the player by Mad Tongue Alberich in the Roundtable Hold. Alberich will invade in the great hall bellow the balcony, where he will perform the gesture himself before engaging in combat. The gesture is received when he completes the animation.

Reverse-Bladed Sword.text: Purchase: Twin Maiden Husks. Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 1,000 Runes.

Rickety Shield.text: Equipped:. One is part of the starting gear for the Prophet class. Drop: Limgrave/Weeping Peninsula/Liurnia of the Lakes/Mt. Gelmir/Altus Plateau. 2% drop chance from sword-and-shield wielding Demi-Humans.

Rift Shield.text: Equipped:. One is part of the starting gear for the Prisoner class. Purchase: Bellum Highway (Liurnia of the Lakes). One is sold for runes 1,800 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant found just a bit north of Bellum Church.

Rimed Crystal Bud.text: Rimed Crystal Buds are found widely across cold regions such as the Mountaintops of the Giants and Consecrated Snowfield.

Rimed Rowa.text: Found throughout the Mountaintops of the Giants. Can be found in high-altitude bushes or as random drops near the coldest regions of the highlands.

Ring of Miquella.text: Players who pre-ordered the Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree expansion will receive this gesture automatically at the very start of every playthrough. If the player had already started a playthrough before pre-ordering the DLC, then the gesture will be automatically obtained the next time they resume with said playthrough.

Ringed Finger.text: Loot: Gelmir Hero's Grave (Mt. Gelmir). Found in a chest at the end of the initial lava-filled path in the Gelmir Hero's Grave, guarded by a Chariot. The first half or so of the path consist of running from cubbyhole to cubbyhole, but the second half is just lava that inflicts low damage slows down movement. Either backstepping or using the Skill: Quickstep can make traversing that second section much simpler.

Rings of Spectral Light.text: Found in Charo's Hidden Grave on top of the arch leading from the Site of Grace to the Death Rite Bird. Go east from the Site of Grace to find the path up. The sorcery lies on an altar surrounded by Gravebirds.

Ripple Blade.text: Purchase: Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes). 1 is sold for runes 3500 Runes by Pidia, Carian Servant, in the hidden floor accessed from the back side of Caria Manor after defeating Royal Knight Loretta.

Ripple Crescent Halberd.text: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Consecrated Snowfield / Mohgwyn Palace. Has a base 2% chance to be dropped by the Second-Generation Albinaurics that wield it.

Ritual Pot.text: 2 are sold by merchants:. 1 sold for 1500 runes by Pidia, Carian Servant, found at the end of Caria Manor in Liurnia of the Lakes. 1 sold for 3000 runes by Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow) at the Isolated Merchant's Shack (Dragonbarrow) in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. 8 are found in the world:.

Ritual Shield Talisman.text: Obtained from a corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital, lying in front of the coliseum in the south end of the city.

Ritual Sword Talisman.text: Loot: Mt. Gelmir. Obtained from a chest in the cellar of Lux Ruins, guarded by the Demi-Human Queen Gilika boss.

Ritual Thrusting Shield.text: Loot: Caelid Colosseum. Found on a corpse inside the Caelid Colosseum, just behind the Great Jar. Two Stonesword Keys are required to activate the elevator down in lower Siofra River by the Below the Well Site of Grace in order to reach this location.

Rivers of Blood.text: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants. Defeat Okina at the Church of Repose.

Riveted Wooden Shield.text: Equipped:. One is part of the starting gear for the Warrior class. Purchase: Limgrave. Sold for runes 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant in Mistwood, east Limgrave.

Roar Medallion.text: Guaranteed Drop: Limgrave Tunnels (Limgrave). Obtained by defeating the Stonedigger Troll in Limgrave Tunnels in central Limgrave.

Roar of Rugalea.text: Guaranteed drop: Rugalea the Great Red Bear. Roar of Rugalea is received upon defeating Rugalea in the woods in the northern part of the Rauh Base, northwest of the Ravine North Site of Grace.

Rock Blaster.text: Loot: Caelid. Acquired from a corpse in a shed at the upper levels of Sellia Crystal Tunnel.

Rock Heart.text: Loot: Jagged Peak. After finding the "Domain of Dragons" Painting, start at the Jagged Peak Mountainside Site of Grace and head up the mountain to a Spiritspring. Drop down to the right at the end of the long ledge and then drop down to the right again, then go down two small ledges to find the painter with the Heart.

Rock Sling.text: Loot: Swamp of Aeonia. Acquired from a treasure chest found in the cellar of Street of Sages Ruins.

Rogier's Letter.text: Found on Rogier's corpse after he passes away in Roundtable Hold.

Rogier's Rapier.text: Quest reward: Roundtable Hold. Given at +8 by Sorcerer Rogier after defeating Godrick the Grafted. It comes with Ash of War: Glintblade Phalanx pre-equipped on acquisition; however, its underlying base skill is Repeating Thrust.

Roiling Magma.text: Loot: Mt. Gelmir. Acquired from a corpse located in the Hermit's Shack found of the southern side of Mt. Gelmir.

Rold Medallion.text: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Elden Throne). Quest: Melina. Received by her upon resting at the Site of Grace, after interacting with the wall of thorns.

Ronin's Armor.text: Dropped by Shabriri on death, or left in his place if the Tarnished meets the Three Fingers and inherits the Frenzied Flame. Will not be dropped by Yura if he is killed before Shabriri possesses him.

Ronin's Armor (Altered).text: Dropped by Yura (unaltered) only once he his possessed by Shabriri during his questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Ronin's Gauntlets.text: Dropped by Yura only once he his possessed by Shabriri during his questline.

Ronin's Greaves.text: Dropped by Yura only once he his possessed by Shabriri during his questline.

Root Resin.text: Can easily be farmed from the Warmaster's Shack site of grace; there are three Root Resin spawns beneath a tree directly next to the grace. Can be purchased in unlimited quantity from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Greasemonger's Bell Bearing. small.

Roped Fetid Pot.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [4], found in Mistwood close to the map for Limgrave, East.

Roped Fire Pot.text: Recipe is included with the Crafting Kit.

Roped Fly Pot.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [24], found in Mohgwyn Palace on the cliffs south-east of the blood swamp.

Roped Magic Pot.text: Craftable after obtaining the Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4] from a chest northwest of Academy Gate Town site of grace. It is guarded by several Second-Generation Albinaurics.

Roped Oil Pot.text: Craftable after purchasing the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [17] from the Abandoned Merchant (Siofra River) for 1000 runes.

Roped Poison Pot.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [14], found on a corpse within Smoldering Church.

Roped Volcano Pot.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [20], sold by the Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir).

Rosus' Axe.text: Loot: Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes). Found inside Black Knife Catacombs, located to the northeast in Liurnia of the Lakes. It requires one Stonesword Key to access.

Rotbone Arrow.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [15], which can be bought from the Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid) for 4000 runes.

Rotbone Arrow (Fletched).text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [15], which can be bought from the Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid) for 4000 runes.

Rotbone Bolt.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [15], which can be bought from the Nomadic Merchant (Southern Caelid) for 4000 runes.

Rotten Battle Hammer.text: Guaranteed Drop: Consecrated Snowfield. Dropped by a Rotten Duelist enemy located west of the Consecrated Snowfield grace.

Rotten Breath.text: Dragon Communion: Caelid / Jagged Peak. Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid and the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 1 Dragon Heart.

Rotten Butterflies.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud, gained by defeating Romina, Saint of the Bud, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Remembrance Duplication Coffins to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Rotten Crystal Spear.text: Drop: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. 8% drop from the Putrid Crystalian enemies that wield it.

Rotten Crystal Staff.text: Drop: Miquella's Haligtree. 8% drop chance from Putrid Crystalian Mage enemies such as the one near the Elphael Inner Wall grace.

Rotten Crystal Sword.text: In a treasure chest guarded by three Crystalians in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, behind some large tree roots right after the Ephael Inner Wall grace.

Rotten Duelist Greaves.text: Dropped by the Rotten Duelist enemy located north west of Ordina, Liturgical Town in Consecrated Snowfield.

Rotten Duelist Helm.text: Dropped by the Rotten Duelist enemy located north west of the Consecrated Snowfield site of grace.

Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak.text: Dropped by the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist boss in the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.

Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak (Altered).text: Dropped unaltered by the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist boss in the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Rotten Greataxe.text: Guaranteed Drop: Ordina, Liturgical Town (Consecrated Snowfield). Dropped by a Rotten Duelist north-west of Ordina, Liturgical Town, together with the Rotten Duelist Greaves.

Rotten Staff.text: Guaranteed Drop: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree (Miquella's Haligtree). Dropped by the Putrid Avatar patrolling the bridge.

Rotten Stray Ashes.text: Found in a building in Sellia, Town of Sorcery, north of the Sellia Under-Stair Site of Grace.

Rotten Winged Sword Insignia.text: Obtained from Millicent after choosing to assist her in defeating her sisters, as part of her questline.

Round Shield.text: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula. One is sold for runes 1,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant at the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace.

Roundrock.text: Loot: Ellac River (Gravesite Plain), Recluses' River (Scadu Altus). Found scattered throughout banks of Ellac River and Recluses' River in the Realm of Shadow. Re-spawns upon resting at sites of grace.

Rowa Fruit.text: An early farming point is at The First Step site of grace in Limgrave, where some can be found in the nearby bushes. A more efficient farming spot can be found at Jarburg, where Tarnished Golden Sunflowers, Grave Violets, Poisonbloom, Erdleaf Flowers, and Crystal Buds also can be found.

Rowa Raisin.text: Recipe is included with the Crafting Kit.

Royal Greatsword.text: Guaranteed drop: Ranni's Rise (Three Sisters). Dropped by Blaidd, along with his armor set (except the Black Wolf Mask), when encountered at Ranni's Rise after Ranni the Witch's storyline has been completed. Killing him prior to this will award no items.

Royal House Scroll.text: Guaranteed Loot: Limgrave. Found on top of a ruined building on a hill just east of Agheel Lake South Site of Grace.

Royal Knight Armor.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

Royal Knight Armor (Altered).text: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Royal Knight Gauntlets.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

Royal Knight Greaves.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

Royal Knight Helm.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold once having defeated Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

Royal Remains Armor.text: Dropped upon defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains at the Roundtable Hold. The entire set can be found where he usually stands after killing him. He invades you once you have collected the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).

Royal Remains Gauntlets.text: Dropped upon defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains at the Roundtable Hold. The entire set can be found where he usually stands after killing him. He invades you once you have collected the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).

Royal Remains Greaves.text: Dropped upon defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains at the Roundtable Hold. The entire set can be found where he usually stands after killing him. He invades you once you have collected the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).

Royal Remains Helm.text: Dropped upon defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains at the Roundtable Hold. The entire set can be found where he usually stands after killing him. He invades you once you have collected the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right).

Ruin Fragment.text: Found near Fallen Ruins. Can be purchased in unlimited quantity from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing 4.

Ruins Greatsword.text: Drop: Redmane Castle (Caelid). Obtained upon defeating the optional Misbegotten Warrior and Crucible Knight duo boss at the Redmane Castle plaza. Do note that this fight is only available whenever the Radahn festival isn't active.

Ruins Map.text: Given by Count Ymir upon meeting him. It depicts the Finger Ruins of Rhia.

Ruins Map (2nd).text: Part of Count Ymir's questline. It depicts the Finger Ruins of Dheo.

Ruins Map (3rd).text: Given by Count Ymir after visiting both the Finger Ruins of Rhia and the Finger Ruins of Dheo. It depicts the Finger Ruins of Miyr.

Ruler's Mask.text: Found on a corpse on a broken caravan near the Abandoned Coffin site of grace in Altus Plateau.

Ruler's Robe.text: Found on a corpse on a broken caravan near the Abandoned Coffin site of grace in Altus Plateau.

Rune Arc.text: Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold (x5). Corpse on a ledge in Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid. Siofra River: found on a corpse near where the Golden Seed is. Follow the small path along the cliff's edges to the north to find a small cave with the corpse and a campfire. Can be earned by contact with other players:.

Rune of an Unsung Hero.text: Found throughout the Realm of Shadow.

Ruptured Crystal Tear.text: |-|Retail=. Guaranteed Drop: Minor Erdtree (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Minor Erdtree (Consecrated Snowfield).
