Left half: drops from a Erdtree Avatar found by the south-western Minor Erdtree of Liurnia, north of the Converted Tower Site of Grace. Dropped along with the left half of the Cerulean Crystal Tear.

Rusted Anchor.text: Guaranteed Drop: Morne Tunnel (Weeping Peninsula). Dropped by the Scaly Misbegotten area boss in Morne Tunnel.

Rusty Key.text: Limgrave (Stormveil Cliffside). Area: inside the dark room atop of the staircases. If Gatekeeper Gostoc isn't at the Godrick the Grafted Site of Grace or isn't dead, he'll lock the door behind the player, trapping them with the Banished Knight.

Rya's Necklace.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Boilprawn Shack). Merchant: Blackguard Big Boggart (1000 Runes). First talk with Rya, then speak to him selecting Give me the necklace and Deal.

Rykard's Great Rune.text: Upon the defeat of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Restored at the Divine Tower of West Altus found past the Sealed Tunnel, south-east of the Outer Wall Phantom Tree Site of Grace in Altus Plateau.

Rykard's Rancor.text: Trade the Remembrance of the Blasphemous, dropped by Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Sacramental Bud.text: Sacramental Buds are found growing around the Church of the Plague and Writheblood Ruins. Buds may only be harvested once per playthrough. Also dropped by Rotten Strays.

Sacrificial Axe.text: Guaranteed Drop: Weeping Peninsula. Received upon defeating the Deathbird in Weeping Peninsula. It will appear on south side of the wall north of Castle Morne at night, near where the wall meets the coast. If the (non-respawning) Archer Golem in the area is still alive, its arrows may help defeat the Deathbird (though it can hit either combatant).

Sacrificial Twig.text: Purchased for 5,000 runes from Patches, in Murkwater Cave in northern Limgrave, then later in Volcano Manor in central Mt. Gelmir. Purchased for 3,000 runes each (up to 3) from the Isolated Merchant in southwestern Weeping Peninsula, in southwestern Limgrave. Obtained from a corpse in eastern Limgrave, found lying in front of a large gravestone, on a cliff west of Mistwood Ruins.

Sage Hood.text: Loot: Stillwater Cave. The Sage Hood is found on a body inside Stillwater Cave, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Sage Robe.text: Can be found on a body inside Stillwater Cave located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Sage Trousers.text: Can be found on a body inside Stillwater Cave located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Salza's Hood.text: Guaranteed Drop: Shadow Keep. Drops from Salza, Sage of the Fire Knights, who can be found at the very end of bridge by the Western Rampart of the Shadow Keep, guarding the entrance to the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

Sanctified Whetblade.text: Guaranteed Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Fortified Manor, First Floor). Found on the second floor of the manor, at the spot where Smithing Master Hewg would sit and right next to the Hammer. WARNING: If Maliketh is defeated before this item is acquired it will become unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.

Sanctuary Stone.text: Found near Fallen Ruins. Sometimes dropped by Sentry Stones. Can be purchased in unlimited quantity from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 4.

Sanguine Amaryllis.text: Sanguine Amaryllis may only be found in the Realm of Shadow. It can be found growing in Rivermouth Cave.

Sanguine Noble Hood.text: Received upon defeating the Sanguine Noble invader, near the white trees north west of Consecrated Snowfield.

Sanguine Noble Robe.text: Received upon defeating the Sanguine Noble invader, near the white trees north west of Consecrated Snowfield.

Sanguine Noble Waistcloth.text: Received upon defeating the Sanguine Noble invader, near the white trees northwest of Consecrated Snowfield.

Scadutree Fragment.text: There are a total of 50 Scadutree Fragments within the Land of Shadow. Gravesite Plain contains 10 of them:. Two are found at the Church of Consolation. One is at the Scorched Ruins, dropped by a pot-carrying shadow at the graveyard.

Scale Armor.text: Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region.

Scaled Armor.text: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

Scaled Armor (Altered).text: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor to receive it unaltered. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Scaled Gauntlets.text: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

Scaled Greaves.text: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

Scaled Helm.text: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

Scarlet Aeonia.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess, gained by defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Scarlet Bud.text: Loot: Realm of Shadow. Harvestable buds grow in the rot-afflicted parts of the western Ancient Ruins of Rauh. They are found in abundance near the Church of the Bud. They grow at the Rauh Base below in rotten areas downstream from the Scorpion River Catacombs. Scarlet Buds are dropped by Scarlet Pests at the Rauh Ruins and Rauh Base.drop % needed.

Scarlet Tabard.text: Chance to drop from Radahn Foot Soldier enemies.

Scavenger's Curved Sword.text: Loot: Mt. Gelmir. After the stone bridge a bit west of the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite Site of Grace, the sword can be found on a corpse in a wagon next to the ladder leading upwards, right next to where the Grafted Scion lands.

Scepter of the All-Knowing.text: Guaranteed Drop: Leyndell, Ashen Capital. Defeat Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing.

Scholar's Armament.text: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 3,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins. Should Sellen die before purchasing this Sorcery from her, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Sellen's Bell Bearing.

Scholar's Shield.text: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 2,500 Runes by Sorceress Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins. Should Sellen die before purchasing this Sorcery from her, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Sellen's Bell Bearing.

Scimitar.text: Starting Equipment:. 2 are part of the starting equipment for the Warrior Origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold. 1 is sold for runes 600 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks.

Scorpion Kite Shield.text: Purchase: Altus Plateau. One is sold for runes 2,000 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant just north of the Forest-Spanning Greatbridge Site of Grace, or southwest of the Minor Erdtree in Altus Plateau.

Scorpion Stew.text: Quest Reward: Belurat, Tower Settlement. Given by the Hornsent Grandam if speaking to her while wearing the Divine Beast Head. Only one Scorpion Stew can be held at a time. A second, concurrent Stew can be acquired only by putting the first one in the Item Box and the speaking to the Hornsent Grandam again. Guaranteed drop: Belurat, Tower Settlement.

Scorpion's Stinger.text: Loot: Lake of Rot (Ainsel River). Found inside a chest near the Grand Cloister Site of Grace, located in the Lake of Rot. It inside the small shrine to the west that is guarded by a large group of Kindred of Rot.

Scouring Black Flame.text: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau. Scouring Black Flame is received upon defeating the Godskin Apostle at Dominula, Windmill Village, on the Altus Plateau.

Scriptstone.text: Recipe is included with Missionary's Cookbook [2], sold by Patches for 800 runes.

Scripture Wooden Shield.text: Equipped:. One is part of the starting gear for the Astrologer class. Drop: Limgrave/Weeping Peninsula/Mt. Gelmir/Altus Plateau/Stone Coffin Fissure. 2% drop chance from small shield-wielding Skeletons.

Scythe.text: Cliffbottom Catacombs, southeast Liurnia of the Lakes. On a boddy in the upper floor, guarded by four stone Imps.

Secret Rite Scroll.text: From the Storehouse, Fourth Floor Site of Grace, head outside and take the stairs to your left. Watch out for the Fire Knight at the second set of stairs. Before you encounter the Giant Bats, take the staircase to your left downwards. Head through the doorway; the scroll is on a table near the ledge, to your right.

Seedbed Curse.text: Leyndell, Royal Capital (East Capital Rampart). Area: past the first lift, on a corpse on the top floor of the building with the cracked ceiling. Leyndell, Royal Capital (West Capital Rampart). Area: inside the room of the Fortified Manor where the Dung Eater is found in the Roundtable Hold.

Sellen's Primal Glintstone.text: Weeping Peninsula (Fourth Church of Marika). Quest: Sorceress Sellen. After defeating Starscourge Radahn and retrieving the Stars of Ruin Spell, talk to her imprisoned body within the Witchbane Ruins.

Sellia's Secret.text: Received from Sage Gowry at Gowry's Shack after giving him the snapped Unalloyed Gold Needle from Commander O'Neil in the Heart of Aeonia.

Sellian Sealbreaker.text: Limgrave (Waypoint Ruins Cellar). Quest: Sorceress Sellen. After retrieving the Comet Azur Spell from Primeval Sorcerer Azur on Mt. Gelmir, talk to her and select Show Azur's sorcery.

Seluvis's Introduction.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Royal Moongazing Ground). Quest: Preceptor Seluvis. Talk to him selecting Ask about Nokron, after speaking to Blaidd the Half-Wolf in Siofra River.

Seluvis's Potion.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Royal Moongazing Ground). Quest: Preceptor Seluvis. Talk to him at his rise selecting Accept the task.

Sentry's Torch.text: Purchase: Capital Outskirts. 1x sold for runes 7,000 Runes by the Hermit Merchant at Hermit Merchant's Shack. More precisely, found north of the first rampart of the capital and by the northern wall, alternatively far west of the Minor Erdtree in the Capital Outskirts.

Serpent Arrow.text: the Dragonbarrow's Isolated Merchant sells endless Serpent Arrows for 120 runes each. Serpent Arrows are also dropped by Serpent Snails & Skeletal Snails.

Serpent Bow.text: Loot: Abandoned Cave (Caelid). Found inside the Abandoned Cave by a broken down Abductor Virgin in a pool of Scarlet Rot. After exiting the first pool of Scarlet Rot to the left, there is an opportunity to jump down into another pool of Scarlet Rot over a cliff to the right.

Serpent Crest Shield.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain. Reward from "Incursion" Painting, which can be acquired from interacting with the painting found in the Artist's Shack located on the cliffs southeast of Prospect Town.

Serpent Flail.text: Loot: Fog Rift Fort (Gravesite Plain). This weapon can be found inside a chest within Fog Rift Fort.

Serpent's Amnion.text: Mt. Gelmir (Temple of Eiglay). Area: on the altar.

Serpent-God's Curved Sword.text: Loot: Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes). Found near a giant Land Octopus on an overhang reached by a ladder to the side just before reaching the ladder to the Ruin-Strewn Precipice Overlook Site of Grace.

Serpent-Hunter.text: Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor). Loot: Can be picked up within the boss arena of Praetor Rykard. This item does not re-spawn when the player has one in either their inventory or chest, even in NG+. However it will re-spawn (and thus can be picked up again) from the same location should the player discard it. This is to make sure that the player always have the means of fighting Rykard with it.

Serpentbone Blade.text: Quest reward: Volcano Manor. Obtained from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress after defeating Rileigh the Idle. This reward can still be received after defeating the Lord of Blasphemy as long as the second Letter from Volcano Manor was obtained beforehand. In this case the Serpentbone Blade should appear where Tanith normally sits after the assassination is done.

Sewer-Gaol Key.text: Roundtable Hold. Quest: talk to the Dung Eater with at least one Seedbed Curse in inventory.

Sewing Needle.text: Limgrave (Coastal Cave): Dropped by the Demi-Human Chief duo bosses, alongside the Tailoring Tools.

Shabriri Grape.text: Limgrave (Godrick the Grafted). Area: in the room past the throne that leads to Liurnia of the Lakes, near a Stranded Soul. Liurnia of the Lakes (Laskyar Ruins). Area: within the Purified Ruins, in the underground treasure room alongside the Two Fingers Heirloom.

Shabriri's Woe.text: Obtained from a corpse in Frenzied Flame Village, in northeastern Liurnia of the Lakes. The corpse is found on the steps of a building. Can be chosen as a starting gift when creating a new character.

Shadow Bait.text: Loot: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. Shadow Bait is found on a corpse guarded by an Omen, past the large gate to the right of the Underground Roadside Site of Grace. If the gate is locked, take the ladder ahead and to the left of the Grace, then continue to the doorway on the far right of the room filled with pipes.

Shadow Militiaman Armor.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 1.5% chance of dropping from a Shadow Militia.

Shadow Militiaman Gauntlets.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 1.5% chance of dropping from a Shadow Militia.

Shadow Militiaman Greaves.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 1.5% chance of dropping from a Shadow Militia.

Shadow Militiaman Helm.text: Random Drop: Realm of Shadow. 1.5% chance of dropping from a Shadow Militia.

Shadow Sunflower.text: Found in places near the Scadutree, like Scadu Altus and Scaduview.

Shadow Sunflower Blossom.text: Trade: Finger Reader Enia. Trade the Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower, gained by defeating the Scadutree Avatar, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Shaman Furs.text: Shaman Furs have a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans.

Shaman Leggings.text: Shaman Leggings have a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans.

Shamshir.text: Loot: Highroad Cave (Limgrave). Found on a corpse on the biggest pillar in the body of water inside of Highroad Cave, guarded by two Giant Bats.

Shard Spiral.text: Quest Item/ Purchase: Academy of Raya Lucaria. Sold for 8,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen after choosing to side with her and help her vanquish Witch-Hunter Jerren at the Raya Lucaria Grand Library. Should Sellen die before this point in her questline, then this Sorcery will be left unavailable for the rest of the playthrough.

Shard of Alexander.text: Obtained from Iron Fist Alexander after completing his questline, by defeating him in northwestern Crumbling Farum Azula, and speaking to him.

Sharp Gravel Stone.text: Found on the Jagged Peak, usually on the corpses of drakes.

Sharpshot Talisman.text: Loot: Albinauric's Shack (Scaduview). Found inside the Albinauric's Shack east of the road between Commander Gaius's boss arena and the Scadutree Chalice.

Shatter Earth.text: Loot: Liurnia. Acquired from a corpse in the section just before the final elevator of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.

Shattered Stone Talisman.text: From the Moorth Ruins Site of Grace head South-East through the big stony archway. You'll directly head towards a house ruin. You can go through the house's doorway, exit on the small roof, turn left and around the corner you'll find the talisman lying there on a corpse.

Shattering Crystal.text: Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria. Acquired from a corpse located on the second floor of the Church of the Cuckoo. The second floor can be accessed through careful platforming on the rooftops west of the plaza north of the Debate Parlor Site of Grace.

Shattershard Arrow.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [11], sold by the Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore) for 1500 runes.

Shield Grease.text: Craftable after obtaining the Glintstone Craftsman's Cookbook [4] from a chest northwest of Academy Gate Town site of grace. It is guarded by several Second-Generation Albinaurics.

Shield of Night.text: Loot: Bonny Gaol (Scadu Altus). Recovered from a body lying on a guillotine-table. Located on a somewhat hidden floor of the gaol. To reach this floor, the player must progress through the dungeon until they reach a jar-elevator that has already begun to move on its own.

Shield of the Guilty.text: Loot: Demi-Human Forest Ruins (Weeping Peninsula). Found in a chest in the cellar. The cellar entrance is inside of the southernmost ruin, visible behind through hole in a wall behind some branches, and requires jumping over the wall (preferably with Torrent, but it's possible to climb the northwest wall to get in without him) to get into the building section to enter.

Shining Horned Headband.text: Shining Horned Headband has a 1.5% chance to drop from Ancestral Follower Shamans.

Short Spear.text: Starting Equipment:. 1 is part of the starting equipment of the Prophet origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold. 1 is sold for runes 600 Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold.

Short Sword.text: Starting equipment for the Astrologer class. Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge for 600 Runes (x1). 4% drop chance off short sword-wielding enemies (Highwaymen, Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Radahn Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, Haligtree Foot Soldiers, and Messmer Foot Soldiers). Murkwater Cave has many Highwaymen in a small area, making it a decent farming spot.

Shortbow.text: Starting equipment:. 1 is part of the starting equipment for the Bandit origin. Purchase: Limgrave. 1 is sold for runes 600 Runes by the Nomadic Merchant found beneath a collapsed structure just southeast of Coastal Cave.

Shotel.text: Purchase: Siofra River. 1 is sold for runes 2500 Runes by the Abandoned Merchant in lower Siofra River. The Merchant is atop a structure west of the Worshippers' Woods Site of Grace.

Siluria's Tree.text: Guaranteed Drop: Deeproot Depths. Received upon defeating Crucible Knight Siluria.

Silver Firefly.text: Silver fireflies can be found in the following areas:. Ainsel River. Siofra River. Deeproot Depths.

Silver Grooved Armor.text: Starting armor for the Idus Knight. Can also be purchased by the Nomadic Merchant outside of the western exit of the Bellum Church, which leads to the path to the Ruin-Strewn Precipice. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

Silver Grooved Gauntlets.text: Starting armor for the Idus Knight. Can also be purchased by the Nomadic Merchant outside of the western exit of the Bellum Church, which leads to the path to the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.

Silver Grooved Greaves.text: Starting armor for the Idus Knight. Can also be purchased by the Nomadic Merchant outside of the western exit of the Bellum Church, which leads to the path to the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.

Silver Grooved Helm.text: Starting armor for the Idus Knight. Can also be purchased by the Nomadic Merchant outside of the western exit of the Bellum Church, which leads to the path to the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.

Silver Grooved Shield.text: Starting Equipment: Idus Knight. The is a starting weapon for the Idus Knight. Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes. The can be purchased by a Wandering Merchant by the Bellum Church for 1,000 Runes.

Silver Mirrorshield.text: Loot: Apostate Derelict (Consecrated Snowfield). Found at the back of the building, next to Phillia, Towering Little Sister.

Silver Scarab.text: Obtained from a chest in the Hidden Path to the Haligtree, Forbidden Lands. From the large circular platform in the large central room, drop straight down from the broken railing to land on an invisible platform, and walk directly South to a small room. Dispel the illusory wall behind a Grave Glovewort (9) to reveal the chest.

Silver Tear Husk.text: Found in and around the Eternal City.

Silver Tear Mask.text: Guaranteed Drop: Nokron, Eternal City. Received upon defeating the Mimic Tear boss.

Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot.text: Recipe is included with Missionary's Cookbook [3], found in Smoldering Church. Found on a ledge behind the starting building in Limgrave (must drop down to get it).

Sitting Sideways.text: Quest Item: Stormhill. Given to the player by talking to the Heartbroken Maiden at Stormhill Shack.

Skeletal Bandit Ashes.text: Dropped by the Tibia Mariner in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Skeletal Mask.text: Found inside a chest in Sage's Cave located in Altus Plateau.

Skeletal Militiaman Ashes.text: Dropped by the Tibia Mariner in Summonwater Village.

Small Golden Effigy.text: Can be looted once from any Summoning Pool.

Smarag's Glintstone Breath.text: Dragon Communion: Caelid / Jagged Peak. Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 2 Dragon Hearts after defeating Glintstone Dragon Smarag north of Temple Quarter in Liurnia.

Smithing Stone [1].text: Merchants: (∞) Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold once given the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing 1. (x3) Sold by a Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge. (x3) Sold by a Nomadic Merchant south-east of Coastal Cave. (x3) Sold by a Nomadic Merchant north-west of Fort Haight.

Smithing Stone [2].text: Merchants: (∞) Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold once given the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing 1. (x1) Sold by a Nomadic Merchant south of Castle Morne Rampart site of grace. (x3) Sold by a Isolated Merchant on the west coast of the shore in the Weeping Peninsula region. (x3) Sold by a Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace in the Liurnia of the Lakes region.

Smithing Stone [3].text: Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] to them.

Smithing Stone [4].text: Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] to them.

Smithing Stone [5].text: Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] to them.

Smithing Stone [6].text: Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] to them.

Smithing Stone [7].text: Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] to them. Rare drop from Miners in Yelough Anix Tunnel.

Smithing Stone [8].text: Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] to them.

Smithing Talisman.text: Found in: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past. The talisman is looted from a corpse. The body is inside a room filled with Fire Blob enemies, on the upper-most level of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [1].text: You can find it in the northeastern part of the lake in Liurnia of the Lakes, inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel, which is behind a Wandering Mausoleum(Wandering Mausoleums).

Smithscript Axe.text: Loot: Taylew's Ruined Forge (Rauh Base). From the Site of Grace at Taylew's Ruined Forge, take the straight path through the dungeon until there's a gap in the path. Jump over the gap instead of dropping down, then take a left into a small room with a Golem Smith and the Smithscript Axe.

Smithscript Cirque.text: Loot: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past (Scadu Altus). It can be looted from a body located by the edge of the sewage waterfall in the depths of the Forge. More specifically, it's found a bit behind a lever-locked gate inside of the Forge.

Smithscript Dagger.text: Loot: Ruined Forge Lava Intake (Gravesite Plain). Proceed normally through the dungeon until you reach the lever that moves the lava pipe and then drop down to the floor below. The dagger can be found on a body behind a Golem Smith.

Smithscript Greathammer.text: The weapon can be found at Taylew's Ruined Forge.

Smithscript Shield.text: Loot: Taylew's Ruined Forge (Rauh Base). Found by running up the raised stone pillar and then jumping off to the right at the top. Go through the doorway and run up a ramp to the right to reach a platform with the shield, guarded by a greatpot-wielding Golem Smith and a falling Molten Tear.

Smithscript Spear.text: The weapon can be found at Ruined Forge of Starfall Past after looting a body on the main floor of said location.

Smoldering Butterfly.text: Smoldering Butterflies in the wild are most commonly found around Flame Slugs. North of Warmaster's Shack is a swarm of 8 around 2 Slugs. Southwest of the Eastern Tableland Site of Grace in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes is a Fire Monk camp that contains the gesture Fire Spur Me. In the nearby area are 3 swarms of Butterflies.

Smoldering Shield.text: Loot: Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir). Obtained from a corpse in the Volcano Manor Legacy Dungeon. The corpse is inside a cave in front of gravestones near the bottom of the Prison Town. Starting from the Prison Town Church Site of Grace, exit into the Prison Town and drop down on the left side of the first rooftop in the Town.

Snow Witch Hat.text: Found inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.

Snow Witch Robe.text: Found inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.

Snow Witch Robe (Altered).text: Found unaltered inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Snow Witch Skirt.text: Found inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.

Soap.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [17], sold by the Abandoned Merchant (Siofra River). 3 sold by Abandoned Merchant.

Soft Cotton.text: Can be crafted after acquiring the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7], found at the end of a broken bridge towards Liurnia of the Lakes that is north of Stormhill Shack and to the east of Stormveil Castle. Found in Woodfolk Ruins, near a wall surrounded by Slugs. Found in a side tunnel at the end of Morne Tunnel, opposite the door to the boss.

Soiled Loincloth.text: Guaranteed Drop from the vengeful Hornsent at either of the following locations:. Shadow Keep - If the player chooses to assist Leda in vanquishing him. This encounter can become available available after suggesting the Hornsent's potential threat to Miquella's cause to Leda near the Highroad Cross site of grace.

Soldier's Crossbow.text: Drop: Weeping Peninsula / Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Scadu Altus / Shadow Keep. 4% drop chance from crossbow-wielding Foot Soldiers: Godrick Foot Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Foot Soldiers, Leyndell Foot Soldiers, and Messmer Foot Soldiers. There are two easily farmed Godrick Foot Soldiers on the cliff overlooking the Saintsbridge Site of Grace, east of the Deathtouched Catacombs.

Soldjars of Fortune Ashes.text: Dropped by the Grave Warden Duelist at the end of Auriza Side Tomb.

Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.text: There is a limited number of Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stones that can be acquired each playthrough. As of now, a total number of 8 have been discovered:. Three in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. One from Latenna upon completing her questline. One in the Mohgwyn Palace.

Somber Smithing Stone [1].text: 1x in Limgrave Tunnels. Before taking the third elevator fall down the edge on the left, and keep falling on the surfaces against the wall. There is a Golden Rune [1] on a platform with a dead body, the next one has a Somber Smithing Stone [1]. x1 in Limgrave: Located on the field, on a dead body sitting on a chair. 1x dropped by an exploding Teardrop Scarab south-west of the Artist's Shack (Limgrave).

Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing [1].text: Dropped by the Fallingstar Beast in Sellia Crystal Tunnel, Caelid.

Sorcerer Leggings.text: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Sorcerer enemies.

Sorcerer Manchettes.text: 1.5% chance to drop from Glintstone Sorcerer enemies.

Spear.text: Drop: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave) / Murkwater Cave (Limgrave) / Liurnia of the Lakes / Mt. Gelmir / Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir) / The Shaded Castle (Altus Plateau). Has a base 2% chance to drop from any spear-wielding Exile Soldier in Stormveil Castle, at a 2% drop rate. A +7 version is dropped by Patches if he is killed, whether at his original spot or at any point of his questline.

Spear Talisman.text: Loot: Lakeside Crystal Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes). Located in a chest guarded by a pack of Demi-humans. The chest can be found in a campsite found by following the path into the cave without dropping down, past two braziers through a smaller cave in the back.

Spear of the Impaler.text: Can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Impaler with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

Speckled Hardtear.text: Guaranteed drop: Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau). Dropped along with the Crimsonspill Crystal Tear by the Wormface miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in central Altus Plateau, west of the Woodfolk Ruins.

Spectral Steed Whistle.text: Obtained from Melina after visiting three Sites of Grace and then resting. She will give the player the item after a cutscene and some dialogue.

Spellblade's Pointed Hat.text: Dropped by Sorcerer Rogier at the end of his questline.

Spelldrake Talisman.text: Guaranteed drop: Earthbore Cave (Weeping Peninsula). Obtained by defeating the Runebear boss fight at the end of the cave.

Spellmachinist's Bell Bearing.text: Loot: Rabbath's Rise (Scadu Altus). Found in a secret chamber in the tower over the study of Rabbath's Rise. It can only be accessed from above the rise itself, by descending down the cliffs southeast of Shaman Village.

Spellproof Dried Liver.text: Craftable:. Can be crafted after acquiring the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [11] from the Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore) who sits at the southern end of Lake of Liurnia's great lake, near the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace. Costs 1,500 Runes. Loot: Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes)/Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes)/ Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes).

Spellproof Pickled Liver.text: Crafted with Forager Brood Cookbook [1]. x2 can be bought from Moore for 4,000 Runes.

Spider Scorpion Ashes.text: Found in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

Spiked Caestus.text: Purchase: Isolated Merchant's Shack (Dragonbarrow) (Caelid). Sold by the Isolated Merchant in Caelid for 4,000 Runes.

Spiked Club.text: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Mt. Gelmir. 2% drop chance from slightly larger, club-wielding Demi-Humans. 1 large club-wielder can be found in the pit just past the entrance of Coastal Cave in Limgrave. 1 can be found just northeast of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace in Limgrave.

Spiked Cracked Tear.text: Loot: Minor Erdtree (Limgrave). Found at an altar near the Mistwood's Minor Erdtree, along with the Greenspill Crystal Tear.

Spiked Palisade Shield.text: Loot: Caelid. Found on the path from Deep Siofra Well to the Caelid Colosseum, on a small rock near where the first Golem Archer stands.

Spiked Spear.text: Dropped by the spear wielding Marionette Soldier enemies.

Spira.text: Loot: Enir-Ilim. From the First Rise Site of Grace, pass the fountain surrounded by Inquisitors and go up the stairs. Thereafter, find a way to walk on the branches to cross over to the platform with the single praying Inquisitor.

Spiralhorn Shield.text: Loot: Uld Palace Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes). From the Ruined Labyrinth Site of Grace, head north to the nearby Wandering Mausoleum and then head left. The shield is on a corpse on the left after riding a bit, hanging of a cliff south of the Mausoleum's pond.

Spiraltree Seal.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain (through Rauh Base). Reward from "The Sacred Tower" Painting, which can be acquired from interacting with a painting found in a cave, northeast of the Scorched Ruins. The player can only acquire this item after having burned the sealing tree past the Church of the Bud. After which the painter (and thus this item) can be found on the edge of a cliff south of the Northern Nameless Mausoleum.

Spirit Calculus.text: Dropped by horned beasts in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

Spirit Calling Bell.text: After getting Torrent from Melina, head to the site of grace at the Church of Elleh at night time and Renna will call the Tarnished over. After some conversation, she'll give you the bell, noting it was entrusted to her by Torrent's former master. Also sold for 100 runes Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks if any Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes is activated without picking it up.

Spirit Glaive.text: In order to obtain this weapon, you first start at the site of grace at Charo's Hidden Grave and walk through the arch to the northwest, turn right directly after and take the path that ramps up north, follow it to where it meets the edge of the Gravesite Plains and it will be on a grave.

Spirit Jellyfish Ashes.text: Given by Roderika, Spirit Tuner at Stormhill Shack after talking to her. If it hasn't been obtained by the time Roderika moves to Roundtable Hold it is possible to still obtain it by talking with her, though this option might not be offered if the game progresses to a certain unknown point after Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Spirit Sword.text: Loot: Cerulean Coast. This weapon can be found in a triangular ravine behind the stranded coffin boat just northeast of the Cerulean Coast West Site of Grace. It's in the far right corner, near some gravestones and Demi-Humans.

Spiritflame Arrow.text: Random Drop:. Nokron, Eternal City. 5% Chance of dropping from Fallen Hawk Soldiers. Loot:.

Spiritgrave Stone.text: Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Fort of Reprimand. Gravesite Plain. Scorched Ruins.

Spread Crossbow.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain. Pillaged from a corpse in a small ruined campsite by the cliffs facing Ellac River, south of the Castle Front military encampment. From the site of grace, circle around the tall mesa to the south and drop down to a low ledge with three Messmer Soldiers.

Spread Out.text: Quest Item: Liurnia of the Lakes. Automatically received when leaving Blackguard Big Boggart after having bought a Boiled Prawn from him for the first time.

St. Trina's Blossom.text: Loot: Garden of Deep Purple (Stone Coffin Fissure). Found at the feet of St. Trina's withered flower body after defeating Promised Consort Radahn.

St. Trina's Smile.text: Guaranteed Drop: Stone Coffin Fissure. Drops from Thiollier when he becomes a hostile invader NPC in the Garden of Deep Purple. WARNING: This Talisman only becomes available if the player advances Thiollier's questline; killing him prematurely before he becomes an invader will not cause the Talisman to drop and the player will have to start a new game cycle if they want another chance.

St. Trina's Torch.text: Loot: Consecrated Snowfield. Found inside one of the Troll-drawn Carriages in the southeast of the Snowfield, northeast of the Consecrated Snowfield Site of Grace and west of the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs Sites of Grace. The other Carriage contains the Flowing Curved Sword, and at night they are guarded by a duo of Night's Cavalry.

Staff of Loss.text: Loot: Caelid. Found on a corpse on a balcony in the northwestern parts of Sellia, Town of Sorcery, in eastern Caelid.

Staff of the Avatar.text: Guaranteed Drop: Deeproot Depths. Dropped by an Erdtree Avatar near the Great Waterfall Crest Site of Grace.

Staff of the Great Beyond.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers, dropped by Metyr, Mother of Fingers, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Staff of the Guilty.text: Drop: Liurnia of the Lakes / Mt. Gelmir / Mountaintops of the Giants. 2% drop chance from Guilty, aka Thorn-Fire Sorcerers. The earliest place to find them is around the Fire Monk camp just north of the Artist's Shack in eastern Liurnia, while alternative farming spots is Fort Laiedd in Mt. Gelmir and Guardians' Garrison in Mountaintops of the Giants.

Stalwart Horn Charm.text: Obtained from a corpse in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes. From Mausoleum Compound, head north up an incline, then left, and proceed southwest to a large tall rock formation. Walk counterclockwise around this formation to find a hole in the formation, forming an archway over a small ledge. Drop down from this ledge and head left to find the corpse, dangling over the edge of a cliff.

Stanching Boluses.text: Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Western Limgrave). Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7], found on the broken bridge to the east of Stormveil Castle.

Star Fist.text: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau). Can be looted from a body at the colosseum in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Star Shower.text: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 10,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Conspectus Scroll.

Star-Lined Sword.text: Guaranteed Drop: Cerulean Coast. Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga.

Stargazer Heirloom.text: Obtained from a corpse lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia, in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes.

Starlight.text: Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 2,500 Runes by Sorcerer Thops at the Church of Irith. Should Thops die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Thops's Bell Bearing.

Starlight Shards.text: Can be farmed from non-boss type Demi-Human Swordmasters. One of these swordmasters is found in the Cerulean Coast, and another can be found in Charo's Hidden Grave. A limited supply of shards can also be found in certain locations throughout the Lands Between (such as on stone astrolabes at the top of cliffs).

Stars of Ruin.text: Quest Item: Caelid. Acquired from Primeval Sorcerer Lusat in Sellia Hideaway. Requires the Sellian Sealbreaker from Sellen in order to access him.

Starscourge Greatsword.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Starscourge, gained by defeating the Starscourge Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the belled Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Starscourge Heirloom.text: Loot: Fort Gael. Obtained from a chest in Fort Gael, in western Caelid. The chest is located on the upper platform of the fort, underneath a canopy.

Steel Armor.text: Starting armor for the Heavy Knight. Can also be purchased from the Isolated Merchant at the Isolated Merchant's Shack in Weeping Peninsula.

Steel Gauntlets.text: Starting armor for the Heavy Knight. Can also be purchased from the Isolated Merchant at the Isolated Merchant's Shack in Weeping Peninsula.

Steel Greaves.text: Starting armor for the Heavy Knight. Can also be purchased from the Isolated Merchant at the Isolated Merchant's Shack in Weeping Peninsula.

Steel Helm.text: Starting armor for the Heavy Knight. Can also be purchased from the Isolated Merchant at the Isolated Merchant's Shack in Weeping Peninsula.

Steel-Wire Torch.text: Loot: Weeping Peninsula. Found at Castle Morne along the northern side of the castle, top level. It's on a body at the end of a narrow path, guarded by two Misbegotten. To reach this spot from the beginning, start at the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace and enter the castle. Then, run up the pile of bodies in the courtyard to enter a room and then climb up the ladder on the other side.

Stimulating Boluses.text: Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Western Limgrave). Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [16], sold by the Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River).

Stone Club.text: Drop: Academy Crystal Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Sellia Hideaway (Caelid) / West Windmill Pasture (Altus Plateau) / Miquella's Haligtree. Has a base 4% chance to drop from any Battlemage. A lone Battlemage can be found among the graves just outside of Sellia Hideaway. The simplest farming spot is just before the Haligtree Promenade Site of Grace in Miquella's Haligtree, where two Battlemages can be found.

Stone of Gurranq.text: Quest Item: Bestial Sanctum, Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. Stone of Gurranq is rewarded from Gurranq after giving him the sixth Deathroot. (However, only after Gurranq has been calmed down after he turns hostile on the player's return to him after consuming the fourth Deathroot.).

Stone-Sheathed Sword.text: Found at an altar in either Fog Rift Catacombs, Ruins of Unte, or Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Since the altar in Fog Rift Catacombs is the most complicated to reach, it's recommended that the sword is taken there so that the later interactions with altars are less time-consuming.

Stonebarb Cracked Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Minor Erdtree (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow). Dropped by the Putrid Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow, north of Fort Faroth, along with the Opaline Hardtear.

Storeroom Key.text: Found in Belurat, Tower Settlement. Used to find Hornsent Grandam.

Stormhawk Axe.text: Loot: Leyndell, Royal Capital (Altus Plateau) / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants). One can be found in Leyndell, in the court outside of the fortified manor where the Abductor Virgin enemies are roaming. One can be found within Castle Sol, on a rooftop not far from where you find the painting. Drop: Nepheli Loux, Warrior.

Stormhawk Deenh.text: Found in the Chapel of Anticipation. After returning to the area via the portal at The Four Belfries, go through the previously locked door near the main entrance, and follow the staircase into the upper level of the chapel to find the ashes.

Stormwing Bone Arrow.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [10], found within Stormveil Castle.

Strength!.text: Limgrave, (Stranded Graveyard). Loot: On a corpse hanging from a ledge past the Cave of Knowledge after defeating the Soldier of Godrick tutorial Boss.

Strength-knot Crystal Tear.text: Loot: Limgrave. Found inside of a bowl atop a cliff north-east of the Stormhill Shack, west of the Warmaster's Shack. There will be a Troll guarding it.

String.text: Four found in the ground level sewers of Leyndell, Royal Capital. From the Lower Capital Church Site of Grace, go down the ladder straight ahead and take the lower left route then turn right at the next turn. It is on the left side, guarded by 3 Giant Rats and 1 small Fingercreeper. Five found in Hermit Village, atop the roof of the southwesternmost house.

String-Seller's Bell Bearing.text: Loot: Gravesite Plain. Acquired from a rope-strung pot that can be found hanging from the rocky mountain wall southwest of the Cliffroad Terminus site of grace. It is specifically hanging from the western side of the rocky hill that bears Prospect Town itself. The pot must be destroyed with a projectile for the item to become accessible.

Sun Realm Shield.text: Drop: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Capital Outskirts / Crumbling Farum Azula. 2% drop chance from red-caped Skeletons and shield-wielding Beast Skeletons. Two easily farmable Skeletons of this type can be found besides the road from the Saintsbridge Site of Grace to Summonwater Village. Starting at Summonwater Village Outskirts Site of Grace is also possible.

Surge, O Flame!.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Sold for runes 5,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Fire Monks' Prayerbook.

Swarm Pot.text: Loot: Mohgwyn Palace (Siofra River). Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [24], found in Mohgwyn Palace on the cliffs south-east of the blood swamp.

Swarm of Flies.text: Loot: Mohgwyn Palace. Located on a corpse at the end of one of the caves found in the northeastern quarter of the lake of blood.

Sweet Raisin.text: Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [19], found north of the Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau) within Woodfolk Ruins.

Swift Glintstone Shard.text: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold. Sold for 600 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Academy Scroll.

Swift Spear.text: The weapon can be found lying on a corpse guarded by 3 Messmer Soldiers along the road going South-East from the Castle Front site of grace.

Swollen Grape.text: Found as loot and dropped by Aging Untouchables.

Sword Lance.text: Trade: Finger Reader Enia. Can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method). Comes pre-equipped with the Ash of War: Spinning Gravity Thrust and Standard Affinity on it.

Sword of Darkness.text: Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Light to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ruins of Unte. WARNING: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle.

Sword of Light.text: Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Darkness to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ancient Ruins of Rauh. WARNING: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle.

Sword of Milos.text: Guaranteed drop: Capital Outskirts / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. Can be acquired in two different, mutually exclusive ways:. Dropped by the Dung Eater when he invades in the southern end of the moat in Capital Outskirts, at the spot where Blackguard Big Boggart normally sits.

Sword of Night.text: Quest Reward: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus). Defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers by following Count Ymir's questline and then defeat both him and Jolán, Swordhand of Night. Reload the area, and the player will find Jolán sitting on the ground against the pillar when she usually stands. Give her the Iris of Occultation, and she'll die and drop the.

Sword of Night and Flame.text: In a locked room at Caria Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes, which the Tarnished can jump into from above on the walkways where the Raya Lucaria Soldier puppets appear. More specifically, starting from the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace walk out onto the stone walkways and take a left when they path splits in two. Follow the path as it turn to the right and look to the left when halfway across the last walkway.

Sword of St. Trina.text: Behind a Stonesword Key imp statue in the Forsaken Ruins, Caelid, visible directly below the ledge at the Rotview Balcony Site of Grace.

Swordhand of Night Jolán.text: Obtained after completing Count Ymir's questline and boss fight and giving Jolán the Iris of Grace.

Tailoring Tools.text: Dropped by the Demi-Human Chiefs in Coastal Cave along with the Sewing Needle.

Taker's Cameo.text: Obtained from Tanith in Volcano Manor in central Mt. Gelmir after completing the third assassination quest, by killing Juno Hoslow in northern Mountaintops of the Giants, near the Shack of the Lofty.

Talisman Pouch.text: Guaranteed Drop: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Dropped by Margit the Fell Omen or by Morgott, the Omen King once defeated. These drops only occur on NG/Journey 1. Quest/Purchase: Roundtable Hold.

Talisman of All Crucibles.text: Found in a treasure chest in the western Ancient Ruins. If you have the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway Site of Grace unlocked, start there and take the nearby lift down; then, enter the square passage towards the south by using Torrent's double jump, using the adjacent pile of rocks to gain enough height to do so. Through the passage is a room containing the treasure chest.

Talisman of Lord's Bestowal.text: Obtained at the Shadow Keep beside the big golden tree.

Talisman of the Dread.text: Found inside the Elder's Hovel in Gravesite Plain.

Tarnished Golden Sunflower.text: Most commonly found around Minor Erdtrees in Limgrave, Weeping Peninsula, Liurnia of the Lakes (northeast), and Caelid. The Minor Erdtree (Limgrave), located in Mistwood, has many of these flowers around it and is not guarded by an Erdtree Avatar or Guardians.

Tarnished's Furled Finger.text: Can be looted near the exit lift out of the Stranded Graveyard.

Tarnished's Wizened Finger.text: Can be looted from a corpse in the Chapel of Anticipation.

Taunter's Tongue.text: Received after defeating the invader Mad Tongue Alberich in the hall of the Roundtable Hold, accessed by jumping off the balcony.

Taylew the Golem Smith.text: Loot: Rauh Base, (Taylew's Ruined Forge). Obtained by reaching the end of the dungeon.

Telescope.text: Sold by Merchant Kalé for 500 runes.

Terra Magica.text: Loot: Academy Crystal Cave. After defeating the boss, there is an elevator that leads up to the bell tower of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Ascend the stairs and the spell will be inside a chest.

Thawfrost Boluses.text: 10 can be purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants). Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [16], sold by the Hermit Merchant (Ainsel River).

The Flame of Frenzy.text: Loot: Callu Baptismal Church (Weeping Peninsula). Found on a corpse in the middle of the church, near the Frenzied Flame Village, located in the middle of the Weeping Peninsula.

The Ring.text: Players who pre-ordered and successfully registered the pre-order bonus code will receive this gesture automatically at the very start of every playthrough. Players who did not pre-order the game can still receive the gesture after successfully defeating a boss with another player who does have the pre-order bonus.

The Stormhawk King.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (The Four Belfries). Area: retrieve an Imbued Sword Key (one is found in the chest near the Site of Grace) and use the Sending Gate of the Precipice of Anticipation to return to the starting area of the game: past the Grafted Scion, enter the previously locked door to the side of the chapel to reach the rooftop where this item is found.

The Two Fingers.text: One living Two Fingers can be found in Roundtable Hold, behind a set of doors that remain closed until the Tarnished champion acquires their first Great Rune. They will be at the back of the chamber with Finger Reader Enia sitting close by. The Two Fingers here appears to be in a state of decay, missing patches of skin with exposed flesh on its body and “fingers”.

Theodorix's Magma.text: Dragon Communion: Limgrave / Caelid / Jagged Peak. Acquired from the altar at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave, the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid, and the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 2 Dragon Hearts after defeating Great Wyrm Theodorix in Consecrated Snowfield.

Thiollier's Concoction.text: Received from Thiollier as part of his questline. Before going to the Shadow Keep:. Speak with Moore. Find Thiollier.

Thiollier's Garb.text: Quest reward & Loot: Enir-Ilim. Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.

Thiollier's Garb (Altered).text: Quest reward & Alter garment: Enir-Ilim. Acquired from altering Thiollier's Garb. Which can be recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.

Thiollier's Gloves.text: Quest reward & Loot: Enir-Ilim. Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.

Thiollier's Hidden Needle.text: Quest reward & Loot: Enir-Ilim. Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.

Thiollier's Mask.text: Quest reward & Loot: Enir-Ilim. Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.

Thiollier's Trousers.text: Quest reward & Loot: Enir-Ilim. Recovered from Thiollier's body at the end of his questline.

Thops's Barrier.text: Quest Item / Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria. Acquired from the body of Thops located outside the Schoolhouse Classroom after giving him the spare Academy Glintstone Key.

Thorned Whip.text: Drop: Mt. Gelmir / Mountaintops of the Giants / Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave. Has a base 4% chance to drop from Fire Prelate enemies that wield it.

Thorny Cracked Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Minor Erdtree (Consecrated Snowfield). Dropped by the Putrid Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in the Consecrated Snowfield, east of Ordina, Liturgical Town, along with one of the Ruptured Crystal Tears.

Throwing Dagger.text: Sold by Merchant Kalé for 40 runes.

Tibia's Cookbook.text: Guaranteed Drop: Charo's Hidden Grave. Acquired from defeating the Tibia Mariner that can be found rowing through the middle of Charo's Hidden Grave.

Tibia's Summons.text: Drop: Wyndham Ruins (Altus Plateau). From the Tibia Mariner miniboss rowing through the waters.

Tonic of Forgetfulness.text: Given by Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress after defeating Rileigh the Idle and advancing the questline of Rya. If Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy is defeated before obtaining the item, it can be found on Tanith's chair once Tanith relocates to Rykard's boss room.

Tooth Whip.text: Loot: Whipping Hut (Scadu Altus). Pillaged from a corpse inside the whipping hut.

Torch.text: Purchase: Limgrave. Bought from Merchant Kalé at Church of Elleh for runes 200 Runes.

Torchpole.text: Dropped by the Exile Soldiers that wield it in Stormveil Castle.

Tower of Shadow Message.text: Loot: Belurat, Tower Settlement. Found on the floor at the top of the curving bridge northeast of the Theatre of the Divine Beast.

Toxic Mossling.text: Found in poison swamps around the Realm of Shadow, such as beyond the Belurat well depths and the path to the Rauh Base.

Toxic Mushroom.text: Harvestable Toxic Mushrooms are found growing in the rotten lands of Caelid and Lake of Rot, particularly in areas afflicted by scarlet rot.

Traveler's Boots.text: Found right next to the Haligtree Roots site of grace.

Traveler's Clothes.text: Found right next to the Haligtree Roots site of grace.

Traveler's Gloves.text: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid.

Traveler's Hat.text: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid.

Traveler's Manchettes.text: Found right next to the Haligtree Roots site of grace.

Traveler's Slops.text: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside the Street of Sages Ruins located north of Aeonia Swamp in Caelid.

Traveling Maiden Boots.text: Found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Moutaintops of the Giants.

Traveling Maiden Gloves.text: Found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Moutaintops of the Giants.

Traveling Maiden Hood.text: Found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Moutaintops of the Giants.

Traveling Maiden Robe.text: Found on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Moutaintops of the Giants.

Traveling Maiden Robe (Altered).text: Found unaltered on a corpse inside the Shack of the Lofty located on the west end of the river in Moutaintops of the Giants. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Tree Sentinel Armor.text: Received upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.

Tree Sentinel Armor (Altered).text: Received unaltered upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Tree Sentinel Gauntlets.text: Received upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.

Tree Sentinel Greaves.text: Received upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.

Tree Sentinel Helm.text: Received upon destroying the chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in Altus Plateau.

Tree-and-Beast Surcoat.text: Chance to drop from Godrick Soldier enemies.

Treespear.text: Found inside a caravan south of the Liurnia Highway South Site of Grace, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Trina's Lily.text: Trina's Lilies can be found in many places throughout the Lands Between. Once a lily has been picked up, it will not respawn until the next playthrough. They can be found in every single region except Ainsel River and Deeproot Depths.

Triple Rings of Light.text: Loot: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Found in a treasure chest in a room locked by an Imp Statue located at the lower level near the Prayer Room Site of Grace.

Triumphant Delight.text: Quest Item: Stormhill / Liurnia of the Lakes. Obtained from helping Alexander, Warrior Jar getting unstuck from the ground at Stormhill or in Liurnia.

Troll Knight's Sword.text: Guaranteed drop: Caria Manor (Liurnia of the Lakes). Guaranteed drop from the Troll Knight in Carian Manor, just before Royal Knight Loretta, the first time it's killed. Drop: Caria Manor / Converted Fringe Tower / The Four Belfries (Liurnia of the Lakes). 4% drop chance from all Troll Knights.

Troll's Golden Sword.text: Loot: Altus Plateau. Found in a chest in the back of a Carriage in a Leyndell Soldier camp in-between the Erdtree-Gazing Hill and Altus Highway Junction Sites of Graces.

Troll's Hammer.text: Found on a corpse inside Old Altus Tunnel, located in Mt. Gelmir. It requires two stonesword keys to access the tunnel.

Turtle Neck Meat.text: Guaranteed Drop:. A 100% drop from any Turtle. x12 drop from Miriel, Pastor of Vows if killed. Loot:.

Twiggy Cracked Tear.text: Loot: Minor Erdtree (Capital Outskirts). Found at a sap collection basin at the foot of Capital Outskirts' Minor Erdtree, along with the Right version of the Crimson Crystal Tear. It is guarded by a group of Death Serving Commoners and an Omen.

Twinbird Kite Shield.text: Guaranteed drop: Capital Outskirts (Altus Plateau). Dropped by the Deathbird that appears at the eastern top of the hill east of the Hermit Merchant's Shack at night, just west of the nearby Minor Erdtree. Be wary of the Skeletal Snails that accompany it.

Twinblade.text: Loot: Dragon-Burnt Ruins (Limgrave). Found in a chest in the southeastern basement room of the Ruins, the one without the Rats, that is reached by using Torrent to jump over a crumbled wall into an enclosure.

Twinblade Talisman.text: Loot: Castle Morne (Weeping Peninsula). From the Behind the Castle Site of Grace, head down the cliff and northwest to the western corner of the castle there will be a tower guarded by a Scaly Misbegotten. Climb the nearby ladder and circle the top of the tower to find a chest containing this item.

Twinned Armor.text: Dropped upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline.

Twinned Armor (Altered).text: Dropped unaltered upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Twinned Gauntlets.text: Dropped upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline.

Twinned Greaves.text: Dropped upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline.

Twinned Helm.text: Dropped upon killing D, Hunter of the Dead or by finishing their questline.

Twinned Knight Swords.text: Loot: East Windmill Pasture (Altus Plateau). Found on a corpse just northwest of the East Windmill Pasture.

Twinsage Glintstone Crown.text: Guaranteed drop: Academy of Raya Lucaria Liurnia of the Lakes. Dropped by a Crystal Crab found to the side of a building reached after climbing across the rooftops to the left after the Debate Parlor Site of Grace. After starting at the rooftops, climb up the ladder to the first tower then drop down on the right at the end, and drop down on the right again and take the right to drop down on a second tower.

Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes.text: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade in Black Knife Catacombs.

Two Fingers Heirloom.text: Loot: Purified Ruins. Obtained from a chest in the cellar of Purified Ruins, southern Liurnia of the Lakes, just north-east of Stormveil Castle. The stairs to the cellar are covered by wooden planks, which must be rolled over to be broken.

Two Fingers' Prayerbook.text: Fortified Manor in the Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Two-Handed Sword Talisman.text: Loot: Temple Town Ruins (Rauh Base). Found inside the highest structure. After the fight with the Horned Warrior, just continue up the stairs into the next room to find a chest with this item inside.

Two-Headed Turtle Talisman.text: Loot: Rivermouth Cave (Gravesite Plain). Found inside a cave beneath a waterfall guarded by enemies just east of Rivermouth Cave.

Uchigatana.text: Starting equipment:. 1 is part of the starting equipment for the Samurai Origin. Loot: Deathtouched Catacombs (Limgrave). 1 is found in the Deathtouched Catacombs on the hidden platform with a Skeleton Archer, just before the lever.

Unalloyed Gold Needle.text: It is obtained from defeating Commander O'Neil within the Heart of Aeonia in Caelid and can be given to Sage Gowry in order to be repaired. |-|Repaired=.

Unendurable Frenzy.text: Loot: Yelough Anix Ruins (Consecrated Snowfield). Found in a cellar located in the small, westernmost building in the southern clusters of the ruins, the ones closest to the Yelough Anix Tunnel.

Unseen Blade.text: Loot: Altus Plateau. Acquired from the treasure chest at the top of Mirage Rise.

Unseen Form.text: Loot: Altus Plateau. Acquired from the treasure chest at the top of Mirage Rise.

Upper-Class Robe.text: Bought from the Hermit Merchant in Altus Plateau. Found on a corpse on a balcony in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Urgent Heal.text: Equipped:. Urgent Heal is a starting spell for the Confessor origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants. Urgent Heal is sold for runes 1,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn.

Urumi.text: Found on a corpse up on the rooftops of Caria Manor located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Vagabond Knight Armor.text: Starting gear for the Vagabond class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

Vagabond Knight Armor (Altered).text: Starting gear for the Vagabond class (unaltered). Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants). Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc the Seamster.

Vagabond Knight Gauntlets.text: Starting gear for the Vagabond class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

Vagabond Knight Greaves.text: Starting gear for the Vagabond class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

Vagabond Knight Helm.text: Starting gear for the Vagabond class. Purchased from Hermit Merchant (Mountaintops of the Giants).

Valkyrie's Prosthesis.text: Found in a treasure chest guarded by a Cleanrot Knight in the Shaded Castle. The chest is in the northwest most corner of the castle. It is most easily reached by following the inner wall towards the west.

Varré's Bouquet.text: Drop: Mohgwyn Palace (Siofra River). Progress White Mask Varré's questline and then touch his invasion sign located just before the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint Site of Grace. Defeat him in his world and then he'll be lying on the ground near where his invasion sign was. Talk to him and exhaust his dialogue, and then he'll drop Varré's Bouquet upon his death.

Velvet Sword of St. Trina.text: From the Fissure Cross Site of Grace in Cerulean Coast, head north and drop down two stone platforms to a cliff lower down. Inside of a cave to the south that's full of slimes is also the sword, furthest in.

Venomous Fang.text: Loot: Abandoned Cave (Caelid). Found on a corpse inside the Abandoned Cave located in Caelid.

Verdigris Armor.text: Guaranteed Drop & Loot from Moore. Its location and availability can be determined by the player's dialogue-choices as they talk to Moore about the breaking of Miquella's great rune:. Scadu Altus - If the player tells Moore to "Remain sad forever". Moore will quietly move to the cliffs north of the Church of the Crusade, where he can be found huddled up next to a motionless forager brood.

Verdigris Discus.text: Verdigris Discus is located in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, positioned before a giant statue of a goddess. This area may be accessed via the sending gate closest to the Highroad Cross site of grace on the Scadu Altus. The gate must be unlocked with an Imbued Sword Key. After passing through, walk uphill and between the twin waterfalls. The statue lies beyond the Divine Bird Warrior.

Verdigris Gauntlets.text: Guaranteed Drop & Loot from Moore. Its location and availability can be determined by the player's dialogue-choices as they talk to Moore about the breaking of Miquella's great rune:. Scadu Altus - If the player tells Moore to "Remain sad forever". Moore will quietly move to the cliffs north of the Church of the Crusade, where he can be found huddled up next to a motionless forager brood.

Verdigris Greatshield.text: Guaranteed Drop / Loot from Moore. Its location and availability can be determined by the player's dialogue-choices as they talk to Moore about the breaking of Miquella's great rune:. Scadu Altus - If the player tells Moore to "Remain sad forever". Moore will quietly move to the cliffs north of the Church of the Crusade, where he can be found huddled up next to a motionless forager brood.

Verdigris Greaves.text: Guaranteed Drop & Loot from Moore. Its location and availability can be determined by the player's dialogue-choices as they talk to Moore about the breaking of Miquella's great rune:. Scadu Altus - If the player tells Moore to "Remain sad forever". Moore will quietly move to the cliffs north of the Church of the Crusade, where he can be found huddled up next to a motionless forager brood.

Verdigris Helm.text: Guaranteed Drop & Loot from Moore. Its location and availability can be determined by the player's dialogue-choices as they talk to Moore about the breaking of Miquella's great rune:. Scadu Altus - If the player tells Moore to "Remain sad forever". Moore will quietly move to the cliffs north of the Church of the Crusade, where he can be found huddled up next to a motionless forager brood.

Veteran's Armor.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall.

Veteran's Armor (Altered).text: Can be bought unaltered from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.

Veteran's Gauntlets.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall.

Veteran's Greaves.text: Can be bought from Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Commander Niall.

Veteran's Prosthesis.text: Guaranteed Drop: Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants). Dropped by Commander Niall upon his defeat at the end of Castle Sol.

Viridian Amber Medallion.text: Guaranteed Drop: Tombsward Cave (Weeping Peninsula). Obtained by defeating Miranda the Blighted Bloom in the Tombsward Cave.

Viridian Hidden Tear.text: Guaranteed drop: Gravesite Plain. Dropped by the Furnace Golem found south of the Ellac River Downstream Site of Grace in Gravesite Plain, on the path to the Cerulean Coast.

Visage Shield.text: Loot: Caelem Ruins (Caelid). It can be found in northeast Caelid, in a chest that's accessible after defeating the Mad Pumpkin Head Duo boss in the Caelem Ruins.

Volcano Manor Invitation.text: Liurnia of the Lakes (Scenic Isle). Quest: Rya the Scout. Given by her in the gazebo east of the Site of Grace, after retrieving Rya's Necklace from Blackguard Big Boggart by either purchasing it for 1000 Runes or killing him.

Volcano Pot.text: Craftable after purchasing the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [20] from Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir) for 3,000 runes. Volcanic Stones are readily available in large quantities along the Seethewater River at Mt. Gelmir.

Vortex of Putrescence.text: Trade the Remembrance of Putrescence with Finger Reader Enia.

Vulgar Militia Armor.text: Chance to drop from Vulgar Militia enemies.

Vulgar Militia Ashes.text: Found in the Auriza Hero's Grave. At the bottom of the hallway with the two chariots, drop down to the wooden beams below and head north to a room containing a statue. Go through the corridor behind the statue and to the right.

Vulgar Militia Gauntlets.text: Chance to drop from Vulgar Militia enemies.

Vulgar Militia Greaves.text: Chance to drop from Vulgar Militia enemies.

Vulgar Militia Helm.text: Chance to drop from Vulgar Militia enemies.

Vulgar Militia Saw.text: Dropped by Vulgar Militia enemies that wield it.

Vulgar Militia Shotel.text: Dropped by Vulgar Militia enemies that wield it.

Vyke's Dragonbolt.text: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants. Vyke's Dragonbolt is acquired from the defeat of Roundtable Knight Vyke in the Lord Contender's Evergaol.

Vyke's War Spear.text: Guaranteed Drop: Church of Inhibition (Liurnia of the Lakes). Received upon defeating Festering Fingerprint Vyke.

Wait!.text: Available from the start of the game.

Wakizashi.text: Found on a corpse inside a locked cell in Gaol Cave, located in Caelid. The cave requires one Stonesword Key to access. From the lever that unlocks all the cages it can be found by taking a right then a left, and then it's one of three items in the second cage on the left.

Wandering Noble Ashes.text: Found on a corpse in Stormfoot Catacombs, in a dead-end room guarded by Imps.

War Surgeon Gloves.text: Dropped by an Unnamed White Mask invader at the blood river near Mohgwyn Palace.

War Surgeon Gown.text: Dropped by a Nameless White Mask invader at the blood river in Mohgwyn Palace.

War Surgeon Gown (Altered).text: Dropped by a Nameless White Mask invader at the blood river in Mohgwyn Palace. Then, alter with Boc.

War Surgeon Trousers.text: Dropped by Unnamed White Mask invader at the blood river of Mohgwyn Palace.

Warhawk Ashes.text: Obtained in Weeping Peninsula, just north of the Church of Pilgrimage. This is the reward for finding the location depicted on the "Prophecy" Painting, and as such, the painting item must have already been obtained from the sideroom to the big courtyard near the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle.

Warhawk's Talon.text: Drop: Stormveil Castle / Castle Sol (Mountaintops of the Giants). 2% drop chance from Warhawks. 4 of these birds can be found on the walls outside of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.

Warm Welcome.text: Available from the start of the game.

Warming Stone.text: Found in the tower to the south of Oridys's Rise (same one with the Great Turtle Shell). Reachable by using the spiritspring near the Nomadic Merchant, jumping towards the tower. Recipe is included with Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [19], found north of the Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau) within Woodfolk Ruins.

Warped Axe.text: Drop: Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes) / Altus Plateau / Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Altus Plateau). 4% chance to drop from axe-wielding Omens. The earliest spots is in Cliffbottom Catacombs, though the two axe-wielding Omen in there are pretty far in.

Warpick.text: Drop: Limgrave / Weeping Peninsula / Liurnia of the Lakes / Caelid / Altus Plateau / Deeproot Depths / Consecrated Snowfield / Miquella's Haligtree. Soldier enemies of every faction that wield this weapon have a 2% drop rate for it. This includes Godrick Soldiers, Raya Lucaria Soldiers, Radahn Soldiers, Leyndell Soldiers, Mausoleum Soldiers, and Haligtree Soldiers.

Warrior Gauntlets.text: Starting gear for the Warrior class. Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria).

Warrior Greaves.text: Starting gear for the Warrior class. Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria).

Warrior Jar Shard.text: Obtained by killing Iron Fist Alexander, before completing his questline.

Watchdog's Greatsword.text: Drop: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs (Mountaintops of the Giants) / Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs (Consecrated Snowfield). 8% drop chance from the non-boss variant of Erdtree Burial Watchdog.

Watchdog's Staff.text: Found behind an illusory wall inside Road's End Catacombs, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

Watchful Spirit.text: Loot: Belurat, Tower Settlement. Gained by speaking to the Hornsent Grandam twice while wearing the Divine Beast Head. She can be found by exiting the room with the Small Private Altar Site of Grace and taking a left to walk across a thin bridge to find a locked door that requires the Storeroom Key on your left. She is on the right side of that room. Must be done before defeating Messmer the Impaler.

Wave.text: Available from the start of the game.

Weathered Dagger.text: Given by Fia as part of her questline; belonged to D, Hunter of the Dead.

Weathered Map.text: Can be bought from Pidia for 600 runes.

Weathered Straight Sword.text: Dropped by Commoner enemies with a 4% drop rate. An easy spot to farm is the room with a Grafted Scion, where 3 Commoners are sitting next to a fireplace near the stairs to the second floor (an easy path there is taking the elevator next to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace).

Well Depths Key.text: Located in Belurat, Tower Settlement. From rooftops guarded by Gravebirds, drop from the South-East corner of the northernmost roof onto a drapery. The drapery leads to a covered bridge, from which you can reach a room containing two enemies and the Well Depths Key.

Well-Pickled Turtle Neck.text: Craft: Scadu Altus. Can be crafted after acquiring the Forager Brood Cookbook [6]. Talk to the forager brood member located near the walls of the Shadow Keep, Church District, northwest of the Church District Highroad site of grace. Purchase: Gravesite Plain. 1 is sold for runes 2 000 Runes by Moore at the Main Gate Cross Site of Grace.

What Do You Want?.text: Quest Item: Roundtable Hold. Given to the player after attempting to speak with Ensha of the Royal Remains next to Gideon's study in the Roundtable Hold.

Whetstone Knife.text: It's found at Gatefront Ruins, in the cellar's chest, alongside the Ash of War: Storm Stomp. Also sold for 500 runes Runes by the Twin Maiden Husks if any Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes is activated without picking it up.

Whip.text: Castle Morne: Inside the second prison cell area reached by dropping down onto a couple of beams. The room is filled with rats and a misbegotten.

Whirl, O Flame!.text: Loot: Caelid. Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in northern Caelid, between the Caelem Ruins and the Rotview Balcony sites of grace. The scarab is located right behind the black carriage containing the Greatsword.

White Mask.text: Guaranteed Drop: Mohgwyn Palace (Siofra River). Dropped by killing one of the three Nameless White Mask NPC invaders in the Mohgwyn Palace, northwest of the Palace Approach Ledge-Road Site of Grace, in the blood-filled lake. The White Mask that drops the Surgeon's set is found near the large stone pillar at the south of the swamp, directly west of the Site of Grace.

White Reed Armor.text: Found on a corpse inside Spiritcaller Cave in Moutaintops of the Giants.

White Reed Gauntlets.text: Found on a corpse inside Spiritcaller Cave in Moutaintops of the Giants.

White Reed Greaves.text: Found on a corpse inside Spiritcaller Cave in Moutaintops of the Giants.

Whiteflesh Mushroom.text: Whiteflesh Mushrooms are commonly harvested throughout the Gravesite Plain. Can be dropped by Shadow Nobles.

Windy Crystal Tear.text: Loot: Caelid. Looted from a bowl in southern Caelid, at the bottom of a cliff south of the Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank Site of Grace.

Wing of Astel.text: Loot: Uhl Palace Ruins. Found inside a chest in Uhl Palace Ruins above a Malformed Star, located in Ainsel River and only reachable from Ainsel River Main. More specifically, start from Ainsel River Main Site of Grace and head down the tunnel. Take the left split in the road, guarded by a Hardhead Giant Ant, and follow the cliffside path to a stone structure with the chest.

Winged Crystal Tear.text: Loot: Capital Outskirts. Found in a sap collection basin on top of some cliffs west of Capital Outskirts' Minor Erdtree and east of Hermit Merchant's Shack. It is guarded by a group of Skeletal Snails, with an additional Deathbird at night.

Winged Greathorn.text: Trade: Roundtable Hold. Trade the Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor, gained by defeating Regal Ancestor Spirit, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

Winged Misbegotten Ashes.text: Unsightly Catacombs, on the bottom level of a hall with lots of dead Misbegotten on the ground around it.

Winged Scythe.text: Found underground in the Tombsward Ruins, on the Weeping Peninsula.

Winged Serpent Helm.text: Guaranteed Drop: Specimen Storehouse. Drops from Kood, Captain of the Fire Knights, who can be found patrolling the entrance to the tower housing Messmer's Dark Chamber.

Winged Sword Insignia.text: Guaranteed drop: Stillwater Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes). Dropped by the Cleanrot Knight boss found at the bottom of Stillwater Cave.

Wise Man's Mask.text: Quest reward: Enir-Ilim (Land of the Tower). Available after successfully assisting Sir Ansbach in his battle against Needle Knight Leda at the Specimen Storehouse. Then defeating Promised Consort Radahn. The item can be recovered from Ansbach's body, which can be found seated against one of the walls close to the entrance of the boss arena.<!

Witch's Glintstone Crown.text: Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria Liurnia of the Lakes. Awarded upon completing Sellen's questline. If Sellen is sided with and both Comet Azur and Stars of Ruin are acquired, it can be found on the ground near Sellen's position in the Grand Library (Rennala's arena) after she transforms. If Witch-Hunter Jerren is sided with, it's awarded after defeating Sellen.

Wolf Crest Shield.text: Loot: Castle Ensis (Gravesite Plain). Found in a hidden room down some stairs west of the courtyard where Moonrithyll, Carian Knight can be fought. Can alternatively be reached after dropping down from the ledge where Glintblade Trio can be found.

Wooden Greatshield.text: Loot: Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Found on the upper floor of a guardhouse in Stormveil's courtyard, more specifically the guardhouse to the right if entering the area from the main gates and on the opposite side of the room with the "Prophecy" Painting.

Wraith Calling Bell.text: Loot: Laskyar Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes). Found inside a chest in the underground room of Laskyar Ruins.

Wrath from Afar.text: Loot: Shadow Keep. Found at the Specimen Storehouse in the Storehouse Loft on one of the giant cogs.

Wrath of Gold.text: Loot: Altus Plateau. Found in a treasure chest in the cellar of Woodfolk Ruins. The cellar is located in a cluster of ruins in the southeasternmost quarter of the forest.

Yellow Ember.text: Found in lands afflicted by frenzy.

Yellow Fulgurbloom.text: Yellow Fulgurbloom is found in the catacombs in the Realm of Shadow: Fog Rift Catacombs, Scorpion River Catacombs, and Darklight Catacombs. Found in the lightning-struck forest downstream of the Ellac River.

Ymir's Bell Bearing.text: Guaranteed Drop: Cathedral of Manus Metyr (Scadu Altus). Acquired after defeating Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers. To access the bossfight, the player must first defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers, then interact with Ymir's throne in the cathedral. This will make Jolan, Swordhand of Night appear, who will be hostile and proceed to attack the player.

Young Lion's Armor.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 20000 from Enia, after defeating Promised Consort Radahn.

Young Lion's Armor (Altered).text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Acquired from altering the Young Lion's Armor. Can be bought for 20000 from Enia, after defeating Promised Consort Radahn.

Young Lion's Gauntlets.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 12000 from Enia, after defeating Promised Consort Radahn.

Young Lion's Greaves.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 12000 from Enia, after defeating Promised Consort Radahn.

Young Lion's Helm.text: Purchase: Roundtable Hold. Can be bought for 12000 from Enia, after defeating Promised Consort Radahn.

Zamor Armor.text: Received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave located in Moutaintops of the Giants.

Zamor Bracelets.text: Received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave located in Moutaintops of the Giants.

Zamor Curved Sword.text: Guaranteed drop: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants). Dropped by the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss at the end of the Hero's Grave.

Zamor Ice Storm.text: Loot: Mountaintops of the Giants. Acquired from a corpse lying next to a wall in the southernmost quarters of the Zamor Ruins.

Zamor Legwraps.text: Received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave located in Moutaintops of the Giants.

Zamor Mask.text: Received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave located in Moutaintops of the Giants.

Zorayas's Letter.text: Found on the floor in Zorayas last location after defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy and choosing both to not kill her nor giving her the Tonic of Forgetfulness.

Zweihander.text: Purchase: Weeping Peninsula. One is sold for 3,500 runes Runes by the Isolated Merchant at the Isolated Merchant's Shack at the westernmost point of the Peninsula.
